jobs.excerpt: Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.
jobs.description:
Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.

Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best & Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy - transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary - come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.

As a remote-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.

Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!

The Sr Program Manager, Implementation serves as an experienced implementation delivery professional responsible for leading complex client onboarding and implementation programs across Alkami Digital Banking solutions. This role independently manages diverse implementation engagements, coordinates cross-functional delivery activities, and drives customer-facing project execution to ensure successful onboarding outcomes and positive client experiences. The position applies advanced project management, stakeholder engagement, and operational problem-solving skills to manage implementation complexity, mitigate delivery risks, and align project outcomes with customer goals and business objectives. The Sr Program Manager, Implementation operates independently on complex initiatives, influences implementation practices, and contributes to operational improvements that enhance delivery consistency, scalability, and customer satisfaction.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


  • Lead complex implementation programs by developing comprehensive project schedules, managing milestones, and coordinating cross-functional delivery activities across multiple customer engagements
  • Serve as the primary implementation lead for assigned customers by proactively managing expectations, facilitating communication, and ensuring alignment on project goals, timelines, and deliverables
  • Coordinate implementation activities across Delivery, Technical Services, Product, Customer Success, and external stakeholders by managing dependencies, resolving conflicts, and driving accountability for project outcomes
  • Analyze implementation risks and operational challenges by evaluating project progress, identifying potential delays, and developing mitigation strategies that support successful delivery outcomes
  • Facilitate customer-facing implementation meetings by leading discussions, documenting action items, and ensuring follow-through on critical implementation activities and decisions
  • Manage Jira tickets, project tasks, and implementation workflows by prioritizing issue resolution efforts and maintaining visibility into project health, milestones, and operational dependencies
  • Support onboarding readiness and implementation planning activities by validating customer requirements, operational prerequisites, and resource alignment prior to implementation execution
  • Develop and maintain accurate project documentation by preparing schedules, status reports, risk assessments, stakeholder communications, and implementation records throughout the project lifecycle
  • Apply advanced project management methodologies by adapting delivery approaches to address varying customer environments, implementation complexities, and operational constraints
  • Build strong customer relationships by acting as a trusted advisor, proactively addressing concerns, and guiding customers through implementation processes and decision-making activities
  • Drive implementation execution by coordinating internal resources, monitoring progress against timelines, and escalating critical issues that may impact delivery success or customer satisfaction
  • Identify process improvement opportunities by analyzing recurring implementation challenges and recommending workflow enhancements that improve implementation predictability and operational efficiency
  • Collaborate with leadership and implementation stakeholders by providing visibility into project health, resource considerations, and implementation risks across assigned portfolios
  • Support less experienced program managers by sharing implementation best practices, assisting with issue resolution, and providing guidance on project coordination activities
  • Manage multiple implementation programs with varying complexity levels by balancing customer priorities, operational demands, and delivery objectives across concurrent engagements

Recommended Experience & Education

Minimum Years of Experience

3–6 years of experience leading implementation programs, customer onboarding initiatives, project delivery activities, or client-facing operational projects within SaaS, fintech, banking technology, or related environments.

Education Level Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Information Systems, Communications, or related experience.


Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications


Required


  • Advanced experience managing implementation programs or customer onboarding initiatives
  • Strong project scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder coordination skills
  • Ability to independently manage complex implementation engagements and competing priorities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with customer-facing experience
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration across operational, technical, and customer teams
  • Ability to analyze implementation risks and develop effective mitigation strategies
  • Experience using project management and ticketing platforms such as Jira, Smartsheet, or similar tools
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and customer relationship management skills

Preferred


  • Experience supporting fintech, SaaS, or digital banking implementation programs
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project management methodologies ● Experience coordinating technical implementation or integration-related activities
  • Knowledge of onboarding operations, delivery lifecycle processes, or customer readiness planning
  • Experience contributing to process optimization or operational scalability initiatives
  • Experience mentoring or guiding junior project or implementation professionals

jobs.title: Program Manager, Membership & Engagement — Latin America
jobs.excerpt: At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success.
jobs.description:
At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.

Position Description

Connect Centric is seeking a Program Manager, Latin America to support the growth of our client’s regional presence, engagement, and member value, with a focus on Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, and Chile. You will execute regional strategy, contribute market insights, support member acquisition and retention, and strengthen engagement with international and student chapters.

You will work closely with global teams, volunteer leaders, faculty advisors, and external partners to expand reach and deliver meaningful member experiences. Spanish proficiency is required; Portuguese proficiency is strongly preferred.

What You Will Do

Market Strategy and Growth

  • Execute regional market development strategy across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, and Chile.
  • Research member needs, institutional dynamics, and the local competitive landscape; analyze findings to inform regional priorities and market approaches.
  • Identify and support growth opportunities through academic partnerships, institutional engagement, and industry collaboration.
  • Contribute to localized engagement plans aligned with global membership and retention goals.

Member Acquisition and Retention

  • Execute targeted initiatives to grow membership among students, early-career professionals, and institutional segments.
  • Support retention programs that strengthen member value and renewal rates; monitor effectiveness and recommend improvements.
  • Partner with marketing and product teams to localize messaging, campaigns, and value propositions.

Chapter Support and Engagement

  • Serve as a liaison to international and student chapters across Latin America, maintaining ongoing relationships with volunteer leaders and faculty advisors.
  • Support chapter activation, sustainability, and growth, particularly in priority markets; help volunteer leaders increase programming frequency, relevance, and participation.
  • Develop and implement approaches that help student chapter members transition into professional chapter or local section engagement.
  • Facilitate faculty advisor and institutional engagement to sustain membership connections across career stages, and share chapter best practices that improve member experience, engagement, and retention.

Programs and Events

  • Lead or support regional workshops, webinars, conferences, and partner activities aligned with membership growth, awareness, and engagement objectives.
  • Coordinate event logistics, vendors, and stakeholder communications; represent the client at regional events as needed.
  • Use market feedback and program performance to provide insights and recommend improvements.

Stakeholder Engagement and Partnerships

  • Build and manage relationships with universities, research institutions, industry partners, and scientific societies across priority countries.
  • Identify partnership opportunities aligned with growth goals and support onboarding of new partners to expand the client’s reach and influence.
  • Engage faculty advisors, volunteer leaders, and early-career communities to strengthen connections with prospective and current members; serve as a regional contact for stakeholders and internal collaborators.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 5–8 years of experience in program management, membership organizations, or international market engagement.
  • Proficiency in Spanish.
  • Experience supporting membership growth, engagement, or retention initiatives.
  • Strong execution skills and the ability to translate strategy into practical actions.
  • Ability to independently manage priorities and multiple projects across countries and stakeholders.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills across diverse cultural contexts.
  • Experience tracking and reporting performance metrics and using data to inform program decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in or with Latin American markets, particularly Brazil and Mexico, strongly preferred.
  • Portuguese proficiency strongly preferred.
  • Advanced degree.
  • Background in scientific, academic, nonprofit, or professional membership organizations.

Position Details

  • Position Type: Full-time W-2 employment. Independent contractor or 1099 arrangements are not available for this position.
  • Location: Washington D.C.
  • This position is fully remote
  • Pay Rate: $65K - $75K

Information Technology (IT) Unit
1400 Washington Street, Phoenix, Arizona 85007

Job Summary:

Would you like to be part of an amazing team that helps Arizonans thrive? At the Department of Economic Security (DES), we strengthen individuals, families, and communities for a better quality of life. DES is looking for individuals that are committed to service, community, and teamwork. To learn more about DES, please visit ; or click on the link here to view ‘Our DES’ video. Come join the DES Team!

The Department of Economic Security, Division of Employment and Rehabilitation Services (DERS) strengthens Arizona communities by bridging and minimizing gaps to employment and independence.

DES is seeking an experienced and highly motivated individual to join our team as an Information Security Analyst with the Information Technology (IT) Unit. This position is responsible for setting, interpreting, and managing information security policies, procedures, and security related to Division data sharing agreements in order to maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information in compliance with Department, State, and Federal Security Regulations. This position takes a "big-picture" view of issues relating to the agency's data sharing agreements, and will take a major role or lead related to data sharing agreements that require policy, legal, regulatory, and technical analysis.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that aﬀords employees ﬂexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in oﬃces, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona, unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Data Sharing agreements (working with external and internal partners to ensure that sharing of data is done in compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements and with proper contractual safeguards).
• User assistance (inquiries regarding data sharing agreement options, policies, and practices).
• Unemployment Insurance (UI) Cost Recovery (Ensuring cost recovery occurs, accurately and timely, for UI data sharing by invoicing data requesters and coordinating with the DERS budget section concerning proper receipt of requested payments).
• Information Security Policy (Monitoring, review, analysis, implementation).
• Audit (Assisting with program audits related to data sharing agreement activity).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge in:
• Data sharing policy, security, legal requirements, regulatory requirements, and administrative requirements.
• Management of both physical and logical information security systems.
• Information Technology (IT) and telecommunications security trends and practices; development of data security policies and procedures; IT Security Standards; WA/EEA/RSA/CCA/RAA applications security; knowledge of directives and practices required to prepare internal and external data sharing agreements.

Skill in:
• Written and oral communication to convey a wide variety of information.
• Policy, legal, and regulatory research.
• Technical presentation, outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, and problem-solving.

Ability to:
• Research, understand, and apply data sharing directives, determine data sharing agreement content, and develop data sharing agreements.
• Learn and comprehend complex State and Federal security regulations and requirements, and communicate them in meaningful ways.
• analyze business needs of the agency and apply the findings to make decisions on structure, types of technologies, and implement appropriate solutions based on business needs.

  • Have an Associate’s degree plus 1 -3 years of experience in information security analysis (or equivalent experience).
    • Candidate shall have or meet the requirements to obtain prior to their first day of employment, a valid Level One Arizona fingerprint clearance card that meets DES requirements for a Level One card pursuant to Arizona Revised Statute 41-1969.
    • Successfully pass background and reference checks; employment is contingent upon completion of the above-mentioned process and the agency’s ability to reasonably accommodate any restrictions.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior DevSecOps Automation Solution Architect to support a large‑scale, multi‑year Mainframe Modernization initiative for a major federal customer. In this customer‑facing role, you will partner directly with the client’s technical and business stakeholders to design and implement modern engineering, automation, and delivery practices that accelerate their transformation from legacy mainframe systems to secure, cloud‑native platforms. As a key member of the modernization program’s architecture team, reporting to the Chief Architect, you will help shape the technical roadmap, lead solution development, and guide engineering teams through modern DevSecOps approaches that ensure reliability, security, and scalability throughout the transformation journey. Your work will directly support mission‑critical objectives and enable the customer to achieve long‑term operational modernization outcomes.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will collaborate closely with federal customer stakeholders to:

  • Design and communicate DevSecOps automation strategies that align legacy‑to‑cloud modernization goals and customer mission needs.
  • Build compelling technical briefings, modernization roadmaps, and reusable solution artifacts tailored for customer consumption.
  • LProvide guidance to engineering teams and customer personnel on CI/CD pipeline modernization, security integration, test automation, and cloud deployment approaches.
  • Evaluate legacy mainframe workflows and help plan prototype implementations demonstrating modernization feasibility and value.
  • Continuously assess modernization progress and support iterative improvements across development, deployment, security, and monitoring workflows.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree preferred
  • 10+ years software development experience, including 5+ years in DevSecOps CI/CD and 3+ years developing cloud‑native software solutions (AWS Preferred).
  • Certifications in software development, DevSecOps, or cloud‑native architecture.
  • Expertise in DevSecOps automation, Agile/Lean delivery, and enterprise‑grade CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitLab/GitHub, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, Sonatype, New Relic, Dynatrace, etc.).
  • Hands‑on experience designing and supporting cloud‑native architectures, containerized microservices, API‑driven interfaces, and event‑based systems. Strong background in application containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Proficiency in modern development frameworks and languages (Java, .NET, Node.js, Spring, Angular, React, JSON, etc.).
  • Experience working with large datasets, data migration strategies, and modernization‑aligned analytics workflows.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience helping federal customers adopt cloud‑native architectures and services (AWS, Azure, container‑based microservices, REST APIs).
  • Demonstrated ability to onboard teams into modern DevSecOps pipelines and accelerate adoption of automation practices.
  • Experience scaling high‑performance engineering solutions for structured and unstructured data.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence engaging directly with customer stakeholders at all levels.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do. ● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities ● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals ● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off ● Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home ● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

Job Title:Account Executive, UGG - Atlanta

Reports to:National Sales Manager – Independent Channel

Location: Atlanta, GA (Remote)

The Role

As an Account Executive for UGG, you’ll manage all aspects of the business relationship between the UGG brand and retailers within your territory. You’ll focus on long-term account development, profitable growth, and building strong relationships with buyers, management, owners, and staff. This role delivers agreed targets by maximizing productivity of existing accounts and pursuing new opportunities in line with brand distribution strategies. Extensive travel and overnight stays are expected throughout the regional territory and for corporate meetings.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

  • Meet or exceed seasonal and fiscal year sales budgets by developing account plans, managing forecasting, and executing sales strategies through in-person and remote appointments
  • Responsible for maintaining elevated UGG presentations that align with UGG Retailer Guidelines across the existing account base and potential new distribution opportunities.
  • Oversee end-to-end account management, including securing orders, coordinating sell-in and sell-through, and ensuring all administrative requirements and deadlines are met
  • Provide ongoing sales reporting and forecasting updates, and perform additional duties as assigned by the Sales Manager
  • Lead full 360-degree account management, building strong relationships with buyers and owners, maintaining consistent communication, and serving as the primary point of contact for the UGG brand
  • Manage strategic customer engagement through regular outreach, account visits, and effective use of marketing tools to drive profitable growth
  • Consistently communicate UGG Retailer Marketplace Guidelines to ensure all retail partners meet or exceed expectations
  • Build seasonal business plans by account using LY data, current business trends, and market analysis to achieve/exceed sales targets
  • Manage current season’s order book to ensure on-time shipments and timely order modifications
  • Work closely with cross-functional partners in Customer Experience and Credit to ensure timely flow of orders
  • Maintain profitability by coordinating with corporate headquarters and customers to minimize returns, credits, and other costs
  • Utilize marketing resources strategically, ensuring thoughtful and ROI-driven investment
  • Manage travel and expenses in line with budget expectations

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent level of experience
  • 3-5 years of sales, account management, retail, merchandising, or customer-facing experience
  • Experience managing customer relationships and delivering against sales or business objectives
  • Footwear, Apparel, or Consumer Products experience preferred
  • Proficient in Microsoft applications, with strong analytical skills in Excel
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and public-speaking communication skills, able to engage effectively at all organizational levels
  • Demonstrates sound independent judgment and thrives in fast-paced, multi-functional environments
  • Highly detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Demonstrate authenticity, champion diverse and effective teams, drive strategy, cultivate innovation, deliver results, and build connection

What We'll Give You –

  • Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
  • Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
  • Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
  • Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.
$66,100.00 - $89,300.00

The salary range posted reflects the estimated minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for this role in:

US - GA Remote Atlanta

Individual pay will be determined by location and additional factors, including job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Diversity and inclusion are key to our success. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds who share a passion for our brands. jobs.description:
Principal Product Manager, Mytonomy

Are you passionate about shaping innovative digital health products that improve patient engagement, education, and outcomes?

Do you enjoy translating customer needs, healthcare insights, and emerging technologies into scalable solutions that deliver meaningful impact?

About our Team

Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision-making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and support a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to help shape the future of the Mytonomy patient education and engagement platform. In this strategic role, you will lead product direction and execution across key areas of the platform, including healthcare integrations and AI-driven capabilities. You will collaborate across teams to deliver solutions that improve patient engagement, care adherence, and outcomes while creating meaningful customer and business value.

Responsibilities

  • Own product strategy, roadmap planning, requirements, and execution for key areas of Mytonomy’s platform.

  • Translate customer needs, market insights, healthcare trends, and product analytics into clear priorities and scalable solutions.

  • Lead discovery, research, testing, and data-driven decision-making to validate product opportunities and reduce execution risk.

  • Drive product development across cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment from concept through launch and adoption.

  • Expand Mytonomy’s integration ecosystem, including EMR/EHR systems, CRM platforms, APIs, and third-party healthcare technology solutions.

  • Partner with sales, marketing, customer success, and client services on go-to-market strategy, launch planning, positioning, messaging, and commercialization.

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and generative AI to improve product performance and patient outcomes.

  • Evaluate new product opportunities, build investment cases, and assess commercial viability.

Requirements

  • Product management experience in healthcare technology, digital health, patient engagement, enterprise software, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated success defining, launching, and scaling commercially successful products.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare technology ecosystems, including EMR/EHR systems, CRM platforms, APIs, interoperability standards, and healthcare data environments.

  • Experience applying data, analytics, customer research, and market insights to product strategy and prioritization.

  • Familiarity with AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and generative AI, with the ability to translate emerging technologies into practical product opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to assess market opportunities, develop business cases, and align product work to growth objectives.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across product, engineering, commercial, clinical, and executive audiences.

  • Collaborative leadership style with a track record of mentoring others, building alignment, and driving outcomes in complex environments.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About the Business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

jobs.title: Account Executive - New Logo (East Coast)
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreBrandlive is a global technology and services company specialising in high-quality virtual and hybrid events, webcasting and digital experiences.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Brandlive is a global technology and services company specialising in high-quality virtual and hybrid events, webcasting and digital experiences. We combine a purpose-built technology platform with production expertise, creative services and hands-on support to help organisations deliver engaging communications at scale.

BrandTV is the evolution of that capability into an enterprise video and communications ecosystem designed to make important communications more engaging, polished and valuable. It brings together live streaming, on-demand video, production, creative and expert support to help organisations create experiences employees want to watch — rather than another meeting they have to attend.

The Role

The Account Executive - New Logo is responsible solely for winning new business for BrandTV. This is a net-new sales role focused on identifying, qualifying, progressing and closing new enterprise opportunities across a global market. The Account Executive will partner closely with the New Logo Hunter / BDR and Sales Director to convert targeted accounts into qualified opportunities and signed customers.

The Account Executive owns the sales process from qualified opportunity through close, including discovery, stakeholder mapping, consultative selling, demonstrations, proposals, commercial negotiation and contract close. They will build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, understand the customer's business and communications challenges, and articulate the value of BrandTV across its platform, production, creative and content ecosystem.

Following a successful close, the Account Executive will remain the commercial owner during an initial onboarding / transition period, typically 6–12 months, working with the Account Director and Customer Success Manager to establish a strong handover and foundations for long-term customer success. Ongoing renewals and account expansion will transfer to the existing-business team and are not responsibilities of this role.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full new-business sales cycle from qualified opportunity through signed contract, with a focus on enterprise BrandTV opportunities.
  • Partner closely with the New Logo Hunter / BDR to progress qualified meetings into well-defined sales opportunities and maintain clear next steps.
  • Conduct high-quality discovery to understand business objectives, communication challenges, current-state technology, stakeholders, decision process and commercial drivers.
  • Confidently deliver consultative BrandTV demonstrations tailored to the customer's use case, buyer, vertical and desired outcomes rather than relying on a generic product pitch.
  • Build and manage relationships with senior stakeholders, including VP and C-level decision-makers, across Internal Communications, Executive Communications, Corporate Communications, Employee Experience and related functions.
  • Develop compelling proposals and business cases that articulate the value of BrandTV across the platform, live experience, VOD, production and creative ecosystem.
  • Manage commercial negotiations, procurement and internal approvals through to close, leveraging internal resources to accelerate the sales process and mitigate risk.
  • Maintain accurate, timely and transparent opportunity management in HubSpot, including qualification, stakeholders, stage, close date, next steps, value and forecast.
  • Build and maintain a disciplined pipeline of new-logo opportunities in line with Brandlive's commercial targets and sales methodology.
  • Conduct ongoing market and account research to identify high-fit enterprise accounts, relevant buying triggers, priority personas and competitive dynamics.
  • Work closely with Solutions, Production, Creative and other internal teams to shape the right solution and ensure the opportunity is commercially and operationally viable.
  • Develop a clear transition plan for every new customer and partner with the Account Director and Customer Success Manager through the initial 6–12 month period to ensure a high-quality handover.
  • Contribute to sales best-practice sharing, messaging development, objection handling, battle cards and continuous improvement of the Brandlive/BrandTV sales motion.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of selling net-new enterprise software, technology or technology-enabled services.
  • Experience owning complex, consultative sales cycles from qualification through contract close.
  • Experience selling to VP and C-level stakeholders and navigating complex buying committees.
  • Strong discovery, consultative selling, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Confident delivering tailored product and solution demonstrations to different stakeholders and business audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline, create urgency and progress opportunities through a multi-month sales cycle.
  • Strong commercial judgement and ability to build a compelling business case around customer outcomes and value.
  • Highly organised, disciplined and accurate in CRM and pipeline management.
  • Self-motivated, resilient and comfortable operating in a high-accountability new-business environment.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to build a new sales motion, test approaches and continuously improve.
  • Strong written and verbal professional communication skills in English.
  • Experience in events, streaming, SaaS, internal communications, employee experience or a related technology/service environment is desirable.

Brandlive Inc. is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to workforce diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic or status protected by law. Brandlive will conduct a background check on final candidates following a formal offer of employment as a condition of employment. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Project Manager – AI & Innovation
jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are seeking an experienced, highly hands-on Senior Project Manager – AI & Innovation to lead and deliver strategic innovation initiatives across Business Assurance IT.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, highly hands-on Senior Project Manager – AI & Innovation to lead and deliver strategic innovation initiatives across Business Assurance IT. This is not a purely governance-focused project management role. The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly with AI tools, developing and refining prompts, testing use cases, supporting rapid prototyping, and translating business needs into practical solutions.

The role will manage a portfolio of AI-driven projects, Proofs of Concept (POCs), Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), automation initiatives, and emerging digital solutions from idea through implementation. These initiatives span multiple business functions and require close collaboration across IT, Operations, Sales, and other business stakeholders.

The role will support the Global Head of IT in shaping the future Business Assurance AI roadmap by identifying high-value opportunities, translating strategic priorities and business needs into a coherent portfolio of initiatives, and establishing clear sequencing, dependencies, governance, and success measures. Working across the five IT pillars and with key business stakeholders, the role will provide the analysis, coordination, and decision support needed to align investment, accelerate responsible adoption, and turn the AI ambition into a practical, scalable roadmap.

Experience within the Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC) industry is strongly preferred, as it would support a faster understanding of Business Assurance processes, audit workflows, and operational use cases.

Our Strategic Pillars

• Customer Experience

• Operational Efficiency

• Auditor Experience

• Customised Audit

• Data Analytics

Each pillar is led by a dedicated IT Manager responsible for delivery within their area. This role will focus on initiatives that cut across several pillars or sit outside existing pillar ownership.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on AI and Innovation Delivery

• Lead AI, automation, and innovation projects from initial concept through deployment and adoption.

• Work hands-on with AI tools, including developing, testing, and refining prompts for specific business use cases.

• Translate operational and commercial challenges into practical AI use cases, workflows, experiments, and prototypes.

• Conduct structured experimentation, validate outputs, gather user feedback, and improve solutions through iteration.

• Partner with technical teams and business users to move successful concepts from prototype to scalable implementation.

• Promote responsible and effective use of AI, with appropriate attention to data quality, security, governance, and measurable value.

Project Leadership

• Manage POCs, MVPs, pilots, digital products, and business transformation initiatives.

• Develop clear project plans, business cases, budgets, timelines, risk controls, success measures, and adoption plans.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, technology teams, and external partners.

• Maintain momentum, resolve dependencies, and ensure initiatives deliver measurable business value and operational impact.

• Balance structured project governance with a practical, agile, and delivery-focused approach.

AI and Innovation Portfolio

• Identify and evaluate opportunities for AI, automation, analytics, and other emerging technologies.

• Support the development and execution of the Business Assurance AI roadmap.

• Manage innovation initiatives that are not yet assigned to a dedicated pillar.

• Drive rapid prototyping, experimentation, validation, and scaling of successful solutions.

• Support AI adoption by helping stakeholders understand where AI can add value and how it can be applied effectively.

Qualifications and Experience

• At least five years of experience in project management, digital transformation, innovation management, digital product delivery, or a related field.

• Experience in the Certification/Business Assurance industry is strongly preferred.• A proven track record of delivering technology-enabled or business transformation projects from concept through implementation.

• Practical, hands-on experience using generative AI tools and prompt engineering, including developing, testing, and refining prompts for business applications.

• Experience managing AI, automation, analytics, or digital product initiatives.

• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to connect business needs and technical delivery.

• Experience working in global, matrix organisations and coordinating contributors across functions and geographies.

• An agile, experimental mindset with the ability to work through ambiguity and turn early-stage ideas into practical solutions.

• Experience with AI initiatives supporting Sales or Salesforce-related use cases would be a strong advantage.

• Agile project delivery experience is preferred.

• Fluency in English, in addition to the local language, Spanish is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

• Successfully delivers a portfolio of practical AI and innovation initiatives with measurable business outcomes.

• Demonstrates a hands-on approach by actively shaping prompts, use cases, prototypes, and solution testing.

• Accelerates responsible adoption of AI capabilities across Business Assurance.

• Converts ideas and emerging opportunities into scalable, user-focused business solutions.

• Enables effective collaboration across IT pillars and business functions.

• Acts as a trusted, delivery-focused partner to the Global Head of IT in advancing the Business Assurance innovation agenda.

Please share your CV in English

Why SGS?

  • Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
  • Flexible schedule and hybrid/remote model.
  • SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
  • Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
  • Benefits platform.

Join Us: At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

At SGS, we have an open corporate and international culture. We offer a dynamic work environment in a leading global company. Our high professional standards and our sustainability approach guarantee you a future-oriented work environment. We invest in our employees for the long term and are committed to supporting your development within the company. Our business principles include: Integrity, Health, Safety & Environment, Quality & Professionalism, Respect, Sustainability, and Leadership.

jobs.excerpt: Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd.  (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions.
jobs.description:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry. Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.

The Vice President, Operational Accounting Lead, plays a key leadership role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of the cash, debt and expense general ledger balances and related accounting across all legal entities and reporting bases within the organization. The position involves strategic implementations, other AI enabled process improvements, internal control design and maintenance, and leading a team of accountants across the organization. The position reports to the Insurance & Group Controller.

What You Will Do:

  • Maintain and/or refine the general ledger structure and chart of accounts in collaboration with Strategic Projects

  • Lead legal entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany processes, ensuring adherence to GAAP, STAT, SFS, EBS and internal methodologies.

  • Oversee FX translations, cash flow statement, and related-party accounting

  • Oversee the development and maintenance of the account hierarchy and ensure internal policy-aligned journal entry execution

  • Prepare SUM and support the SAB 99 process in coordination with Financial Reporting and Financial Controls

  • Develop and maintain robust control procedures, including reconciliations and drive execution of reconciliations and related controls

  • Support evolving business needs (e.g., new transactions, debt issuances, etc.) with timely, accurate and high-quality financial reports

jobs.description:
About CodeDay & CodeDay Labs Program

There's a place in tech for everyone. CodeDay is a non-profit providing welcoming, hands-on opportunities for under-served students to explore a future in tech and beyond.

CodeDay's Labs program is a 100% online tech internship for anyone. Tens of thousands of talented CS students attend affordable local colleges rely on internships to gain real-world knowledge and demonstrate the skills they need to get a job. But most companies focus their hiring on brand-name schools. We help these students get real-world opportunities by pairing them with an industry mentor to work on a real-world, open-source Computer Science project.

About the Role

Mentors are the lifeblood of CodeDay Labs, and mentor managers help us recruit, onboard, train, and provide support to the mentors who oversee student projects. You'll support a team of 3-20 mentors (your choice):

  • Recruit mentors (optional): Reach out to engineering leadership at a few tech companies, and present information about why their employees should volunteer.

  • Onboard mentors: One ~15min phone call to determine interests and match them with one of our partner open source projects.

  • Monitor: During the program, ensure all teams are meeting regularly, and review weekly reflections from mentors and students. Raise any concerns with program staff.

  • Check in: During the program, check in with your mentors every 1-2 weeks about any issues or feedback.

Most of these activities will take place at your own schedule.

Requirements

  • Good organizational skills (or otherwise happy to edit things in a spreadsheet).

  • Comfortable taking on the phone and writing emails.

  • At least hand-wavey-level knowledge of how teams develop software, and some modern tooling (consuming/building APIs, what goes into front-end/mobile/back-end development, etc). You don't need to know how to do these things, but you need to be able to talk about them enough to help match a mentor to a project.

  • Available during some US working hours each weekday.

College students or responsible high school students are probably a good fit.

Compensation

You'll be paid as a contractor:

  • $50 per mentor managed.

  • $50 per mentor recruited, if any, as a result of your efforts.

  • $50 per session for your time attending meetings with our program staff.

You're also welcome to do this as a volunteer job, if you'd like to help us get more students into the program.

Tools & Platforms

  • You thrive in collaborative, fast-paced marketing environments.
  • You balance creative excellence with marketing performance.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Design social media graphics and paid advertising creatives.
  • Develop campaign assets for email marketing and digital promotions.
  • Create web graphics, landing page visuals, and marketing collateral.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams on campaign concepts and creative direction.
  • Refine designs based on stakeholder feedback.

In short: You create high-performing visual assets that strengthen brand identity, improve marketing performance, and help drive measurable business results.

  • Two or fewer revision cycles per project
  • Stakeholder satisfaction with design quality

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a creative Graphic Designer with a strong portfolio, a passion for performance-driven design, and experience building compelling marketing campaigns, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help create visual experiences that drive real business results.

jobs.excerpt: 🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
jobs.description:
🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future?

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Head of Global Talent Acquisition to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our Mission:
We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our Vision:
We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.

Role Overview

Role Overview

As the Head of Global Talent Acquisition, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond.

This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement).

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role):

• Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment.

• Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end.

• Sourcing Channel Optimization: Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance; build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.

• Employer Brand & Glassdoor Defense: Monitor and manage Glassdoor reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, protect brand rating.

• Hiring Metrics & Funnel Reporting: Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role; track funnel performance against KPIs.

People Operations:

• People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, align

ed with the company's growth objectives.

• Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business.

• Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization.

• Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

• Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness.

• External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary.

How Success Is Measured

Talent Acquisition KPIs:

• Average time to fill open roles: under 45 days.

• Weekly applicant volume per active role: 250+ qualified applicants.

• Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel: 100% completion, on time.

• Completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week: 15+.

• Glassdoor company rating: maintain 4.5+ average across the year.

People Operations KPIs:

• Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business's ability to scale.

• Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement.

• Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment.

• Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company's growth and success.

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a recruiting-strong, systems-oriented leader. You have personally closed difficult hires, not just managed a team that did. You move fast in a sourcing pipeline, you can run a structured interview that lands the right read on a candidate in 30 minutes, and you are equally comfortable defending the company on Glassdoor as you are building a 90-day onboarding plan. You thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first, contractor-centric environment and have a track record of both filling open roles ahead of timeline and scaling the people systems that retain the talent you bring in.

You Have / Requirements

Talent Acquisition / Recruiting (must-haves):

• 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in remote or e-commerce organizations.

• Proven track record of hiring across marketing, ops, Amazon, product, and leadership roles.

• Experience running structured interviews, test projects, and group interviews.

• Familiarity with recruiting tech stacks: LinkedIn Recruiter, Workable, OnlineJobs.ph.

• Comfortable managing hiring systems using Notion, ClickUp, or lightweight ATS tools.

• Strong writing ability: clear job posts, compelling outreach, direct candidate comms.

• Ability to handle 5-10 active roles at a time with no drop-off in process.

• Experience defending brand reputation and responding to feedback (e.g. Glassdoor).

• Experience building and running reporting for hiring metrics.

People Operations (must-haves):

• 5+ years of progressive HR or people operations experience, with leadership responsibility.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.

• Direct experience operating contractor-centric or distributed teams.

• Demonstrated success building compliant, scalable people systems.

• Strong understanding of contractor classification, employment law, and risk mitigation.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand.
  • Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours.
  • Benefits:
    • Remote-first work environment
    • Paid time off and holidays
    • Access to learning resources and professional development
    • Free access to Hadley Designs products
    • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CMO
    • Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Apply Today

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact in a growing company that’s shaping the future of learning, apply now to join the Hadley Designs team as our Director of People Operations. Help us create a lasting impact on families, educators, and children worldwide.

P.S: If you don’t hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

Berkley Medical Management Solutions (BMMS) provides a different kind of managed-care service for W.R. Berkley Corporation. Our goal was clear: combine solid clinical practices, proven return-to-work strategies and robust software into one system for seamless management of workers’ compensation cases.

To get it right, we started with a flexible technology platform that allowed for impressive customization without sacrificing the ability for expansion and continued innovation. We deploy integrated systems to give W.R. Berkley Companies recommendations and professional services for managing each individual case in an efficient and appropriate manner. The power of our technology takes medical bill-review services and clinical advisory services to a new level. Our unique marriage of technology, software platforms, data analytics and professional services ensures we provide Berkley’s operating units with reliable results, and reduced time and expenses associated with case management.

Our team brings former experience at the world's leading quantitative firms, including Two Sigma, Flow Traders, Tower Research, PDT Partners, SIG, and more.

We're looking for a midlevel or senior IC to join our Backend Engineering team as a Site Reliability Engineer. You'll own the uptime, performance, and observability of our platform, and help set the standard for how the rest of engineering builds, ships, and monitors software.

The range of problems is wide. You'll work on petabyte-scale data processing, SaaS problems like customer management and billing, and the query systems that power our APIs. Unlike most finance firms, we're open about our tech and how we build it.

Responsibilities

  • Own uptime, SLAs, and SLOs across our API and platform services.
  • Set reliability and operational best practices for other developers without slowing them down.
  • Build and maintain observability across logging, metrics, and tracing.
  • Design and run high-availability deployment and containerization strategies.
  • Profile and optimize Python applications for throughput, latency, and cost.
  • Debug production issues down to the OS level using tools like strace, perf, eBPF, ss, and gdb.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, including application development and performance optimization.
  • Comfortable with Linux debugging and profiling tools such as strace, perf, eBPF, ss, and gdb.

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The Director of Sales, Europe will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.

As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Kingdom or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.
  • Forecast Governance & Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.
  • Capture Strategy & Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.
  • Manage, Coach & Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.

  • Talent Bench & Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.
  • Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.
  • Technical & Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.
  • Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory / leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.
  • Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.
  • Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).

  • An established, C-level network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, Allied Commands, and European Defense Primes / System Integrators.
  • Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support Allied posture, sovereign defense, intelligence, and ISR missions.
  • Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.
  • A strategic, self-directed leader with commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.

Senior Full-Stack PHP Developer
Contract | Remote (South Africa) | Full-Time Hours

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack PHP Developer to join one of our clients in a fast-moving applications team during an exciting period of platform growth and delivery. You'll work across a customer-facing web platform and its APIs, building new features, integrating third-party services, and surfacing new data and reporting experiences for end users.

This is a full-stack role and you'll be embedded directly into our client's team, joining daily standups, working within established processes and tooling, and picking up work across the backlog, from backend PHP/Symfony development through to React/TypeScript UI work. We're looking for experienced professionals who can get up to speed quickly and start delivering with minimal ramp-up time.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Building and improving customer-facing features across a large, established PHP/Symfony web application backed by MySQL

  • Developing new UI components and views in React/TypeScript

  • Exposing new data and reporting through portal pages, reporting views, and API layers

  • Integrating third-party services via their APIs and SDKs, and maintaining clean abstraction layers

  • Enhancing and extending the existing PHP API layer to support new platform features

  • Full-stack delivery across backend and frontend, picking up whatever the backlog needs

The Tech Stack

Backend

  • PHP with Symfony, clean code architecture, not just framework familiarity

  • Doctrine ORM

  • MySQL (production and read replicas)

  • AWS-hosted, served via Apache

Frontend

  • React built in TypeScript

  • JavaScript and CSS; some legacy Vue

Testing

  • PHPUnit for unit testing

  • Playwright for UI/E2E testing

What We're Looking For

  • Strong commercial PHP experience, ideally with Symfony or a comparable modern PHP framework, with a solid grasp of clean API design and architecture

  • Solid SQL skills: writing and optimising queries against large datasets, comfortable working with an ORM. MySQL experience is a plus; strong Postgres experience is also acceptable

  • Proven experience building and consuming REST APIs, including third-party integrations

  • Comfortable working on AWS-hosted applications

  • Frontend competence in TypeScript/JavaScript sufficient to contribute across the full stack

  • Strong engineering discipline, version control, unit testing, code review and clear written communication for a remote embedded team

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to telematics, IoT, or high-volume data platforms

  • Familiarity with agentic coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code

  • Docker — working familiarity expected at senior level

  • Python — not needed for this engagement but a longer-term plus

Ways of Working

This is a fully remote engagement but requires guaranteed overlap with UK business hours for daily standups and team collaboration. You'll be embedded directly in the team, this is not a hand-off or black-box delivery model. We value pragmatic, delivery-focused engineers who are comfortable in large established codebases and focused on shipping.

Wellis is een snelgroeiende healthtech scale-up die één van de meest traditionele sectoren opnieuw uitvindt: de apotheek. Wat nog maar kort geleden begon, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een winstgevend Europees bedrijf met tienduizenden klanten — en we staan pas aan het begin.

Door medische expertise te combineren met technologie en data maken we de zorg slimmer, efficiënter en persoonlijker. We richten ons op thema’s zoals gewichtsbeheersing, leefstijlbegeleiding en medicatie op maat.

Bij Wellis sluit je je aan bij een gedreven, ambitieus team dat snel schakelt, conventies doorbreekt en bouwt met impact. We creëren een omgeving waar professionals zich thuis voelen: met korte communicatielijnen, veel eigenaarschap en de energie van een organisatie die hard groeit.

Over de rol

Als verpleegkundige ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen cliënten, apothekers en het logistieke team. Je zorgt dat alles soepel verloopt: van intake tot medicatieverstrekking. Je combineert klantgericht contact met procesmatig inzicht en kwaliteitsbewust werken — volledig digitaal.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Cliëntcontact & farmaceutische zorg: uitvoeren van telefonische intakes, beantwoorden van vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat.

  • Dossierbeheer: controleren en aanvullen van cliëntendossiers, bewaken van medicatieveiligheid en signaleren van bijzonderheden.

  • Samenwerking met apothekers: afstemmen over recepten en afwijkingen, zorgen voor correcte documentatie volgens wet- en regelgeving.

  • Procescoördinatie: ondersteunen van de logistieke processen op afstand en meedenken over verbeteringen in workflow en kwaliteit.

  • Kwaliteitsbewaking: bijdragen aan het borgen van procedures en meewerken aan optimalisatie van digitale zorgprocessen.

Requirements

  • Diploma MBO-4 verpleegkunde met BIG-registratie.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als verpleegkundige.
