POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Care Manager – Innovations Waiver (IW) to join our Care Management Team! The Care Manager - IW is responsible for providing complex care coordination and monitoring to members having a primary Intellectual or Developmental Disability, which may include secondary mental health or substance abuse, and/or complex medical/physical health needs. This position requires a dynamic, proactive approach to assessment, monitoring, and complex coordination of care, to ensure quality support and consistent adherence to waiver requirements. Care Manager - IW assists with integrated care management through multi-disciplinary collaboration and referrals. This position has a primary focus on members who have Intellectual Developmental Disability, serving both children, adolescents, and adults.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Utilize person centered planning methods/strategies to gather information, to get to know the members supported and to adequately address specific needs of the individual.
  • Provide education and support to members in learning about and exercising rights and responsibilities.
  • Consistently complete Discovery activities (information gathering and assessment) as a component of the planning process.
  • Ensure that members/legally responsible people are informed of services available (all types of Medicaid and state-funded services), service options available (e.g. Individual/Family Direction for Innovations participants), processes (e.g. requirements for specific service), Natural and community services, and so forth.
  • Assist members/legally responsible people in choosing service providers, ensuring objectivity in the process.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must meet QP status.
  1. Fully licensed by the NC governing board regulating Human Services professions; OR Fully licensed RN who is licensed to practice in the state of NC by the NC Board of Nursing who also has four (4) years of full-time experience with the MH/DD/SA population served. OR
  2. A graduate of a college or university with a Master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  3. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a human service field and has two years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has two years of full-time, pre or post bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  4. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a field other than human services and has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling.
  • Additionally, If serving members with LTSS needs, the care manager, must meet the minimum QP requirements defined above (A-D) and shall additionally have at a minimum two (2) years of prior LTSS and/or HCBS coordination, care delivery monitoring and care management experience. This experience may be concurrent with the years of experience required to become a Qualified Professional.
  • License and/or certification may be accepted as noted above.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside in North Carolina and within 75 miles Trillium’s South Central Region, specifically Pender County.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree in human services.
  • Experience with the Innovation Waiver or IDD population and writing person-centered plans.

Deadline for Application:October 12, 2026 at 11:59 PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

The Opportunity

We're hiring Licensed Mental Health Therapists (LCSW, LPC, LMHC) to provide therapy for autistic and neurodivergent adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affirming, accessible mental health services for the neurodivergent community.

Our clinicians come from diverse backgrounds and career stages - whether you're passionate about neurodiversity advocacy, seeking flexibility and better work-life balance, or looking to add specialized experience to your existing practice, we offer roles to match your professional goals.

  • Grow professionally: Access regular peer consultation, specialized training, and monthly case conferences
  • Neurodiversity-affirming environment: Work alongside clinicians who share your commitment to neurodiversity-affirming approaches
  • Connect with a supportive clinical community: Join weekly drop-ins and engage in a tight-knit clinical community that prevent isolation

We offer two distinct position types to accommodate different career needs and scheduling preferences

Scheduling Availability

  • Set your own schedule, 7 days a week, between 7am and 10pm
  • No required evening, weekend or on-call hours
  • Build your schedule around your life, not the other way around

Full time (Benefits-Eligible)

jobs.description:
Position: OFF-THE-PLAN CONVEYANCING SPECIALIST

Salary range: Php 87,000/month (The final amount will be at the the client discretion basing on the candidate’s skills and experience.)

Working Hours: Following AU business hours

Work set-up: 100% Remote work under Independent Contractor Agreement

Holidays: TBD

Recruitment process: possible multiple client interviews and an assessment

About the Company & Role

Our client is an established Australian property services firm that supports clients through important residential and commercial property transactions, with a strong focus on providing accurate, practical, and client-focused conveyancing support. The team works closely with property purchasers and a range of professionals involved in property transactions, including developers, solicitors, brokers, and selling agents. We are looking for an experienced Off-the-Plan Conveyancing Specialist to join the team and provide specialist contract review and risk assessment support for Queensland property purchasers. The role is responsible for reviewing off-the-plan contracts and related developer documentation before signing, identifying potential legal, financial, and property-related risks, and presenting findings in clear and practical language. The successful candidate will combine strong Australian conveyancing knowledge with excellent attention to detail, contract interpretation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills to help clients make informed decisions before committing to a property purchase.

What You'll Do

  • Review residential and commercial off-the-plan property contracts before they are signed.
  • Review contracts alongside relevant supporting documentation, including:
    • Disclosure statements
    • Disclosure plans
    • Proposed survey plans
    • Specifications and finishes schedules
    • Proposed by-laws
    • Developer documentation
    • Other relevant property and contractual documents
  • Identify and assess key contractual, legal, financial, and property-related risks from the purchaser's perspective.
  • Review provisions relating to:
    • Sunset dates and termination rights
    • Developer termination provisions
    • Settlement and registration timeframes
    • Changes to lot size, area, boundaries, or layout
    • Material changes and potential material prejudice
    • Deposit requirements and trust arrangements
    • Finance and valuation risks
    • Body corporate and community-title arrangements
    • By-laws and management rights
    • Easements, encumbrances, covenants, and restrictions
    • Adjustment provisions
    • Default, rescission, and termination provisions
    • Developer-favourable special conditions
    • Assignment and resale restrictions
    • Construction delays and extension provisions
    • Defects and practical completion provisions
  • Assess whether contractual terms are consistent with the purchaser's intended use, financing arrangements, and investment objectives.
  • Prepare clear and structured contract review reports highlighting key risks, important considerations, and matters requiring client instructions.
  • Explain complex contractual and property matters in plain English to clients and stakeholders.
  • Provide recommendations on amendments, protections, clarifications, or other matters that should be addressed before signing.
  • Assist with negotiating special conditions and contractual amendments with the developer's solicitor where appropriate.
  • Review subsequent contract amendments, variations, and updated disclosure documentation throughout the development.
  • Liaise with purchasers, developers, developer solicitors, selling agents, brokers, financial advisers, and other relevant professionals.
  • Maintain accurate records of contract reviews, client instructions, negotiations, and amendments.
  • Provide a clear handover to the conveyancing team once the contract has been signed.
  • Support the broader conveyancing team with specialist contract and property-related matters as required.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in Australian conveyancing, property law, or property contract review.
  • Strong experience reviewing off-the-plan property contracts and associated documentation.
  • Solid understanding of Queensland property and conveyancing practices.
  • Strong ability to identify contractual risks and explain their potential impact on purchasers.
  • Experience interpreting complex contracts and identifying developer-favourable terms or special conditions.
  • Strong written English and the ability to prepare clear, professional, client-facing reports.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing multiple documents and identifying inconsistencies.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a wider conveyancing or legal team.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple contract reviews and deadlines.
  • High level of confidentiality and professionalism when handling client and transaction information.

Nice to Have

  • Legal, paralegal, conveyancing, property, or related qualification.
  • Previous experience working with an Australian conveyancing or law firm.
  • Direct experience with Queensland property transactions.
  • Experience handling off-the-plan residential or commercial purchases.
  • Experience reviewing developer contracts and disclosure documentation.
  • Experience negotiating special conditions or amendments with solicitors.
  • Familiarity with body corporate, community-title arrangements, easements, covenants, and other property encumbrances.
  • Experience communicating directly with Australian property purchasers.

Key Skills & Expertise

  • Australian Conveyancing
  • Queensland Property
  • Off-the-Plan Contracts
  • Property Contract Review
  • Contract Interpretation
  • Legal Risk Assessment
  • Property Law
  • Contract Negotiation
  • Client Advisory
  • Legal Research
  • Report Writing
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Attention to Detail

Director, Sales

Location: Remote (Midwest Region)

(Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, Missouri)

ABOUT ANET

Achievement Network (ANet) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping all students achieve strong educational outcomes. We partner with school and system leaders to strengthen teaching and learning through the strategic use of assessments, coaching, and tools that drive meaningful results. Individuals who join ANet become part of a dynamic, mission-driven, and collaborative organization focused on making a lasting impact in schools. We are committed to supporting one another and growing together as a team.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Reporting to the Managing Director, Sales, the Director, Sales will expand ANet’s impact across the Midwest Region by cultivating a strong, diverse community of school partners and education champions. In close collaboration with the Senior Vice President, Sales, you’ll drive ambitious growth goals by identifying and pursuing high-leverage opportunities through thoughtful research, strategic outreach, and a deep understanding of local instructional priorities and leadership dynamics.

You will exercise strong judgment and influence across the region by tailoring communication to diverse audiences, framing decisions, and guiding districts toward high-impact, equity-centered assessment practices.

Precision and discipline will be key: tracking outreach efforts, prioritizing prospects, and maintaining clean, actionable data to ensure no opportunity is missed. Ultimately, you’ll play a critical role in securing new partnerships that deepen ANet’s impact across the region.

TRAVEL

Travel is expected to be 50-75% depending on business needs, and will be primarily in the Midwest region. Some weekend travel and overnight stays expected for conferences.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Opportunity Identification & Lead Generation

  • Meet pre-set revenue targets through strategic planning, pipeline development, and partnership engagement within the designated region.
  • Research district and system priorities, leadership structures, and instructional needs to identify high-potential partnership opportunities, with a focus on mid-sized districts.
  • Build and manage a steady pipeline of qualified leads via outbound outreach, referrals, networking, and event follow-up.
  • Ensure timely response to all sales-qualified leads (SQLs), coordinating with relevant team members (e.g., Specialists, MDs).
  • Track regional market trends, competitor activity, and policy shifts to inform targeting and positioning strategies.
  • Use regional policy, instructional, and market data to identify implications for ANet’s strategy, elevating trends and risks that require organizational attention.

Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Building

  • Initiate and nurture relationships with senior district and charter network leaders, school-based decision-makers, and mid-level instructional leaders.
  • Secure and lead discovery conversations that uncover surface-level needs and deeper instructional challenges.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to prospective partners by tailoring solutions to their unique goals, constraints, and priorities.
  • Engage internal team members as needed to support cultivation and deepen trust.
  • Create inclusive engagement spaces that draw out district leaders’ diverse perspectives, enabling collaborative problem-solving and trust building.

Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Design and deliver customized, persuasive sales presentations and materials that communicate ANet’s offerings and differentiated value.
  • Recommend scope, pricing, and partnership structures using sound judgment, balancing impact, district context, and financial sustainability.
  • Create proposals that reflect partner needs and priorities, collaborating with delivery and finance teams to ensure aligned scope and pricing.
  • Navigate procurement processes and lead negotiations with professionalism and clarity around value, constraints, and timing.
  • Close well-scoped, high-quality deals that set the stage for long-term success and renewals.

Operational Discipline & Internal Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the Growth & Partnerships team and delivery teams to ensure alignment on targeting, messaging, and handoffs.
  • Identify systemic bottlenecks in outreach, pipeline progression, and handoffs, proposing solutions that strengthen cross-functional alignment.
  • Contribute to team learning by sharing insights, participating in professional development, and continuously improving sales practice.

COMPETENCIES

In order to be successful in this role, candidates must demonstrate the following:

  • Expertise in Area of Focus: 5+ years’ professional experience, including 3+ years owning a full sales cycle in a mission-driven or K–12 education-facing organization (preferably in California). Proven consultative selling success with public school systems or charter networks.
  • Critical Thinking & Data Orientation: Ability to prioritize high-value information, surface important trends, and make strategic, equity-centered recommendations; uses both qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions.
  • Planning & Prioritization: Plans and prioritizes complex regional work in a way that aligns with organizational strategy, anticipating barriers and coordinating with internal partners to ensure smooth execution.
  • Communication: Crafts persuasive, tailored presentations and proposals; communicates with clarity and empathy; actively listens to build trust.

Ideal candidates may also demonstrate the following preferred qualifications:

  • Technical proficiency with Salesforce and HubSpot
  • Prior experience serving in a K-12 edtech or educational publishing sales role
  • Prior experience as a teacher, instructional coach, and/or administrator
  • Critical Thinking & Data Orientation:

COMPENSATION

New hires will start between the range minimum and midpoint ($99,144 - $123,930) based on qualifications assessed during the hiring process, past experience, and internal equity. INCENTIVE COMPENSATION

Strategy & Marketing Leadership

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, funnel conversion, and campaign alignment
    • Coordinate with operations and product stakeholders to ensure marketing supports business priorities
    • Contribute to broader growth strategy discussions and go-to-market initiatives

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

    • Hands-on operator comfortable managing campaigns and optimizing performance directly

Role is remote but MUST be located in the UNITED STATES

preference for candidates who are local to the Atlanta, GA  area


Position Summary

The successful candidate will provide functional support for an Oracle E-Business Suite solution supporting mission-critical inventory, supply chain, asset management, financial, and warehouse operations. The position works closely with SNS business users, technical teams, developers, database administrators, integration specialists, and other stakeholders to translate operational requirements into effective Oracle EBS solutions.

The Oracle EBS Functional Analyst will support day-to-day operations as well as ongoing modernization and enhancement activities, including requirements analysis, business-process improvement, functional configuration, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, user support, and implementation of new or enhanced ERP capabilities.

The SNS mission depends on 24x7 availability of systems that support the nation’s emergency medical supply readiness and public health response. This position will participate in on-call services and must be able to acknowledge critical incidents within 15 minutes while on call.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support, configuration, analysis, and troubleshooting for Oracle EBS modules supporting SAMS.
  • Work with business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, business processes, issues, and enhancement needs.
  • Analyze existing business processes and recommend Oracle EBS configuration or functional solutions that improve efficiency, usability, data quality, and mission support.

  • Order Management
  • Inventory Management
  • Warehouse Management
  • Financials, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and General Ledger
  • Enterprise Asset Management
  • Advanced Supply Chain Planning
  • Planning Command Center
  • Transportation Management
  • Medical Equipment Maintenance

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with business users, technical staff, project leadership, and government/customer stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary Agile delivery environment.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Tier 2 background investigation/security eligibility and comply with HHS/ASPR/SNS security and training requirements.
  • Because SNS systems support the nation’s emergency medical supply readiness and public health response, this position is required to be on-call 24 hours/7 days a week. The employee must be able to respond to mission alerts within 15 minutes. The employee must carry a cell phone at all times while on call.
  • Ability to support occasional on-site activities at HHS facilities in the Atlanta, Georgia area and other authorized locations when required (for Atlanta based candidate).

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
About OHO

OHO is a digital agency full of smart, curious learners who love solving complex problems for higher education organizations. We partner with colleges and universities to navigate digital complexity so their marketing drives measurable impact for their brand and enrollment goals.

We bring deep expertise and a consultative mindset to everything we do—asking the right questions, challenging assumptions when needed, and always centering around our clients’ goals. In this role, you’ll be the subject-matter expert who frames the solution as part of the win-strategy for higher-ed web solutions engagements, helping prospective clients understand where they’re stuck and advising them on the right path forward, not just pitching a product.

We’re building toward a future where OHO is higher education’s most trusted advisory and implementation partner, and this role sits on the front lines of that journey—translating institutional challenges into smart, actionable web strategies.

About the Position

At its core, this role exists to win business: owning win-strategy, shaping the story OHO tells, engaging directly with clients, and leading pitches and proposals for Web Solutions deals.

The Principal Web Solutions Strategist sits on OHO’s Web Solutions Strategy team and plays a critical role at the intersection of business development, strategy, and delivery, in close partnership with the Director of Strategy. This role leads the strategic definition of Web Solutions deals, from early conversations with prospective clients through high-level involvement during delivery—ensuring that what OHO sells is thoughtful, viable, and aligned with how we deliver value.

In the sales process, the Principal Web Solutions Strategist crafts and communicates the vision and then defines the solution. You will own the majority of strategic airtime in client conversations:

  • Properly diagnosing client pain points and goals
  • Leading pitches and proposal strategy
  • Creating proposals and pitch materials, bringing in subject-matter experts and delivery leads when specialized input is needed or the opportunity requires a custom deliverable
  • Presenting audits and strategic recommendations
  • Clearly explaining OHO’s approach and the “how” behind our work

Proposal and pitch work is core to this role. It’s strategic work, not just production work. You’ll set the direction and narrative, developing customized proposals and pitch materials that communicate a persuasive, tailored solution that meets the client’s needs while effectively communicating the value OHO would bring to the engagement.

You’ll work closely with OHO’s Sales and Web Solutions teams, collecting collaborative input and feedback as you build the final proposal or pitch for delivery.

Through deep expertise in higher education websites and digital ecosystems, you’ll build trust quickly and confidently answer complex technical and strategic questions, partnering with OHO subject matter experts as needed.

After a project is won, you’ll stay engaged at key moments to ensure the project direction stays aligned with the vision established during the sales process. You’ll support a strong transition into delivery, participate in select milestones where your context is most valuable, and be available to help flag major strategic misalignments or risks so the team can address them early. This role provides continuity and confidence for the client at pivotal points while empowering the delivery team to lead day-to-day strategy and execution.

Beyond individual projects, you’ll help shape the evolution of OHO’s Web Solutions practice. You’ll gather market insights, identify buyer patterns, and partner with our Web Solutions leadership team to shape, inform and refine our offerings and how we talk about the value we bring to potential partners. i You’ll also contribute to OHO’s thought leadership so that OHO continues to be seen as a trusted strategic partner for higher education institutions.

Requirements

  • 7-10+ years of experience in digital strategy, web strategy, consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experience leading or owning delivery of digital projects in an agency and/or higher-education environment, with a solid understanding of how digital disciplines—UX, content strategy, design, and development—fit together and depend on one another. Higher-education experience is strongly preferred; candidates from other complex, highly regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, government, financial services) with comparable client and compliance dynamics are also encouraged to apply.
  • Deep expertise in content-intensive website strategy, including UX, content strategy, CMS platforms, accessibility, governance, SEO, and project delivery approaches.
  • Executive-level presence and strategic storytelling ability, with demonstrated comfort leading high-stakes pitches, setting vision, building trust with senior stakeholders, confidently owning the room, and influencing business development outcomes. This does not require a formal sales title or a traditional sales background.
  • Experience shaping, evolving, or stewarding service offerings or productized solutions.
  • Ability to balance pre-sale strategy leadership with high-level delivery involvement without becoming execution-focused.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and collaborating across sales, strategy, and delivery teams.
  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills, particularly around scope, approach, and strategic tradeoffs.
  • An intuitive problem-solver who can rapidly synthesize complex information, identify core problems, and pivot to strategic solutions with speed and precision.
  • Natural ability to rally teams, build momentum around a vision, and push deals or initiatives across the finish line.
  • Depth of technological understanding across diverse digital ecosystems, ensuring the ability to confidently advise on complex technical solutions and integrations.
  • Established or emerging thought leadership and external credibility—for example, conference speaking, published articles or perspective pieces, or a strong professional presence (e.g., LinkedIn) within the higher-ed or digital strategy community.

What Success Looks Like in 6–12 Months

Within 6–12 months, a successful Principal Web Solutions Strategist will:

  • Shape web opportunities so that by the time they’re late-stage, everyone is clear on the problem we’re solving, how success will be measured, and the recommended approach.
  • Develop and lead proposals and pitches that win, with measurable improvement in OHO's win rate on Web Solutions opportunities and wins increasingly driven by the strength of the strategy and story—not just price or scope.
  • Sell work that delivery teams describe as “right-sized and well framed,” with minimal need for major re-scoping once projects kick off.
  • Lead sales conversations that prospective clients and senior stakeholders regularly describe as advisory, clarifying, and confidence-building (for example, through direct feedback, NPS, or post-pitch debriefs).
  • Help evolve our Web Solutions offering by spotting patterns across deals and delivery and turning them into sharper packages, positioning, and case studies.
  • Become the person BDRs, BDMs, and Web Solutions Directors naturally pull into complex or ambiguous opportunities when they need help framing the problem and path forward.
  • Contribute to visible thought leadership in higher-ed web strategy (talks, webinars, articles, etc.) that we can point to as influencing new or stronger client relationships.

OHO Benefits

OHO offers a comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance package, along with company-paid life insurance as well as short/long-term disability coverage. Benefits also include a 401(k) match up to 4% of pay, paid vacation and sick time, ten holidays including a Flex Day, Summer Fridays, and more!

Each year, the team aims to come together in person for our Annual Summit at a beautiful destination, and throughout the year, leadership shares regular company updates and fosters an open-door culture. We also sprinkle in a healthy dose of fun with team events, friendly competitions, and other surprises that keep things fresh and connected.

Additional Information

Candidates should be comfortable traveling nationally 2-4 times a year for company and/or client meetings.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States in order to be considered. OHO is an e-Verify employer, ensuring compliance with federal employment eligibility requirements.

OHO is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse workforce, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Launch Your Career in Artificial Intelligence

We are seeking language professionals who are available and prepared to commit to this project for a minimum of six months. This is a long-term engagement that requires consistent attendance, dependable availability, and the ability to work the required schedule throughout the project.

Artificial Intelligence is transforming how the world communicates, learns, and solves problems—and skilled reviewers play an important role in improving the quality of these systems.

As an AI Evaluation & Annotation Reviewer, you will evaluate AI-generated content, identify linguistic and structural issues, annotate language data, and provide feedback that helps make AI responses more accurate, relevant, and reliable.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in linguistics, translation, localization, language education, research, writing, or quality assurance who are interested in gaining hands-on experience on a real-world AI project.

Why Join This Project?

  • Gain practical experience working on a global Artificial Intelligence project.
  • Build valuable skills in AI evaluation, annotation, prompt review, and language quality.
  • Work directly with QA Leads, international teams, and client stakeholders.
  • Strengthen your experience for future opportunities in AI, language technology, localization, research, and quality assurance.
  • Receive project-specific training, guidance, and ongoing feedback.

What You’ll Do

  • Review AI-generated responses for clarity, accuracy, correctness, relevance, and overall quality.
  • Annotate and label language content according to detailed project guidelines.
  • Generate or evaluate prompts based on assignment requirements.
  • Identify linguistic errors, dataset concerns, and structural inconsistencies.
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to support improvements in AI performance.
  • Communicate complex language requirements clearly to both linguistic and non-linguistic stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with QA Leads and clients to apply feedback and maintain quality standards.
  • Participate in required client-facing meetings with your camera on.
  • Submit daily work reports and consistently meet productivity and quality expectations.

What We’re Looking For

  • Professional fluency in French with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Linguistics, Languages, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • A degree or certification in French, where required.
  • Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • The ability to identify patterns, errors, inconsistencies, and subtle language issues.
  • Experience in annotation, evaluation, translation, localization, linguistics, research, education, or quality assurance is helpful but not required.
  • An interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, language technology, or data annotation.
  • The ability to learn new tools, follow detailed guidelines, and adapt to changing project requirements.
  • Strong organization and task-management skills.
  • Professional communication skills and confidence participating in client-facing meetings.
  • The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a global team.

Schedule and Commitment Requirements

Applicants must be able to meet all of the following requirements:

  • Commit to the project for a minimum of six months.
  • Maintain consistent availability throughout the engagement.
  • Work consecutive eight-hour shifts.
  • Remain available during the required core hours of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.
  • Attend daily client meetings scheduled between 10:00 AM–12:00 PM PST.
  • Consistently meet attendance, productivity, quality, and reporting expectations.

Only approved and properly logged hours will be compensated. This is an independent contractor engagement and does not include paid holidays or paid time off.

Compensation Range

Rates vary by language and are confirmed based on project requirements.

French - $15 to $18.00 USD per hour


Ready to Apply?

This opportunity is best suited for individuals who are genuinely interested in language and Artificial Intelligence and can provide the consistency required for a long-term global project.

Apply if you are ready to commit for at least six months, meet the required schedule, and contribute dependable, high-quality work throughout the engagement.


Location Restrictions

We are unable to accept applicants currently residing in:

Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Iran, Iraq, North Korea, Mexico, Panama, Russia, Sudan, Syria, Ukraine (Crimea, Luhansk, Donetsk), United Kingdom, Venezuela.

jobs.title: E3n - Vice President, Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Location, Reporting & TravelReports to the Chief Revenue Officer.
jobs.description:
Location, Reporting & Travel

Reports to the Chief Revenue Officer. This is a full-time, 100% remote role within the United States, with approximately 20-25% travel for team meetings, member and partner engagement, conferences, and E3n events.

About Us

E3n is a not-for-profit, member-based organization serving independent schools, educators, students, and families across the full student lifecycle.

Formed through the merger of the former Educational Records Bureau (ERB) and the Enrollment Management Association (EMA), E3n builds on nearly a century of collective expertise in assessment, enrollment, and student development. E3n exists to deepen school impact and advance whole-student growth by uniting academic and enrollment leadership around shared, data-driven insights.

E3n provides comprehensive assessments, tools, professional learning, data and insights that help independent schools demonstrate their value and support student success from pre-enrollment through graduation - extending beyond academic performance to include student well-being, sense of belonging, and social-emotional development.

About the Opportunity

E3n is seeking a strategic, hands-on marketing leader to help translate the organization's post-merger strategy into disciplined, integrated, and measurable execution. The Vice President, Marketing will bring process, pace, and performance to a wide range of marketing work across brand, communications, member lifecycle, product marketing, events, sales enablement, and marketing operations.

This role is ideal for a senior marketing professional who can move fluidly between strategy and execution - building campaign plans, improving systems, coaching a team, analyzing performance, and partnering across Sales, Product, and the Member Experience functions . The right leader will thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building structure, and care deeply about helping schools understand E3n's value across the full student lifecycle.

As an executive-level functional leader, the VP will be expected to make sound decisions, manage resources, influence across teams, and ensure marketing execution strengthens E3n's market presence, member engagement, and growth outcomes.

What You'll Do

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, the Vice President, Marketing will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:

Set Enterprise Market Strategy and Executive Alignment

  • Establish and execute a unified market strategy that clarifies E3n's value proposition, and positioning following the merger.
  • Define enterprise marketing priorities, success metrics, investment choices, and operating rhythms that align with E3n's strategic plan, growth goals, member outcomes, and organizational performance.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Sales, Product, Member Experience, and other teams so E3n presents one coherent market narrative and delivers against shared outcomes.
  • Represent E3n with external stakeholders, including independent school leaders, members, partners, sector influencers, and, as appropriate, Board-level audiences.

Execute Brand Integration, Messaging, and Marketing Communications

  • Implement E3n's post-merger brand integration across legacy organizations, ensuring consistent brand voice, messaging, visual identity, and tone across channels and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the rebranding of core assets, including web and digital content, member communications, sales materials, product collateral, conference/event materials, and internal templates.
  • Translate E3n's mission, capabilities, and portfolio into clear, audience-specific messaging for school leaders, members, prospects, educators, students, and families.
  • Elevate E3n's thought leadership and market visibility through coordinated content, campaigns, events, and communications that position E3n as a trusted resource for independent schools.

Drive Member Lifecycle Marketing: Engage, Retain, Grow

  • Use member segmentation to define target cohorts and develop a multi-channel strategy that increases engagement, retention, product and service usage/adoption, and expansion opportunities.
  • Develop and execute multi-channel marketing plans that showcase Professional Learning and increase engagement among priority audiences.
  • Create communication plans that educate members about upcoming product releases in enrollment, achievement, assessment, and related portfolio areas with compelling benefit statements for key cohorts.
  • Partner with Member Experience to identify moments in the member journey where marketing can improve onboarding, adoption, renewal readiness, and long-term value.

Partner with Sales and Revenue Teams to Support Growth

  • Partner with Sales to provide core messaging, competitive differentiation, competitor profiles, campaign assets, and sales enablement materials needed to achieve growth goals.
  • Translate revenue priorities into campaign briefs, audience strategies, content plans, calls to action, and channel recommendations.
  • Support member acquisition goals by ensuring marketing programs are aligned to pipeline needs, buyer personas, , competitive positioning , and membership value drivers.
  • Collaborate with the CRO and revenue-facing teams to establish practical reporting on campaign performance, lead quality, engagement, and marketing contribution to shared outcomes.

Lead Product Marketing, Portfolio Messaging, and Partnerships

  • Implement and integrate a voice-of-the-customer process that informs messaging, product positioning, launch planning, and customer-facing content.
  • Partner with Product and Member Experience teams to evaluate and refine the market positioning of core products and services.
  • Develop competitor messaging frameworks and product-level differentiation for E3n's portfolio.
  • Support adoption and scale for new products and releases, including Wild Zebra and new blended admissions assessment offerings.
  • Promote key partnerships, including Committee for Children, Wild Zebra, and Test Innovators, in ways that drive growth and member value around SEL curriculum, AI tools, and test practice.

Strengthen Marketing Operations, Team Management, and Budget Discipline

  • Develop, implement, and maintain marketing tools, processes, dashboards, and reporting routines that enable data-informed decisions and stronger campaign execution.
  • Define core KPIs and action plans for engagement, campaign performance, product usage, retention support, and marketing operational effectiveness.
  • Provide performance management, coaching, and development for the marketing team, including the current five FTEs and a newly onboarded marketing communications resource.
  • Model best practices for cross-functional engagement and ensure the marketing team operates with clarity, accountability, and strong service orientation to internal partners.
  • Develop and manage the marketing budget with appropriate financial controls, vendor oversight, and expense management.

Measures of Success

  • Marketing plans, calendars, campaigns, and event support are delivered on time, aligned to organizational priorities, and clearly connected to member and revenue outcomes.
  • Campaign performance improves through disciplined testing, segmentation, analytics, and optimization.
  • Sales, Member Experience, and Product teams receivepractical, timely marketing partnership and enablement.
  • Members and prospects experience a clearer, more consistent E3n brand and portfolio story across channels.
  • The marketing team operates with stronger systems, clearer priorities, better reporting, and consistent coaching.

Why Work with Us

At E3n, you will join a mission-driven organization formed through the unification of two respected leaders in independent education. We are building something new - bringing together enrollment and academic perspectives to create deeper insight, stronger institutions, and better outcomes for students from pre-enrollment through graduation.

At E3n, you will experience:

  • Purpose with impact. Our work directly supports educators, school leaders, and families nationwide. The decisions we make - and the tools we build - matter.
  • Smart, thoughtful colleagues. You will work alongside people who care deeply about education, ask good questions, and value collaboration, clarity, and integrity.
  • Whole-person thinking. Just as we help schools understand the full student journey, we strive to support employees as whole people - recognizing that strong work is sustained by balance, trust, and belonging.
  • Growth during a moment of transformation. E3n is actively evolving. That means opportunities to shape systems, influence direction, and grow alongside an organization defining its future.
  • Values-driven, data-informed. We balance heart and rigor - grounding our work in evidence while staying anchored in empathy, equity, and real-world impact.

If you are energized by meaningful work, thoughtful problem-solving, and helping schools better serve students, you will find a home at E3n.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant leadership responsibility for functions, teams, or major organizational initiatives.
  • Progressive marketing leadership experience across marketing communications, product marketing, lifecycle/customer or member marketing, growth marketing, campaign strategy, and marketing operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and execute integrated, multi-channel marketing plans across email, social, web, events, webinars, member portals, print assets, direct mail, and partner channels.
  • Record of supporting a sales function with a suite of enablement tools resulting in member acquisition, member retention, and product expansion resulting in top-line growth.
  • Fluency in B2B and B2C marketing strategies, including segmentation, buyer personas, market research, customer journeys, and audience-specific messaging.
  • Experience using CRM, marketing automation, campaign analytics, and performance reporting tools to guide decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Experience managing people, budgets, vendors, timelines, and cross-functional work in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

Preferred Skills & Experiences

  • Experience in EdTech, education services, assessment, and enrollment.
  • Knowledge of the private and independent school landscape and the needs of school leaders, educators, students, and families.
  • Experience in membership-based organizations, including retention, engagement, renewal, product usage, and expansion strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pardot, Marketing Cloud, or comparable marketing technology tools.
  • Experience marketing conferences, annual meetings, webinars, sponsored events, partner campaigns, or professional learning offerings.

E3n is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We believe our work is stronger when people of different backgrounds, identities, and experiences come together.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: To maintain a strong connection with our members and local communities and better understand their unique needs, we are currently considering applications from candidates residing in Oregon and Washington for all open positions.
jobs.description:
To maintain a strong connection with our members and local communities and better understand their unique needs, we are currently considering applications from candidates residing in Oregon and Washington for all open positions. We appreciate your understanding as we focus our hiring efforts in these specific regions. And, we encourage all qualified candidates from these states to apply, as we look forward to learning more about your unique skills and experience!

Job Overview:

Owns Peak’s member-growth strategy and its execution across the full member lifecycle: awareness, acquisition, activation, onboarding, retention, and referral. Sets the growth roadmap across digital and offline channels, leads the growth marketing team, and partners with the SVP of Marketing & Internal Communications, Product team, and IT to build funnels, launch products, and grow membership and share of wallet. This is a measurement-driven role where success is defined by movement on a small set of growth metrics, not activity.

Where You Will Work:

  • Remote role open to candidates residing in Washington (WA) or Oregon (OR). (Branches)
  • Travel is required.

When You Will Work:

  • This is an exempt position.
  • Standard business hours.

Pay Range:

  • The target annual pay range for this position is $184,536 - $209,700. The full annual pay range is $167,760 - $251,640.
  • Compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer of employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant.
  • Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Sets and executes the annual member-growth strategy across the full lifecycle, with quarterly priorities aligned to Peak’s goals.
  • Owns and allocates the growth marketing budget, optimizing spend against return.
  • Reports progress against growth targets to the SVP of Marketing & Internal Communications and leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Plans, launches, and optimizes integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social by platform, SEO, display/retargeting, email, streaming, direct mail.
  • Leads go-to-market for new products, features, rates, and offers, from positioning through channel execution.
  • Builds and runs lifecycle and trigger programs (onboarding, cross-sell, win-back) that deepens member relationships and grow share of wallet.
  • Defines, tracks, and reports the metrics that govern this role (e.g., net new members, CAC, cost per funded account, conversion rate, ROAS, share of wallet).
  • Owns a continuous testing roadmap across creative, audience, offer, and channel, and scale what wins.
  • Partners with the Marketing Analyst, Digital agency, and Business Intelligence to turn campaign and member data into decisions.
  • Operates and improves Peak’s marketing technology stack: HubSpot Marketing, PowerBI, Microsoft Copilot, Google Analytics, and additional analytics and advertising platforms.
  • Partners with IT and digital to maintain clean data flow, accurate attribution, and reliable campaign execution.
  • Ensures all marketing meets credit-union advertising and lending compliance requirements (for example UDAAP, Reg DD, Reg Z, and NCUA advertising rules).
  • Leads and develops a team of direct reports plus agency and contractor partners; sets goals, coaches, and builds a culture of experimentation and accountability.
  • Collaborates across product, retail/branch, digital, and IT to deliver programs on time.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's in Marketing, Business, Communications, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A minimum of ten (10) years of marketing experience with a progression of increasing responsibility, including a minimum of five (5) years in management or leadership role owning growth, demand, or digital marketing strategy. Deep understanding of digital marketing and data analysis, with direct B2C acquisition experience. Proven ability to reduce acquisition costs and improve return on spend.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a financial institution or other highly regulated environment preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Makes data-driven decisions and translates complex data into strategy.
  • Full-funnel growth expertise across acquisition, lifecycle, and retention.
  • Proficiency with marketing automation, CRM, and web analytics platforms.
  • Command of paid and organic channels and the metrics behind each (CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, LTV).
  • Budget management and the ability to calculate and improve ROI.
  • Strong project management; runs multiple programs simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of credit-union and lending compliance requirements.
  • Comfort with experimentation, testing design, and basic statistical reasoning.
  • Hands-on proficiency and certifications with HubSpot Marketing, Google Ads, and Google Analytics preferred.
  • Track record leading B2C digital acquisition at scale and managing creative or agency partners preferred.

Total Rewards:

This position is eligible for Full-Time Regular benefits. Employees and their eligible family members have access to a wide array of employee benefits, such as medical, dental, vision and life insurance coverage.

  • Includes an option for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance to be paid at a 100% by company for the employee only coverage.

  • Full-Time Regular hired employees also receive 11 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 1 floating holiday, 16 hours of self-care time, and 16 hours of volunteer time.

All benefits except 401k start the first of the month following date of hire. Employees become eligible to contribute to 401k on the first of the month following 60 days of employment.

This role exists to build and maintain the infrastructure, automation and deployment pipelines that keep our Laravel-based applications running smoothly, securely and at scale.

The DevOps Laravel Engineer will work within the IT function, part of Group Operations, partnering closely with our development team to bring strong DevOps practice to the applications that support DeterTech's customers and colleagues across the UK, Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden.
This role will take day-to-day operational ownership of our AWS cloud environment under the technical direction and architectural governance of the Lead Full Stack Developer. Working closely alongside the Lead Developer and existing infrastructure specialists, you will share and progressively take on full operational ownership of our cloud footprint—establishing robust auto-scaling, high-availability, and modern infrastructure-as-code practices. You will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure and application engineering—ensuring event queues, databases, and background workers scale effortlessly during real-time alarm surges, while embedding automated deployment pipelines that help our developers ship quality code safely, predictably, and with full architectural sign-off.

Key Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure and environments
• Build, maintain and continuously improve the cloud infrastructure that hosts DeterTech's Laravel applications, using infrastructure-as-code practices.
• Manage development, staging and production environments so releases are consistent, predictable and easy to roll back if needed.
• Own the configuration and performance of web servers, databases and caching layers supporting our applications.

• Architect, configure, and maintain our core AWS cloud footprint (specifically EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM, and VPC networking, alongside ECS/containers) in direct consultation with the Lead Developer, adhering to established system design standards, high availability, and disaster recovery requirements.

• Collaborate alongside existing infrastructure specialists to capture, map, and record infrastructure knowledge as operational ownership is progressively consolidated in-house, maintaining clear architecture diagrams and operational runbooks.

• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using technologies such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, ensuring all cloud infrastructure modifications are submitted via pull requests, version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and signed off prior to execution.

• Fine-tune and scale background queues and caching layers to guarantee low latency or monitoring lag during high-volume alarm spikes.

2. CI/CD and automation
• Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Laravel applications, automating testing, build and deployment.
• Reduce manual, repetitive work through automation, so the development team can ship changes quickly and safely.
• Support version control workflows and branching strategies that keep releases clean and traceable.
• Architect, configure, and maintain our core AWS cloud footprint (specifically EC2, ECS/containers, RDS, and Lambda) in direct consultation with the Lead Developer, adhering to established system design standards, high availability, and disaster recovery requirements.
• Maintain clear, documented architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and internal cloud governance in partnership with the Lead Developer.
• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using technologies such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, ensuring all cloud infrastructure modifications are submitted via pull requests, version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and signed off prior to execution.
• Fine-tune and scale background queues and caching layers to guarantee low latency or monitoring lag during high-volume alarm spikes.
3. Monitoring, reliability and security
• Implement monitoring, logging and alerting so issues are caught and resolved before they affect customers or colleagues.
• Own backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements for the applications you support.

• Participate as an escalation point for production incidents alongside our 24/7 out-of-hours support partner, following clear triage and communication processes.

• Deploy centralised observability and alerting systems (e.g. Grafana, or Sentry etc) to monitor API response times, queue depths, memory thresholds, and database connection pooling in real time, escalating critical anomalies to the Lead Developer.

• Enforce robust cloud security policies, least-privilege IAM roles, security groups, SSL/TLS certificates, and secure secrets management (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager or HashiCorp Vault), avoiding plain-text credentials in application code.

• Ensure infrastructure and release processes comply with ISO 27001, GDPR, and security alarm industry regulatory standards.

• Provide our external 24/7 out-of-hours support partner with up-to-date operational runbooks, health check procedures, and clear escalation workflows in agreement with the Lead Developer.

4. Collaboration and continuous improvement
• Work closely with the development team to embed DevOps thinking into how Laravel applications are designed, built and released.
• Share knowledge and document processes clearly, so the wider IT and development teams can work confidently with the systems you build.
• Keep up to date with developments in the Laravel and DevOps ecosystem, bringing new tools and approaches to the team where they add real value.

• Conduct cost-optimisation reviews across AWS services, presenting rightsizing and architectural recommendations to the Lead Developer and IT leadership for approval.

• Facilitate blameless post-incident reviews alongside the Lead Developer following infrastructure or deployment issues to prevent recurring outages.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise


• Proven experience in a DevOps or infrastructure engineering role supporting PHP/Laravel applications in production.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (for example GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) and infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform or Ansible).

• Strong Linux administration skills and experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).

• Practical knowledge of containerisation (Docker) and, ideally, orchestration (Kubernetes or similar).

• Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and caching technologies (Redis).

• A security-conscious mindset, comfortable applying best practice around access control, secrets management and vulnerability management.

• Clear communicator, comfortable working closely with developers and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

• Commercial background configuring and managing production AWS cloud environments, specifically focused on EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM, and VPC (or comparable cloud equivalents).

• Practical understanding of Laravel internals from an infrastructure perspective (Artisan commands, queue workers, job processing, caching strategies, and Laravel Horizon).

• Comfortable collaborating alongside external or partner technical specialists to share operational coverage and progressively absorb platform ownership.

• Strong technical documentation skills, able to record, map, and consolidate infrastructure architecture and operational runbooks as knowledge transitions in-house.

• Demonstrated experience implementing Terraform or CloudFormation to manage infrastructure-as-code in a multi-environment setting (Dev, Staging, Production).

• Hands-on experience securing cloud workloads, applying principle of least privilege, secrets management, and network access controls.

• Comfortable collaborating under the technical governance of a Lead Developer, actively seeking code and architectural reviews for infrastructure changes.

Desirable
• Familiarity with Laravel-specific tooling
• Experience working in a regulated or security-focused industry.
• Exposure to observability tooling (for example Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic or Datadog).
• Experience supporting applications used across multiple countries or time zones.

• AWS Certifications (e.g. AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Solutions Architect, or DevOps Engineer).

• Familiarity with containerised deployments using Docker and AWS ECS.

• Experience handling high-throughput, real-time message queues or streaming architectures (such as SQS, RabbitMQ, or MQTT for IoT devices).

• Experience collaborating with an external 24/7 managed service or out-of-hours monitoring partner.

About the Role

Our client in the Data Center Construction Field designs, installs, and commissions telecommunications and low-voltage infrastructure for enterprise, data center, healthcare, education, and public-sector clients across the United States. We are hiring a Senior Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of those projects.

This is a fully remote, full-time, W-2 position. You run your projects from a home office anywhere in the continental U.S. and travel roughly 30% of the time to job sites nationwide — site surveys and existing-conditions audits before the work starts, quality and safety walks while it is running, and punch-list resolution and final client sign-off at the end.

You are accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and the client relationship from award through closeout. You will direct field supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors you do not see every day.

What You Will Do

  • Own project delivery end to end: validate the estimate at handoff, build the schedule and execution plan, and drive it to closeout on time and on margin.
  • Travel to job sites nationwide (approx. 30%) for pre-construction surveys, existing-conditions audits, in-progress quality and safety walks, punch-list walks, and final customer sign-off.
  • Direct field supervisors, lead technicians, and subcontractor foremen on manpower loading, sequencing, and daily reporting — remotely most weeks, on site when it counts.
  • Own project financials: labor against earned value, material and subcontractor spend, change order origination and negotiation, progress billing, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Serve as the single point of accountability for the client, with a consistent cadence of written status reports, risk logs, and look-ahead schedules.
  • Enforce compliance with ANSI/TIA-568, 569, 606, and 607, BICSI installation methods, NEC, and NFPA 70/72, along with the company and site-specific safety programs.
  • Oversee testing and certification — copper channel and permanent link, OTDR and optical loss, system commissioning — and review results before they go to the client.
  • Assemble and deliver complete closeout packages: as-builts, test results, warranty registrations, O&M manuals, labeling schedules, and final acceptance documentation.
  • Qualify and manage subcontractors on multi-site and out-of-region deployments, holding them to the same quality, safety, and documentation standard as internal crews.
  • Mentor project coordinators and assistant project managers, and help standardize delivery practice across the team.

What You Need

  • Seven (7) or more years of progressively responsible project management experience delivering telecommunications, structured cabling, fiber optic, or low voltage systems projects, with full ownership of scope, schedule, and budget.
  • A track record on significant-value projects and/or concurrent multi-site programs, including work delivered outside your home region.
  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, project management, telecommunications, engineering technology, business, or a related field — or an equivalent combination of education, certification, military service, and directly relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Working command of structured cabling and fiber optic systems, including installation methods, termination, testing, certification, and the applicable ANSI/TIA, BICSI, and NEC standards.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction documents — architectural, electrical, and telecommunications drawings, riser diagrams, specifications, submittals, and RFIs.
  • Experience owning project financials, including change order negotiation and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Proficiency with project scheduling and collaboration platforms (MS Project, Smartsheet, Primavera P6, Procore, or equivalent) and strong spreadsheet skills.
  • Demonstrated success managing projects and field teams remotely, with a dedicated home workspace and reliable high-speed internet.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30% nationally, including overnight stays, and to access active construction sites.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States on a W-2 basis without current or future employer sponsorship.
  • Valid driver's license and an acceptable motor vehicle record.

Nice to Have

  • BICSI RTPM or RCDD certification; PMP or CAPM certification; OSHA 30-Hour Construction.
  • Manufacturer certifications (CommScope, Panduit, Corning, Belden, Leviton) and fiber test platform experience (Fluke Networks, VIAVI, EXFO, AFL).
  • Mission-critical environment experience: data centers, colocation, hyperscale build-outs, or hospital and healthcare campuses.
  • Experience with DAS/ERRCS, Wi-Fi infrastructure, access control and IP video, AV, fire alarm, nurse call, or building automation scopes.
  • Government, federal, E-Rate, or prevailing-wage and certified-payroll project experience.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish.

Travel and Working Conditions

Travel averages approximately 30% of working time — typically two to six days per month, occasionally more during mobilization, cutover, or closeout. Travel is scheduled in advance around project milestones and is not on-call; overnight stays are typical, and occasional Sunday departures or Saturday returns may be required to meet Monday-morning mobilization or weekend cutover windows. All business travel expenses are paid by the company under the corporate travel and expense policy.

Home-office work involves prolonged sitting and computer use with frequent video conferencing. Job-site work involves standing and walking on active construction sites and uneven surfaces, climbing stairs and ladders, bending, stooping, kneeling and reaching, occasional lifting up to 40 pounds, work at heights and in confined spaces such as ceilings and telecom rooms, and wearing required PPE. Sites may involve noise, dust, temperature variation, and moving equipment. Some client sites require additional badging, security clearance, safety orientation, or health screening. As a Scrum Master, you love contributing to the in-depth growth of development teams brought together for our clients. What are you going to do?

You will be part of a young and growing organization that aims to develop the best cross-platform mobile apps out there. As a Scrum Master, you’ll be responsible for creating a team spirit within a group of developers. You’ll act as a link between our developers, clients and third parties and keep the focus on the end goal. In addition, you’ll ensure that you will keep an open attitude but remain critical to make sure requirements are met for the customer while keeping everyone informed on project progress, status, schedule, deadlines, and releases.

You’ll be transparent and open about the choices made and to be made. You’ll know the ins and outs of the market and translate this into user stories. You’ll also be realistic and pragmatic and willing to cooperate.

For this position, we are looking for someone who has very strong communication skills, experience with a role as a Scrum Master in an Agile work environment and an interest in the world of app development.
