Position: Digital Marketing Specialist / Shopify Specialist

Salary: $1,800 - $2,500 AUD a month maximum
Working Hours & Conditions: Australian Hours
Holidays: Australian Public Holidays

About the Company

The company is a lifestyle and retail business offering a carefully curated collection of fashion, beauty, homewares, accessories, children’s products, and lifestyle goods from brands selected for their quality, purpose, sustainability, and thoughtful design.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist / Shopify Specialist to take ownership of company's online store and help drive stronger e-commerce performance.

The primary focus of this role is Shopify and conversion rate optimization — improving the website experience, merchandising, product presentation, SEO, and customer journey to turn more existing website traffic into customers.

Alongside Shopify, the successful candidate will support SEO, Klaviyo/email marketing, marketing automation, social media, graphic design, and digital advertising. As website conversion performance improves, paid advertising across platforms such as Meta and Google can become a greater focus for driving scalable online growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful e-commerce marketing is not simply about generating traffic. You should be comfortable analyzing the complete customer journey, identifying where customers are dropping off, and implementing practical improvements that increase conversion, engagement, repeat purchases, and online revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Shopify & E-Commerce Management (Primary Focus)

  • Take day-to-day ownership of the Shopify website
  • Maintain and optimize product pages, collections, navigation, menus, and site content
  • Ensure product information, imagery, descriptions, pricing, and promotional content are accurate and well presented
  • Improve product merchandising and collection structure to make products easier to discover
  • Review the customer journey from landing page through to checkout
  • Identify website issues that may be limiting conversion
  • Implement improvements to usability, navigation, product discovery, and overall shopping experience
  • Coordinate website promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and sales
  • Ensure the online store remains current, visually consistent, and aligned with the brand
  • Monitor website performance and recommend ongoing improvements

Conversion Rate Optimisation

  • Analyse website behaviour and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates
  • Review key landing pages, product pages, collection pages, and checkout journeys
  • Identify points of friction or customer drop-off
  • Recommend and implement practical CRO improvements
  • Test improvements to page layouts, calls-to-action, messaging, offers, and merchandising
  • Improve mobile shopping experience and website usability
  • Monitor conversion performance and report on improvements over time
  • Use data rather than assumptions to guide website changes

SEO & Organic Website Growth

  • Improve on-page SEO across the Shopify website
  • Optimise product and collection titles, descriptions, metadata, headings, and URLs
  • Conduct keyword research relevant to company’s products and customers
  • Identify opportunities to improve organic visibility for important product categories
  • Optimise new and existing website content for search
  • Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and website performance
  • Identify and resolve basic technical SEO issues where possible
  • Ensure SEO best practices are incorporated into ongoing Shopify management

Klaviyo, Email Marketing & Automation

  • Manage and optimise Klaviyo email marketing activity
  • Build and improve automated customer flows
  • Develop campaigns supporting product launches, promotions, seasonal activity, and customer retention
  • Improve key automations such as welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, and re-engagement flows
  • Segment audiences to improve email relevance and performance
  • Create and test subject lines, messaging, offers, and creative
  • Monitor open rates, click-through rates, conversions, and email-attributed revenue
  • Identify opportunities to use automation to improve customer retention and repeat purchases

Social Media & Content

  • Support company’s organic social media presence
  • Plan and maintain a consistent social content calendar
  • Create content promoting products, brands, campaigns, and the company story
  • Coordinate social activity with website promotions and email campaigns
  • Maintain consistent brand presentation across digital channels
  • Monitor engagement and identify content opportunities based on audience response

Graphic Design & Ad Creative

  • Create high-quality digital assets for the website, social media, email campaigns, and paid advertising
  • Develop promotional banners, campaign graphics, product-focused creative, and social content
  • Adapt existing brand assets into multiple digital formats
  • Create compelling ad creative designed to drive engagement and conversion
  • Maintain visual consistency with the brand
  • Work efficiently across multiple creative requirements and campaign deadlines

Paid Digital Advertising

As website conversion improves, the role will progressively support greater investment into paid acquisition.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Manage and optimise Meta and Google advertising campaigns
  • Develop campaigns around key products, categories, promotions, and seasonal opportunities
  • Coordinate ad creative, copy, audiences, and landing pages
  • Monitor spend, traffic, conversion, and return on advertising investment
  • Test audiences, creative, messaging, and offers
  • Ensure paid traffic is directed to relevant, conversion-focused landing pages
  • Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns based on performance
  • Provide clear recommendations around budget allocation and campaign priorities

Reporting & Digital Performance

  • Monitor key e-commerce and marketing performance metrics
  • Track website traffic, conversion rate, average order value, customer behavior, and online revenue
  • Monitor SEO, email, social, and paid media performance
  • Identify trends, issues, and growth opportunities
  • Provide clear reporting and practical recommendations
  • Use performance data to priorities the digital activities most likely to improve commercial outcomes

Tools & Systems

  • Shopify – strong hands-on experience essential
  • Klaviyo – highly preferred
  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Search Console
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar graphic design tools
  • SEO and keyword research tools
  • Email marketing and automation platforms
  • Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets
  • Social media scheduling and management platforms

Requirements

Key Requirements

  • Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong Shopify/e-commerce focus
  • Strong hands-on experience managing and optimizing Shopify websites
  • Demonstrated understanding of conversion rate optimization and e-commerce customer journeys
  • Experience with SEO and on-page website optimization
  • Experience with email marketing and marketing automation
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals across organic and paid channels
  • Graphic design capability and ability to produce quality digital marketing assets
  • Experience supporting or managing social media marketing
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to use data to identify opportunities
  • Good understanding of e-commerce metrics including conversion rate, traffic, average order value, customer acquisition, and revenue
  • Excellent written English and attention to detail
  • Strong organization and ability to manage multiple digital priorities
  • Proactive approach with the ability to independently identify and implement improvements

Highly Desirable

  • Strong previous experience working with Shopify-based retail or e-commerce brands
  • Previous experience with Klaviyo
  • Proven experience improving website conversion rates
  • Experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads
  • Experience with fashion, lifestyle, beauty, homewares, or consumer retail brands
  • Strong graphic design and ad creative portfolio
  • Experience with customer segmentation and lifecycle marketing
  • Understanding of Australian e-commerce and consumer behaviour
  • Experience working with an Australian retail business
  • Ability to combine creative marketing skills with strong commercial and analytical thinking

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreEvery organization runs on intelligence: years of accumulated knowledge, decisions, and context.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Every organization runs on intelligence: years of accumulated knowledge, decisions, and context. As AI takes on more of that work, companies face a choice: rent that intelligence from vendors who keep the data, the context, and the results, or own it.

OpenTeams exists to make ownership possible.

Founded by Travis Oliphant, creator of NumPy and SciPy, and built by people with deep roots across the open-source ecosystem, including NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, and Jupyter, we help enterprises and governments build AI they control, govern, and evolve themselves.

If that sounds like your kind of work, we'd like to meet you.

Full-Stack Platform Engineer x2

Location: U.S - Remote OR Hybrid - Washington, DC, Denver, CO or Colorado Springs, CO.

Work Authorization: U.S. citizenship required

Clearance:U.S.-Remote Opening: An active clearance is not required. Candidates must be eligible and willing to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Hybrid Opening: An active TS/SCI clearance is preferred. Candidates may also be considered if they previously held a TS/SCI with CI polygraph or currently hold an active TS or Secret clearance.

Salary Range: $145,000–$250,000 USD, dependent on experience level and location

Openings: Two positions are available:

  • One hybrid position: Candidates must be located in or willing to work hybrid from Washington, DC; Denver, CO; or Colorado Springs, CO. An active TS/SCI clearance is required. Up to 15% travel is required.
  • One U.S.-remote position: Candidates may work remotely from anywhere in the United States. An active clearance is not required, but candidates must be willing and able to undergo the process required to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Candidates will be considered for the opening that best aligns with their location, clearance status, experience, and work preferences. Candidates who meet the requirements for multiple openings may be considered for more than one.

About the Role

We're looking for a Full-Stack Platform Engineer to build both sides of an AI platform — the API surface other teams build on, and the interfaces analysts use directly.

The API comes first here, and that's a real constraint rather than a slogan: platform capabilities are consumed through documented interfaces by analysts, internal teams, and partner organizations using their own tools. If those interfaces are unstable or hard to reason about, adoption stalls regardless of what the platform can do underneath.

On the backend, you build API-first services for workflow orchestration, data ingestion, evaluation execution, and results management, and you implement identity federation and access controls that hold up across deployment environments. On the frontend, you build the analyst-facing tooling — modern web consoles and utilities where someone actually kicks off a workflow, inspects a result, or figures out why a run failed. You should be comfortable in a component-based web stack, though the emphasis is on clear, functional interfaces over visual polish. Doing both sides means you feel your own API design decisions from the consuming side, which is the fastest way to find the ones that were wrong.

You also produce what external teams need to build on the platform: documentation, reference implementations, and client examples that work when someone follows them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, document, and maintain APIs for workflow orchestration, data ingestion, evaluation execution, and results management
  • Define clear, stable, and versioned interface specifications for use by external integrators
  • Implement brokered single sign-on and identity federation using protocols such as OpenID Connect, SAML, and PKI/X.509 certificate-based authentication
  • Enforce approved authentication, authorization, and access-control requirements across platform services
  • Design relational data models that support platform APIs and workflow requirements
  • Build the analyst-facing web interfaces for the platform — consoles for launching workflows, inspecting results, and diagnosing failed runs
  • Develop UI for AI-specific interaction patterns: streaming model output, long-running and multi-step agentic runs, prompt and configuration management, and side-by-side comparison of model or workflow results
  • Ensure analyst-facing interfaces are built strictly on the same public APIs external integrators use, keeping the platform genuinely headless rather than headless in name
  • Produce and maintain API documentation, integration guides, SDK examples, reference implementations, and example workflows
  • Develop notebooks and other enablement resources for data science and analyst audiences
  • Support partner organizations and Government teams integrating with published platform interfaces
  • Write automated tests and maintain CI pipelines across backend and frontend code
  • Ensure application dependencies are compatible with target deployment environments
  • Collaborate with platform, security, infrastructure, and ML engineers to deliver reliable, secure, and interoperable platform services

Required Skills & Experience

  • U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance
  • 5+ years of full-stack or backend engineering experience, with an emphasis on API-first services
  • Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, Go, or a comparable programming language
  • Experience designing, documenting, versioning, and maintaining REST or GraphQL APIs used by external teams or integrators
  • Working proficiency with a modern component-based frontend framework such as React, Vue, or Svelte, and the ability to build clean, functional interfaces without dedicated design support
  • Familiarity with the patterns AI interfaces depend on — streaming responses, asynchronous job status, and interfaces that stay usable while an operation is still running
  • Hands-on experience implementing authentication and authorization using OpenID Connect, SAML, PKI/X.509 certificates, or comparable identity protocols
  • Experience developing containerized applications and services
  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, automated testing, and continuous integration
  • Demonstrated ability to write developer-facing API documentation, integration guides, and reference implementations
  • Experience with relational databases and API-level data modeling
  • Ability to translate technical requirements and user feedback into clear, maintainable interface specifications
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to support technical users integrating with platform services
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience building headless platforms, developer platforms, or public API products
  • Experience building user interfaces on top of LLMs, agents, or other AI/ML services
  • Experience developing human-in-the-loop review, scoring, annotation, or adjudication tooling
  • Familiarity with Government identity and access-management standards, including CAC/PIV authentication
  • Experience developing Jupyter notebooks, SDK examples, or technical enablement materials for analyst and data science audiences
  • Experience delivering software for Government, defense, or another regulated industry
  • Experience integrating AI/ML services, model gateways, or evaluation tools through documented API contracts
  • Familiarity with access-control models such as role-based or attribute-based access control
  • Familiarity with design systems or component libraries
  • Active or previously held U.S. security clearance

Grow With Us

At OpenTeams, growth isn’t just about the company—it’s about you.

We believe the best careers are built at the edge of your potential. That is where new tools, ideas, and technologies change the world. Here, you’ll work alongside pioneers of AI, solving problems that matter: making AI more transparent, more ethical, and more empowering. As your skills grow, our career framework provides a pathway and recognition of that increased impact.

Opportunities aren’t limited by geography. You’ll collaborate with global experts, contribute to open source projects that power the world’s technology, and stretch your skills daily. That global perspective and diversity makes our solution more universal and robust. We are committed to continuing to celebrate diversity on our team.

Supported people are successful people. We offer 100% employer paid medical premiums for employees and self-managed PTO with a minimum time off requirement, so that our teams are able to do their best work.

We invest in curiosity, creativity, and ownership. That means you’ll be trusted to boldly innovate, supported to learn fast, and celebrated for successful collaboration.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

OpenTeams understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge is crucial to and enriches the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, disabled people, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer - all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for recruitment, interviews, employment, training, compensation, promotion, and related activities. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. We are a gritty group of passionate technologists on a mission to dominate the mortgage world!

The Information Technology Team within Rate passionately and consistently puts our customers first. We build high-performing, self-organized, cross-functional agile teams that operate with minimal hierarchy. Information Technology team members hold themselves and others accountable and live and breathe the tenets of autonomy, mastery, and purpose.


What's the Role?

The Senior Technology Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Analyst plays a critical role in maturing Rate's Technology GRC program by pairing governance, risk and compliance expertise with a forward-leaning approach to automation and AI. This person runs our GRC processes while actively building and maintaining AI-driven tools and agents that increase the speed, consistency, and scale of the GRC function. The analyst partners across Tech (Security, IT and Product) to manage highly cross-functional risk initiatives, and is expected to operate with minimal direction, move fluidly across governance, risk, and compliance workstreams, and deliver accurate work across a fast-moving workload.


Responsibilities

GRC Technology & Automation

  • Identify high-volume, repeatable GRC tasks (evidence collection, control testing, risk scoring, reporting) and build and deploy AI agents or automation workflows to improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Maintain, monitor, and iterate on existing AI tools/agents supporting GRC processes, ensuring outputs remain accurate and audit-ready.
  • Support the implementation of Rate's GRC platform and provide ongoing platform administration.
  • Build and maintain workflows within the GRC platform and propose process updates to improve efficiency and usability.
  • Stay current on AI and automation trends relevant to GRC and proactively recommend new use cases.

Risk Management

  • Plan and execute risk control self-assessments (RCSAs) across Technology domains.
  • Evaluate risk evidence and control documentation for completeness, accuracy, and sufficiency.
  • Maintain and continuously improve the technology risk register, ensuring risks are logged, scored, tracked, and remediated to schedules.
  • Support risk tolerance and risk appetite adjustments as directed by leadership, updating supporting documentation and communicating changes to stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance to Tech teams (Security, Product, and IT) on risk remediation planning and prioritization.

Compliance & Controls Management

  • Create, update, and maintain Technology policies and standards.
  • Support the ongoing management of IT General Controls (ITGCs) and other relevant control requirements.
  • Support internal and external Technology audit processes, including evidence gathering, walkthroughs, and issue remediation tracking.
  • Support ongoing alignment with applicable frameworks and regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST, SOC 2).

GRC Metrics & Data Analysis

  • Build, maintain, and interpret data sets that feed Technology GRC metrics, KPIs, and KRIs.
  • Translate raw Technology risk and compliance data into clear, actionable reporting for stakeholders and leadership.
  • Continuously refine metrics and dashboards to reflect evolving program priorities and risk tolerance.
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy across GRC platforms and reporting tools.

Cross-Team Program & Project Management

  • Lead and coordinate cross-team Tech risk and compliance initiatives involving Technology, Security, and Product.
  • Manage competing priorities and timelines across multiple concurrent GRC workstreams with minimal oversight.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for stakeholders on assigned Tech risk, compliance, and audit initiatives.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and roadblocks clearly and proactively to leadership.

Qualifications

  • Ability to deliver precise, high-quality work across a high-volume, fast-moving workload.

Job Title: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator

Job Location: Washington, District Of Columbia, United States of America

MCRA is part of IQVIA MedTech. As a trusted CRO and advisory partner, IQVIA MedTech and MCRA deliver integrated lifecycle solutions for the medical device and diagnostics industry. Together, we support innovation from concept to commercialization, offering expertise in regulatory strategy, clinical trial design and execution, market access, and post-market optimization. Our teams combine deep therapeutic knowledge with advanced data and technology to help clients make smarter decisions and thrive in the market. Join our team to help shape the future of MedTech.

Overview


The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting the execution of clinical research studies by coordinating and performing remote clinical activities in compliance with study protocols, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Good Clinical Practice (GCP). This role is responsible for performing a variety of clinical procedures to collect, record, report, and interpret patient data for individuals enrolled in or seeking enrollment in clinical studies.

  • Adhere to SOPs and Manual of Procedures when conducting all study-related activities to ensure compliance and consistency. This includes maintaining a working knowledge of study-specific software applications and equipment.
  • Collaborate with the research team and study sites to identify, recruit, and virtually enroll eligible patients for clinical trials.
  • Collect, maintain, and securely store all relevant data associated with clinical research trials in accordance with regulatory and organizational standards.
  • Educate potential participants about clinical research trials, including study requirements, and manage the informed consent process through virtual interactions.
  • Assist with participant study compliance by providing guidance and reminders to ensure adherence to protocol requirements.
  • Conduct follow-up activities for clinical trials while maintaining adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
  • Ensure patient safety by monitoring participants, reporting adverse events promptly, and ensuring compliance with IRB-approved protocols.
  • Support the research participant call center as assigned, handling inquiries and providing assistance.
  • Maintain professionalism in all interactions with research participants to foster trust and engagement.
  • Assist with study equipment management and reporting, ensuring proper tracking, functionality, and documentation.
  • Communicate effectively with MCRA clinical affairs staff and clients, providing updates and support under the guidance of senior MCRA staff as needed.
  • Perform additional duties and projects as assigned to support the success of clinical research operations.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required (preferably in a life sciences or healthcare-related field)
  • Experience: Minimum of three years of experience as a Clinical Coordinator or in a comparable clinical research role
  • Strong attention to detail

Prison Break. Breakout. Fixer Upper. This Old House.

So, not only do you get to help dogs and cats, but you also get to help the staff who try so hard and care so much by giving them support to improve their shelter, make their jobs more rewarding, and to save more animals.


Shelter Engagement Specialists are on the front line of lifesaving. They play a direct role in achieving Best Friends Animal Society’s no-kill mission by selecting and pulling animals from priority shelters, and then helping priority shelter partners make enhancements to their shelter as well as develop or enhance lifesaving programming.


We’re seeking someone who has experience working in animal shelters, is savvy with dogs, cats, and PEOPLE, loves problem solving, and is not afraid to get covered in fur to bring about the future of animal sheltering. Does this sound like a dream job to you? If so, apply today for the Shelter Engagement Specialist role and make that dream a reality!

Each team member is responsible for creating an inclusive environment where all voices are respected and contributing to a workplace that embodies our shared values and commitment to progress. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Compliance Lead who will be responsible for operationalizing our compliance programs and championing a culture of integrity at Geotab. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Compliance Lead your key area of responsibility will be driving adherence to our policies, procedures, and evolving global regulatory requirements by designing and executing right-sized compliance initiatives. You will need to work closely with Legal, Finance, Technology, HR, IT, Operations, and Senior Management.

To be successful in this role you will be a high-performance, tech-forward individual with strong agility, integrity, communication, and leadership skills. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong risk and control orientation, strategic thinking, analytical capability, and a focus on continuous improvement.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive, risk-based ethics and compliance strategy—proactively identifying gaps, recommending solutions, and aligning programs to global business goals without waiting to be directed.
  • Lead and manage thorough, impartial investigations into allegations of non-compliance, unethical conduct, or violations of our Code of Conduct and other policies—leveraging AI tools to enhance efficiency, pattern detection, and investigative rigor, and delivering clear findings to leadership.
  • Take full ownership of drafting, reviewing, and continuously improving key ethics and compliance policies and procedures—including our Code of Conduct, Anti-Corruption & Anti-Bribery, Third-Party Risk Management, Sanctions, Conflicts of Interest, and Whistleblower policies—anticipating regulatory changes and proactively recommending updates before issues arise.
  • Design and own compliance risk assessment programs—identifying vulnerabilities before they become issues, leveraging AI-powered analytics to surface patterns and gaps, and bringing forward data-driven, actionable solutions rather than escalating problems.
  • Serve as a proactive thought partner and subject matter expert for the compliance team and business partners on ABAC, third-party risk, business continuity, records retention, and sanctions—consistently bringing well-reasoned recommendations and solutions to the table rather than surfacing problems without a path forward.
  • Drive cross-functional compliance integration by independently initiating partnerships with Legal, Finance, Technology, HR, IT, Operations, and Senior Management—embedding compliance into business processes and building AI-powered tools and self-service resources that reduce friction and manual effort across the organization.
  • Stay abreast of evolving laws, regulations, industry standards, and best practices relevant to ethics and compliance in the technology sector. Drive automation and AI utilization across compliance workflows, building scalable tools, automated systems, and self-service knowledge repositories that enable other departments to handle routine compliance matters independently—reducing reliance on manual administrative support and empowering the organization to self-serve.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 5 - 8 years of required experience in developing and managing ethics and compliance programs, conducting internal investigations, and leading complex cross-functional compliance initiatives.
  • Technology Adoption & Automation: Rapidly learns, adopts, and deploys new technologies, SaaS platforms, and AI tools. Comfortable building workflow automations to eliminate repetitive administrative tasks and drive self-service adoption to scale compliance operations.

  • Agility & Multi-Tasking: Ability to juggle competing priorities, context-switch smoothly in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple complex projects simultaneously while maintaining high attention to detail.

  • Risk & Control Orientation: Strong ability to identify, evaluate and mitigate compliance risks across processes. Demonstrates proactive approach to maintaining effective control environments.

  • Integrity & Ethical Conduct: Upholds the highest ethical standards and promotes a culture of honesty and transparency. Acts as a trusted advisor and role model for ethical decision-making.

  • Strategic Thinking & Decision-Making: Balances regulatory requirements with business objectives. Anticipates compliance challenges and recommends forward-looking strategies.

  • Communication & Influence: Effectively communicates compliance expectations to all levels of the organization. Influences stakeholders and drives behavioral change without direct authority.

  • Leadership & Collaboration: Leads cross-functional initiatives, guiding teams to embed compliance into business operations. Builds strong relationships with internal stakeholders.

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Capability: Uses data and evidence-based approaches to identify issues and develop solutions. Demonstrates sound judgment in handling sensitive or complex compliance matters.

  • Continuous Improvement & Learning: Stays updated on evolving regulatory landscapes and industry best practices. Continuously seeks to enhance compliance processes, tools and training programs.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field with a focus on ethics and compliance programs (Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree required). Professional Certification in CCEP is preferred.

jobs.description:
Engineering Manager

Remote, US

About Nametag
Nametag is building the future of secure digital identity. Our mission is to make it easy for people and organizations to prove who they are online, safely and seamlessly. We're pioneering next-generation identity verification and account protection so that users can control their own identity, and companies can build trust without friction. By enabling trust at scale, we help enterprises reduce fraud, streamline onboarding, and deliver secure user experiences that customers love.

The Role

We're looking for an engineering leader to own how Nametag's engineering team works — how it plans, ships, operates, and grows.

This is a player-coach role on a small, senior team. You'll manage a group of staff- and senior-level engineers working across a Go backend on AWS, a React/TypeScript frontend, native mobile clients, and the ML systems behind our fraud detection. You will not be writing most of the code, but you need to be able to read it, review it, and hold a credible opinion in a design discussion. Engineers here are experienced and autonomous; they want a manager who removes obstacles and raises the bar, not one who assigns tickets.

You'll own delivery end to end: what the team commits to, whether it lands, and what we learn when it doesn't. You'll partner closely with product and with the CEO on roadmap and tradeoffs, and you'll be accountable for the operational health of a platform that enterprises depend on for account security.

We're a security company, which changes the job. Our failure modes are adversarial, not accidental. Reliability, incident response, and secure-by-default engineering are not a separate workstream you delegate — they're part of how the team ships.

We're also an AI-native engineering org. Our engineers work alongside coding agents daily, and we invest in the tooling, context, and review practices that make that productive rather than reckless. You'll be expected to have a point of view on how a team should actually work in that environment.

The title flexes with experience. For a candidate who has run an engineering organization before — owning hiring, structure, and technical strategy across multiple teams — this is a Head of Engineering role.

What you’ll do

Lead the team

Manage, coach, and grow a team of senior and staff engineers, including regular 1:1s, feedback, and performance and promotion decisions.

Set expectations clearly and address problems early. Protect the team's focus and its standards with equal energy.

Grow people deliberately — career paths, stretch work, and the honest conversations that make either one meaningful.

Own delivery

Run planning and execution so the team ships predictably: clear scope, visible progress, and no surprises at the end of a quarter.

Make and communicate tradeoffs between speed, quality, and scope, and be accountable for the call.

Unblock work. Escalate the things that need escalating and absorb the rest.

Own operational health

Be accountable for reliability, on-call, and incident response for the systems your team owns.

Drive postmortems that change something. Treat a repeat incident as a process failure, not bad luck.

Keep security and compliance obligations — SOC 2, customer commitments, secure development lifecycle — as part of normal engineering work rather than an annual scramble.

Partner across the company

Work with product and design to turn a roadmap into a sequenced, buildable plan.

Represent engineering to customers, prospects, and the exec team, including in the technical conversations that close enterprise deals.

Translate between what customers need and what the architecture will actually support.

Hire and build the org

Own engineering hiring: sourcing, interview design, calibration, and closing.

Raise the quality of the bar and the fairness of the process at the same time.

Design team structure and ownership boundaries as the org grows.

Shape how the team engineers

Set and enforce the standards — code review, testing, deployment, documentation, architectural decision records — that let a small team move fast without breaking trust.

Define how the team uses AI tooling responsibly: where agents accelerate work, where a human stays accountable, and what review looks like in between.

Make the build, test, and deploy path something engineers trust. Developer experience is a leadership responsibility.

What You Bring

Work authorization required: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship.

You do not need to match every bullet. We care most about judgment, ownership, and evidence that teams get better under your leadership.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years managing software engineers, including senior and staff-level ICs, with a track record of shipping production systems.
  • A strong engineering background of your own — you've built and operated backend or distributed systems at scale, and you can still hold your own in a design review.
  • Experience owning delivery for a team: planning, prioritization, and accountability for outcomes rather than activity.
  • Experience running on-call and incident response for a production system with real availability expectations.
  • Demonstrated hiring success — you've built an interview process, not just sat on panels.
  • Comfort operating at startup scope: ambiguous problems, shifting priorities, and no one else to hand the hard thing to.
  • Strong written communication. We're remote-first, and decisions that aren't written down didn't happen.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in security, identity, fraud, or infrastructure-adjacent B2B SaaS.
  • Experience with Go, AWS, and a services architecture.
  • Experience scaling an engineering org through a growth stage — adding teams, layers, or a second manager.
  • Experience with SOC 2 or similar compliance regimes as an engineering leader rather than a bystander.
  • A real point of view, informed by practice, on how AI coding tools change engineering process and quality.

What we value

  • High ownership. You see what needs doing and do it.
  • Technical judgment. You make systems simpler, safer, and easier to operate.
  • Speed with care. We move quickly because attackers move quickly, but we do not cut corners on trust or security.
  • Knowledge compounds. What one person learns should be available to everyone, and to the tools we work alongside.
  • Kindness and integrity. Trust starts with how we work with each other.

What We Value

  • Intellectual horsepower. Quickly grasping complex technical and business concepts.
  • Kindness and integrity. Earning trust is central to how we build relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Bias for action. We move quickly to deliver impact and protect our customers against fast-moving threats.
  • Ownership mindset. You care about uptime and stability the way a founder cares about the product.

Culture & Perks

At Nametag, we believe trust starts with how we treat each other. We're a remote-first team that values autonomy, inclusivity, and collaboration, with regular in-person time to stay connected and innovate together.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in the US. Our team spans Seattle, San Francisco, Ann Arbor, Denver, New York City, and beyond.
  • Off-sites: We bring the team together once per quarter for in-person collaboration, often off-site in new places.
  • Flexible schedules: Work in your own time zone; we align key meetings across a shared window.

We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Meaningful equity ownership
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Quarterly team off-sites and travel support
  • New computer hardware and equipment
  • An inclusive environment where your voice has impact and your work drives change

jobs.description:
About

Converge fuses cyber insurance security and technology to provide businesses with clear, confident cyber protection. Deploying a proprietary data ecosystem underpinned by expert underwriting, it provides risk solutions that deliver high value strategies with improved outcomes. Our team is composed of top-tier professionals across underwriting, technology, and claims who share a passion for driving the future of cyber risk management.

Position Overview

Reporting to our CTO, you will lead the design and delivery of complex, end-to-end product capabilities across the full stack. You will play a key role in technical decision-making, system architecture, and mentoring engineers while partnering closely with product, design, underwriting, and actuarial stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and ownership of full-stack features across React/Next.js frontends and Python backend services, including scalable GraphQL APIs supporting internal applications and external partner integrations.
  • Drive technical solutions from ambiguous requirements through implementation and production release, owning CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and production stability for supported services.
  • Design and implement advanced UI patterns, data visualizations, and analytics-driven workflows in partnership with product and design leaders.
  • Ensure high standards of code quality through reviews, testing strategies, and refactoring initiatives — evaluating and championing new technologies and best practices across the stack.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and direct technical guidance, raising the quality bar across the team.
  • Collaborate across teams to influence platform architecture, long-term technical direction, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development.
  • Proficiency in Python and TypeScript with React/Next.js; comfortable owning work across the full stack.
  • Deep command of software engineering principles: clean code, SOLID, design patterns, distributed systems, and API-first thinking.
  • Deep experience designing and maintaining GraphQL APIs and service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong experience with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines in cloud-based architectures.
  • Proven ability to design scalable systems and drive sound architectural decisions end-to-end.
  • Security-conscious mindset — you write code with data integrity, access control, and SOC 2 compliance in mind from the start.
  • Ability to articulate technical tradeoffs clearly to non-engineering stakeholders like underwriters, actuaries, and executives.
  • Genuine intellectual curiosity about the intersection of technology, data, and risk — you want to understand the business, not just the codebase.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI/ML integrations, LLM APIs, or building intelligence into production workflows.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, data pipelines, or tools such as Apache Airflow and Neo4j.
  • Knowledge of cyber risk concepts: threat intelligence, vulnerability scoring, and security posture assessment.
  • Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other compliance frameworks as an active engineering contributor.
  • Prior experience at an insurtech, MGA, fintech, regulated data-intensive industries, or early-stage startup.

What Success Looks Like

  • Owns complex systems and features end-to-end with no oversight.
  • Raises the technical bar across the team through leadership and mentorship.
  • Anticipates risks and proactively designs scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Acts as a trusted technical partner to product, design, and leadership.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

Physical Requirements

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Ability to lift up to 15 pounds occasionally. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Compensation & Benefits

Pay Range: $7000 – $9000/month (commensurate with experience and location).

SUMMARY: The Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth and retention across an assigned portfolio of existing customers. The Account Manager is expected to proactively engage customers, understand their business operations and strategic priorities, identify opportunities to expand the relationship, and position relevant products and services that deliver measurable value. Success in this role is measured primarily through achievement of revenue targets, expansion of recurring revenue, renewal performance, pipeline development, and effective management of the customer relationship.

In addition to commercial responsibilities, the Account Manager serves as a key point of contact for assigned customers and helps set appropriate expectations regarding Support, Professional Services, Implementation, Accounting, and other internal processes. The Account Manager coordinates internal resources when escalations arise while maintaining ownership of the overall customer relationship.

Experience in B2B sales and managing a revenue quota is required. Experience within logistics, freight

forwarding, supply chain technology, or customs compliance is strongly preferred.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Quota Performance: Meet or exceed an individual sales quota through contract renewals, cross-sell, upsell, license expansion, product adoption, transaction growth, and other expansion opportunities.

• Customer Engagement: Conduct regular customer meetings, business reviews, product discussions, demonstrations, and onsite visits.

• Customer Advocacy: Act as a customer advocate internally while balancing customer needs with company policies, contractual obligations, and commercial objectives.

• Industry Representation: Represent the company at customer meetings, industry conferences, and events as required.

Required Qualifications

• Quota Accountability: Demonstrated experience carrying and achieving an individual sales or revenue quota.

Keplr continues to expand geographically through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION & RESPONSIBILITIES

The primary responsibility of this position is to mine and deliver patient and supply chain insights for independent optometry practices as part of our managed services organization. This includes leveraging data and analytics to generate actionable insights and help shape the company strategy, managing budgets and implementing measurement & analytics processes.

Strong candidates should possess a growth mindset that fosters a culture of continuous learning and development. The person in this role should be prepared to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Supply Chain and Inventory.

Supply Chain Analytics

Drive data-driven supply chain decisions by developing analytics that optimize inventory performance, vendor management, and demand planning.

Key Responsibilities

Develop inventory health, procurement, and supplier performance dashboards and KPIs.

Monitor and analyze inventory turns, fill rates, service levels, and 3PL operational performance.

Build demand forecasting models to improve purchasing and replenishment decisions.

Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through statistical analysis and predictive modeling.

Partner with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations to improve inventory efficiency and reduce costs.

Utilize Databricks, Power BI, SQL, and Python to build scalable analytics and reporting solutions.

Merchandise Analytics

Provide merchandising insights through advanced reporting, assortment analysis, and location planning to maximize product performance.

Key Responsibilities

Design and maintain executive dashboards and operational reports using Databricks and Power BI.

Analyze merchandise assortments by practice, market, and customer segment to improve sales performance.

Develop location planning and assortment optimization models.

Monitor sell-through, inventory productivity, and category performance.

Deliver actionable insights that support merchandising strategy, assortment decisions, and business growth through reporting and analysis

Merchandise Financial Planning

Support merchandise financial planning through forecasting, financial modeling, and profitability analysis.

Key Responsibilities

Develop bottom-up merchandise financial forecasts and annual operating plans.

Forecast and analyze key merchandising KPIs including Average Unit Cost (AUC), Average Unit Retail (AUR), Gross Sales, Margin, Inventory, and Net Revenue.

Perform markdown, promotional, and discount analysis to identify opportunities to improve profitability.

Conduct variance analysis against financial plans and recommend corrective actions.

Provide financial insights and scenario modeling to support pricing, assortment, and inventory investment decisions.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

The ideal candidate will have:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.

5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics, Merchandise Analytics, Merchandise Financial Planning, or Business Intelligence.

Experience developing inventory, demand planning, and 3PL performance analytics.

Strong understanding of merchandise financial planning concepts including forecasting, Open-to-Buy (OTB), AUC, AUR, Gross Sales, Margin, and inventory management.

Experience building bottom-up financial forecasts and KPI dashboards.

Advanced proficiency with Databricks, Power BI, SQL, and Excel; Python experience is a plus.

Experience building executive dashboards, automated reporting, and self-service analytics.

Knowledge of assortment planning, location planning, and merchandise performance analytics.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.

Experience performing pricing, markdown, promotional, and discount analysis.

Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional business partners.

Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

Experience with ERP, merchandising, inventory management, or supply chain systems (NetSuite experience preferred).

Specific per-page rates are provided during the qualification conversation and are commensurate with experience, clearance status, and quality track record. jobs.description:
Position:TMP DESIGNER

Salary range: Php 95,000/month (The final amount will be at the the client discretion basing on the candidate’s skills and experience.)

Working Hours: Following NZ business hours

Work set-up: 100% Remote work under Independent Contractor Agreement

Holidays: TBD

Recruitment process: possible multiple client interviews and an assessment

About the Company & Role

Our client is a New Zealand-based traffic and safety management provider supporting roadworks, civil construction, infrastructure and other projects where safe traffic movement is essential. The company focuses on developing practical and compliant Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) solutions that support the safety of workers, road users and the public. As a TMP Designer, you will be responsible for preparing Traffic Management Plans (TMPs), Corridor Access Requests (CARs), traffic management diagrams and related planning documentation. You will work closely with Operations teams, STMSs, clients and Road Controlling Authorities to develop solutions that meet NZGTTM requirements and can be effectively implemented on site. The role requires strong technical planning skills, attention to detail and a practical understanding of traffic management environments, while ensuring documentation is accurate, compliant and delivered within required timeframes.

Key Responsibilities

Traffic Management Planning & Design

  • Prepare, submit and amend Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) in line with NZGTTM, RCA requirements and client/project expectations.
  • Develop accurate traffic management diagrams and supporting planning documentation.
  • Design practical traffic management solutions that consider site conditions, construction methodology, traffic flow and pedestrian movements.
  • Ensure traffic management solutions appropriately address the safety of workers, road users and the public.
  • Review and update TMPs when project requirements, methodology or site conditions change.
  • Maintain accurate records of TMPs, revisions, submissions and approvals.
  • Ensure planning documentation is completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.

Operational & Project Support

  • Work closely with Operations teams, Branch Managers and STMSs to understand project requirements.
  • Provide planning and technical support during project preparation and delivery.
  • Incorporate relevant site, construction and operational information into TMP designs.
  • Respond to planning queries and provide timely support to operational teams.
  • Identify and escalate complex planning matters when additional technical input is required.
  • Support the effective implementation of approved TMPs.

Client & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Liaise with clients to understand project requirements and traffic management expectations.
  • Prepare and coordinate Corridor Access Requests (CARs), permits and associated documentation.
  • Work with Road Controlling Authorities, councils and other relevant approval agencies.
  • Monitor planning submissions, approvals and revisions.
  • Communicate planning progress and respond to enquiries professionally and promptly.
  • Maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure TMPs and related documentation comply with current NZGTTM and relevant RCA requirements.
  • Keep up to date with changes to traffic management requirements, standards and industry practices.
  • Review feedback from operational teams, audits and project outcomes to improve planning quality.
  • Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, templates and documentation.
  • Contribute knowledge and ideas to a collaborative planning team.
  • Participate in relevant training and professional development activities.

Health, Safety & Quality

  • Apply a strong safety-focused approach to all traffic management planning activities.
  • Ensure TMP designs consider site-specific risks and appropriate control measures.
  • Consider the safety of workers, pedestrians, cyclists, road users and the wider public.
  • Follow company Health & Safety, Quality and Environmental procedures.
  • Report hazards, incidents and improvement opportunities promptly.
  • Promote safe, practical and effective traffic management solutions.

Key Attributes

  • Safety-focused and risk-aware
  • Detail-oriented and highly organised
  • Practical and solutions-focused
  • Strong technical and planning mindset
  • Clear and professional communicator
  • Able to work independently while contributing effectively to a team
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines
  • Proactive in identifying issues and improving processes

Requirements

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Experience in Traffic Management Planning, TMP Design or a related TTM role.
  • Working knowledge of the New Zealand Guide to Temporary Traffic Management (NZGTTM).
  • Experience preparing Traffic Management Plans and associated documentation.
  • Experience creating traffic management diagrams and practical TTM solutions.
  • Experience using RapidPlan or similar traffic management planning software.
  • Understanding of Road Controlling Authority requirements and approval processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in technical documentation.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Operations teams, STMSs, clients and external stakeholders.
  • Practical understanding of how TMPs are implemented in roadwork, construction or traffic management environments.

Desirable Skills & Qualifications

  • Current TTM Planner qualification or currently working towards one.
  • Current STMS qualification.
  • Previous operational traffic management experience.
  • Experience working with multiple Road Controlling Authorities.
  • Experience supporting civil construction, infrastructure, roadworks or similar projects.
  • Experience with CARs, permits and traffic management approval processes.
  • Full New Zealand Driver Licence.

Role Summary

The Business Development Manager, Distributed Energy, is responsible for accelerating Fluke’s penetration and market share across the rapidly expanding EV charging infrastructure and solar/energy-storage ecosystems. This role blends strategic market development with hands-on selling to unlock new logo wins, drive product-line expansion, secure multi-site contracts, and influence standards and specifications that preference Fluke test and measurement tools.

The role spans the full distributed energy value chain: EV charge point operators (CPOs) and network providers, EVSE installers and electrical contractors, fleet electrification programs, solar EPCs, O&M providers, utility-scale solar and storage owner-operators, commissioning agents, and utilities interconnecting distributed energy resources. A strong understanding of EVSE installation and maintenance workflows, PV system commissioning and O&M, energy storage, and electrical safety practices is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Market Expansion & Business Development

  • Build and execute a strategic growth plan to expand Fluke’s presence across EV charging (public DCFC networks, fleet depots, workplace/retail L2) and solar (utility-scale, C&I, and distributed PV plus storage).
  • Identify and convert new logo opportunities across CPOs, EVSE manufacturers and installers, fleet operators, solar EPCs, O&M providers, asset owners, commissioning agents, and utilities supporting DER interconnection.
  • Develop multi-year growth strategies for key distributed energy customers and map executive stakeholders and influencers to secure enterprise-wide adoption, specification preference, and expansion opportunities.
  • Develop standardized Fluke-preferred workflows and playbooks for EVSE commissioning and maintenance technicians, PV installers, O&M field teams, and electrical contractors.
  • Drive adoption of Fluke solutions across installation, commissioning, acceptance testing, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and electrical safety workflows.
  • Analyze competitive solutions and market dynamics to develop strategies that position Fluke as the preferred test and measurement provider across distributed energy workflows.

Pipeline Creation & Conversion

  • Establish and execute a 12–24-month pipeline focused on critical product categories including EV charging station analyzers, solar irradiance and I-V curve tracing tools, insulation testers, CAT III 1500 V solar instruments, power quality analyzers, thermal imaging, battery analyzers, and digital multimeters.
  • Generate early-stage funnel through proactive outreach to CPOs, EVSE installers, solar EPCs, O&M providers, and utility DER programs.
  • Drive demand through vertical events, industry associations (e.g., RE+, SEIA, CharIN, EVSE/NECA forums), and strategic channel activation.
  • Co-sell with field sellers and channel partners to progress high-value deals through close.
  • Own revenue growth, pipeline development, and market-share expansion objectives for the distributed energy segment, with accountability for converting strategic opportunities into scalable, multi-site customer relationships.

Contracts, Standards, and Specifications

  • Influence standards and specifications at CPOs, EPCs, asset owners, and utilities to require Fluke tools across EVSE commissioning, PV acceptance testing (IEC 62446), storage, and electrical safety workflows.
  • Secure multi-site and multi-year agreements that consolidate spend and reduce TCO for network operators, EPCs, and O&M providers.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Marketing and Product Management to identify key distributed energy customer personas, define their operational workflows and pain points, and translate those insights into targeted messaging, solution positioning, and market development strategies.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop verticalized content, case studies, and campaigns tailored to EV charging and solar audiences.
  • Provide VOC to Product Management to inform roadmap prioritization for EVSE, PV, and energy-storage test needs.
  • Support Sales Enablement in building segment-specific training for field sellers, distributors, and contractor-focused teams.

Thought Leadership & Vertical Expertise

  • Serve as Fluke’s subject matter expert across the distributed energy ecosystem including EV charging networks, fleet electrification, solar EPC/O&M, and energy storage.
  • Articulate Fluke's value proposition around productivity, reliability, safety, regulatory compliance, and total cost of ownership during executive-level customer engagements and industry forums.
  • Represent Fluke at conferences, commissioning groups, contractor forums, and technical associations tied to e-mobility and renewable energy.
  • Educate internal teams on emerging trends such as NEVI/state charging programs, high-power charging, megawatt charging for fleets, solar-plus-storage growth, interconnection constraints, and evolving codes and standards (NEC, UL, IEC).

Qualifications

  • 8–12+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, or key account management within distributed energy, EV infrastructure, solar, energy storage, electrical infrastructure, test & measurement, or related technical industries.
  • Demonstrated success driving new logo acquisition, account expansion, and multi-site or multi-year agreements in complex B2B environments.
  • Strong understanding of distributed energy ecosystems, including EV charging infrastructure, solar generation, energy storage, utilities, fleet electrification, and contractor networks.
  • Working knowledge of EVSE installation and maintenance workflows, PV commissioning processes, energy storage systems, electrical safety practices, and applicable industry codes and standards.
  • Experience engaging with and selling to charge point operators (CPOs), EVSE manufacturers and installers, solar EPCs, O&M providers, utilities, fleet operators, asset owners, commissioning agents, or related stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to build and execute strategic account plans, map stakeholders, and influence decision-makers at multiple organizational levels, including executive leadership.
  • Experience developing and managing 12–24 month pipelines, including early-stage opportunity creation and funnel development.
  • Ability to articulate value propositions tied to reliability, safety, productivity, regulatory compliance, and total cost of ownership (TCO).
  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration with sales, marketing, product management, and channel partners to drive revenue outcomes.
  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Experience selling through and with distribution channel partners.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across North America.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Direct experience in EV charging infrastructure, solar construction and commissioning, energy storage systems, distributed energy resources (DERs), or electrical infrastructure environments.
  • Background selling or supporting test and measurement equipment, power quality tools, thermal imaging, electrical safety instrumentation, battery analysis, or related technologies.
  • Experience influencing standards, specifications, or approved vendor lists within large operators, EPCs, utilities, fleet organizations, or asset owners.
  • Familiarity with distributed energy technologies and emerging trends, including high-power EV charging, fleet electrification, solar-plus-storage systems, DER interconnection, and grid modernization initiatives.
  • Experience working with or selling through channel partners, distributors, contractor networks, or utility ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop vertical-specific workflows, playbooks, or standardized solutions.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and regulatory frameworks impacting EV charging, solar, energy storage, electrical safety, and compliance.
  • Experience participating in or presenting at industry associations, technical forums, standards organizations, or conferences.
  • Ability to analyze competitive landscapes and develop displacement strategies.
  • Master of Business Administration (MBA) or advanced degree preferred.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Fluke

Fluke is leading the world in creating software, test tools and technology that will support customers today and in the future. We are a customer-obsessed market leader with a strong reputation for reliability, quality and safety.A wholly owned subsidiary of Fortive Corporation (www.fortive.com), Fluke is a global corporation headquartered in the greater Seattle area. Driven by the successful Fortive Business System, Fluke offers the passion of a startup with the resources of a Fortune 500 company. We are focused on the growth of our individual employees, teams and the Fluke brand.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at .

jobs.excerpt: The AmpSeq Programme Director is responsible for leading the cross-functional programme required to scale AmpSeq from strategic growth priority into a robust, governed, commercially reliable and operationally sustainable global platform.
jobs.description:
The AmpSeq Programme Director is responsible for leading the cross-functional programme required to scale AmpSeq from strategic growth priority into a robust, governed, commercially reliable and operationally sustainable global platform.

The role provides overall programme leadership across customer intake, design, pilot execution, kit manufacture, services delivery, BioIT, quality, supply chain, commercial readiness, product development and site implementation. It is accountable for governance, prioritisation, risk management, stakeholder alignment, KPI tracking and delivery of the AmpSeq roadmap across Middleton, Berlin and other contributing sites. The role works closely with Operations, Commercial, Innovation Hub, Product Development, Quality, Bioinformatics, Supply Chain, Finance, PMO and senior leadership to ensure AmpSeq growth is delivered with clear ownership, scalable processes and measurable business impact.

 

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to capably perform each of the following essential duties:

  • Business Impact: Lead the AmpSeq programme as a strategic growth platform, driving delivery of revenue, customer conversion, operational scale-up, service readiness and programme outcomes across global stakeholders.

  • Innovation & Change: Direct cross-functional change across NGS workflows, portal adoption, panel design, pilot execution, manufacturing scale-up, BioIT support, quality controls and customer onboarding.

  • Type of Work: Balance strategic programme leadership with operational issue resolution, ensuring near-term delivery risks are managed while building a sustainable future-state operating model.

  • Key Stakeholders: Partner with global Operations, Commercial, Product Development, Innovation Hub, BioIT, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, PMO, site leadership and senior executives to align priorities and unblock delivery.

  • Communications: Provide clear programme updates, escalation packs, decision logs, risk summaries, KPI reporting and leadership communications for operational reviews, steering committees and executive forums.

  • People Management: Lead through direct and matrixed teams, setting expectations, assigning accountable owners, clarifying decision rights and supporting capability development across programme workstreams.

  • Process Oversight: Own the programme governance model, including operational huddles, Tier 2 escalation reviews, steering committee decisions, intake and questionnaire review, action tracking, decision tracking and risk management.

  • Subject Matter Expertise: Apply strong understanding of NGS services, AmpSeq customer workflows, design-to-pilot processes, kit manufacture, service delivery, BioIT dependencies, quality expectations and operational scale-up.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify and drive improvements in turnaround time, first-time-right performance, traceability, inventory management, workflow standardisation, dashboarding and operational handoffs.

  • Data & Metrics: Establish and manage KPIs for revenue progression, opportunity conversion, panel design performance, pilot status, turnaround time, manufacturing readiness, capacity, quality and customer delivery.

  • Physical Demands: Primarily office, meeting and virtual work, with periodic site visits to laboratory, manufacturing and service environments.

  • Policy & Standards Compliance: Ensure programme activities comply with LGC policies, quality expectations, EHS requirements, customer commitments, data controls and relevant operational standards.

  • Other Duties As Assigned: Perform other duties as required to support AmpSeq growth, business continuity and strategic delivery priorities.

Essential Knowledge and Qualifications:

  • Degree or equivalent experience in life sciences, molecular biology, genomics, biotechnology, operations, programme management or a related discipline.

  • Significant experience leading complex cross-functional programmes in life sciences, genomics, laboratory services, manufacturing, operations or commercial delivery environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage strategic programmes with multiple workstreams, dependencies, risks, stakeholders and senior leadership governance requirements.

  • Strong understanding of operational scale-up, customer onboarding, service delivery, supply chain dependencies, quality requirements and process governance.

  • Experience using dashboards, action logs, decision logs, risk registers and KPI reporting to drive accountability and programme delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, including ability to simplify complex operational and technical issues for executive, commercial, technical and site-based audiences.

Desired Knowledge and Qualifications:

  • Experience with NGS, AmpSeq, KASP, FlexSeq or comparable high-throughput genotyping service platforms.

  • Experience working across multiple global sites and managing delivery through matrixed teams.

  • Formal project or programme management qualification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, Lean, Six Sigma or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience with ERP, LIMS, Salesforce, Tableau, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project or other operational planning and reporting tools.

  • Familiarity with customer-facing technical programmes, product launch readiness, validation, manufacturing readiness and service implementation.

What we offer (US based-employees):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees and dependents

LGC strongly believes that every job applicant and employee should be valued for their individual talents regardless of age, disability, race, color, ethnic or national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, religion, or belief. Short listing, interviewing and selection will always be carried out without regard to gender, sexual orientation, marital status, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or belief, age, or trade union membership.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

This position requires current U.S. work authorization. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship for temporary visas (including H‑1B, H‑2B, OPT, O‑1, TN)

LGC is a leading, global life science tools company, providing mission-critical components and solutions into high-growth application areas across the human healthcare and applied market segments. Our high-quality product portfolio is comprised of mission-critical tools for genomic analysis and for quality assurance applications, which are typically embedded and recurring within our customers’ products and workflows and are valued for their performance, quality and range.

Our tools play a key role in customer workflows from discovery applications through to commercial manufacture and enable its customers to: bring new diagnostics and therapies to market; progress research and development; optimize food production; and continuously monitor and enhance the quality of food, the environment and consumer products.

LGC’s 175+ years of scientific heritage, combined with a track record of innovation and value-enhancing acquisitions, has enabled the company to build its product portfolio and expertise, and develop deep relationships with customers, industry partners and the global scientific community. Join us and help us achieve our mission of Science for a Safer World!

Our kit and component manufacturing sites are situated across the US (Middleton, Petaluma, and Novato) and Europe (Berlin and Lystrup) and are underpinned by either ISO 13485 or ISO 9001 compliance. These capabilities support a wide portfolio of off-the-shelf components and kits critical to NGS workflows including magnetic beads, oligos, enzymes, and library prep kits. Additionally, our primary manufacturing capabilities enable customization and bulk (OEM) manufacture of reagents such as key NGS enzymes for high volume applications.
