jobs.title: Operations Manager, R&D Operations & AI Enablement
jobs.excerpt: Who is Whip Around? Whip Around is an award-winning, easy-to-use fleet maintenance software company that connects drivers, mechanics, and fleet managers to improve the uptime of vehicles and equipment.
jobs.description:
Who is Whip Around?

Whip Around is an award-winning, easy-to-use fleet maintenance software company that connects drivers, mechanics, and fleet managers to improve the uptime of vehicles and equipment. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Diego, CA, we’re on a mission to keep the world’s fleets moving.

Team culture is at the heart of our success, with personal improvement being just as important as company outcomes. We boast a senior leadership team with experience from numerous successful global businesses, and we continue to double down on our vision to bring simplicity and efficiency to fleet management and compliance — increasingly powered by data and artificial intelligence.

Why this role is important to us:

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Operations Manager helps improve our internal AI tools and agents while supporting our R&D and Engineering teams with operational measurement, analytics and reporting. Working closely with the Director of Operations and our technical teams, this role helps investigate, implement, validate and continuously improve internal AI solutions, while supporting the data, systems and processes that keep them accurate and reliable.

A key part of the role is supporting Whip Around’s AI enablement efforts across customer-facing teams. Under the direction of the Director of Operations, the Operations Manager will help identify practical opportunities for AI and automation, turn promising experiments into reliable, repeatable solutions, and embed those tools into everyday workflows to save time and improve consistency. We’re looking for someone with hands-on experience helping teams put AI into practical use, improve the quality and reliability of AI-assisted workflows, and demonstrate measurable value from the solutions they implement.

What success looks like:

Operational Delivery & Support

• Support the Director of Operations in keeping workflows, resources and projects on track and aligned to team goals and developing initiatives.

• Track and report on operational KPIs against targets set with the Director, flagging performance gaps and helping put corrective action in place.

• Help manage operational budgets, systems and vendors to ensure we receive appropriate value from our investments.

• Identify new opportunities for AI within assigned areas of responsibility and help design and implement practical solutions..

AI Enablement & Use-Case Delivery

• Support the rollout and adoption of AI and automation tools across the team, providing guides, training and hands-on support people need to use them confidently and effectively.

• Help identify and prioritize practical AI use cases tied to clear outcomes — reducing manual effort, improving consistency and saving time or cost.

• Deliver early, practical “quick wins” in the first few months, then help establish repeatable processes for monitoring evaluating and improving solutions already in use..

• Help ensure live AI tools and agents have access to accurate, current and appropriate information so they remain reliable and trusted by the people using them.

• Maintain clear communication with stakeholders across the business to ensure AI agents and workflows remain aligned with current data, processes and organizational changes.

Process Improvement & Systems

• Map and improve core operational processes, identifying bottlenecks where automation or AI could reduce manual administration and sharing recommendations with the Director.

• Support R&D and Engineering AI initiatives and help teams improve reporting and data quality.

• Document processes, tools and standard operating procedures so that knowledge is captured, repeatable and easy for the team to follow.

• Manage and monitor new system integrations and coordinate new AI agent requests and intake as they arise.

Data, Reporting & Stakeholder Support

• Help develop and maintain meaningful R&D and Engineering metrics and reporting, using data from development and work-management systems to provide visibility into delivery, capacity, workflow health and operational trends.

• Build strong relationships with R&D and engineering to develop a deep understanding of their of their workflows, needs and challenges, and help design AI-assisted reporting that provides useful operational insights while supporting broader company reporting requirements.

• Conduct regular audits of key business data and operational data to ensure accuracy , working with relevant teams to identify and resolve sources of variance.

• Help prepare monthly and quarterly analytics for the Director and senior leadership, communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Team Support

• Work closely with the Director of Operations and partner with other Operations Managers to keep work coordinated across teams.

• Bring structure, timelines and follow-through to operational projects so they stay on track.

• Provide documentation, support and training for internal users.

Compliance & Quality

• Follow and help maintain responsible-use, data privacy and quality controls for AI and automation, so the tools we use stay safe and trustworthy.

• Support compliance with applicable data privacy regulations and partner with the Tech team on security where needed.

• Identify and escalate operational risks early and perform other duties as assigned to support projects and departmental needs.

What you’ll bring to the role:

Critical Competencies:

R&D Operations & Insights

• Partner with Engineering and R&D stakeholders to understand how work moves through the development lifecycle and identify opportunities to improve visibility, efficiency, and operational effectiveness.

• Develop and maintain meaningful reporting and metrics around R&D activity, capacity, delivery, workflow health, and team performance.

• Analyze operational and development data to identify trends, bottlenecks, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

• Translate data and operational findings into clear, useful insights for both technical teams and business stakeholders.

• Help improve the quality and consistency of development and ticketing data so that reporting and AI-generated insights are reliable.

• Support process improvement initiatives across R&D without adding unnecessary administrative burden to engineering teams.

• Comfortable working with structured business and operational data using SQL, spreadsheets, reporting platforms, or BI tools.

AI Enablement & Agent Development

• Hands-on experience using generative AI tools to solve business or operational problems.

• Experience building, configuring, training, testing, and refining AI agents or AI-assisted workflows.

• Strong working knowledge of Claude and the ability to build and iteratively improve Claude-based projects, agents, workflows, or other AI solutions.

• Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, usefulness, consistency, and appropriate use of source context.

• Experience improving AI performance through prompt design, instructions, context management, source-data refinement, testing, and feedback.

• Understanding of hallucination risk and practical approaches for improving the reliability of AI-generated outputs.

• Experience designing AI workflows that incorporate human review or approval where appropriate.

• Ability to identify practical opportunities where AI can reduce manual work, improve reporting, surface useful insights, or support better decision-making.

• Comfortable experimenting with new AI capabilities and determining whether they provide meaningful business value.

Engineering & R&D Collaboration

• Experience working closely with software engineering, product, technical, or R&D teams.

• Ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders and turn business needs into clear requirements, workflows, reporting, or process improvements.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence, coordinate, and move work forward without direct authority.

• Comfortable asking technical teams for information, clarification, or assistance while respecting competing priorities and engineering ownership.

• Able to independently investigate problems, gather available context, and clearly define what assistance is needed before escalating to Engineering.

• Comfortable operating as a collaborative peer within a technical environment rather than as a people manager.

Professional Skills

• Well organized and dependable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and bring structure to ambiguous problems.

• Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills, with the ability to build productive working relationships across technical and business teams.

• Able to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• High level of integrity, attention to detail, and accuracy.

• Curious and comfortable learning unfamiliar systems, tools, and business processes.

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with a bias toward practical, measurable results.

• Collaborative, resourceful, and comfortable working independently while knowing when to involve subject-matter experts.

Preferred and Differentiated Competencies:

• Experience with Atlassian products such as Jira and Confluence.

• Experience with Atlassian Rovo, Rovo agents, or similar AI-enabled work-management platforms.

• Experience with engineering analytics, developer productivity, or R&D reporting platforms such as Jellyfish or similar tools.

• Experience developing metrics or reporting around software delivery, engineering capacity, cycle time, throughput, planning, or development workflows.

• Experience with Claude and other major generative AI platforms.

• Experience with AI agent builders, workflow automation platforms, or low-code/no-code automation tools.

• SQL experience and familiarity working with relational or structured datasets.

• Experience with BI and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools.

• Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or data pipelines sufficient to collaborate effectively with technical teams; hands-on software development experience is not required.

• Experience with process improvement, operational analytics, program coordination, or project management.

• Experience working in SaaS, software development, technology, or other fast-moving product environments.

• Familiarity with Agile development practices and software-development lifecycle concepts.

• Experience with AI governance, data governance, security, privacy, or compliance practices is a plus.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Analytics, Information Systems, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of experience in business operations, R&D or engineering operations, analytics, business systems, program management, AI enablement, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience using generative AI tools to create or improve business workflows, reporting, analysis, or internal processes.

• Experience working cross-functionally with technical teams and translating operational needs into practical solutions.

• Experience working with operational data and using it to produce meaningful reporting, recommendations, or process improvements..

Location & Work Arrangement

· Location: Remote, with preference in US Central or Eastern time zones

· Hours: Full-time. Occasional early or late calls to overlap with New Zealand colleagues.

· Travel: Minimal.

Benefits

  • Compensation: $100K - $115K USD, depending upon experience and location
  • Unlimited PTO: Use your paid time off when you need it
  • Subsidized Healthcare: A variety of subsidized medical plans to fit your needs
  • Retirement Support: 401(k) matching to help you invest in your future.
  • Family Friendly: Paid parental leave and caregiver support
  • Growth & Development: Professional development plans and resources to support continuous learning.

Even if you don't meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply - Whip Around is a place for learning, growth and building what's next. Following your application, a member of the Whip Around team will be in touch. If you have any accessibility requirements you can then let us know, so we can assist throughout the process. We participate in E-Verify and will verify employment eligibility via the I-9 Form.

Director, Strategic Sales — Corporate Payments

The Opportunity

Corpay is seeking an accomplished Director of Strategic Sales to join our Corporate Payments organization and help businesses modernize how they manage supplier payments, working capital, payment risk, and finance operations.

This is not a transactional sales role. It is a strategic, consultative enterprise sales opportunity for a seller who knows how to earn credibility with senior finance leaders, uncover complex operational challenges, quantify business impact, and build a compelling case for change.

Our customers are navigating staffing constraints, fragmented payment processes, check and ACH exposure, reconciliation burden, cash-flow visibility, compliance requirements, and increasing pressure to operate more efficiently.

As a Director of Strategic Sales, you will develop your assigned territory and account portfolio, create qualified pipeline, lead complex enterprise sales cycles, and position Corpay’s payment automation, commercial card, vendor enablement, and corporate payment solutions with organizations looking to build a more efficient, controlled, and scalable finance operation.

What You Will Do

Build and execute a strategic territory and account plan designed to create qualified pipeline and predictable revenue.

Prospect into and develop executive-level relationships with CFOs, Controllers, VPs of Finance, AP leaders, Treasury, Procurement, IT, and other key stakeholders.

Lead insight-driven discovery conversations that uncover how payments are managed today and identify the associated cost, risk, manual effort, control gaps, and missed economic value.

Quantify customer impact across labor, exception handling, payment risk, supplier engagement, working capital, rebate opportunity, implementation effort, and measurable business outcomes.

Develop compelling “why change” and “why now” business cases rather than relying solely on product demonstrations.

Manage sophisticated, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through negotiation, contracting, implementation handoff, and expansion.

Apply disciplined MEDDPICC methodology across meaningful opportunities, including Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Pain, Champion, and Competition.

Develop mutual action plans that align customer stakeholders, decision timelines, approvals, commercial requirements, and implementation expectations.

Multi-thread accounts early and intentionally across Finance, AP, Procurement, Treasury, IT, Security, and executive leadership.

Partner cross-functionally with Sales Development, Solution Consulting, Implementation, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and senior leadership.

Deliver accurate forecasts based on customer-validated information, documented next steps, identified risks, and demonstrated buyer commitment.

Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene, opportunity strategy, account planning, and sales-process discipline.

Position Corpay effectively against competitive alternatives and the status quo by demonstrating measurable business outcomes, payment expertise, and execution capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a focused territory and account strategy, established relationships with key prospects and executive stakeholders, built meaningful enterprise pipeline, demonstrated strong discovery and qualification discipline, and created a credible path toward near-term revenue.

Long-term success means consistently creating and advancing qualified enterprise opportunities, translating operational pain into customer-validated fiscal impact, building durable executive relationships and internal champions, navigating complex decision, and contracting processes, and producing reliable forecasts and predictable revenue performance.

What We Are Looking For

5+ years of successful B2B enterprise sales experience, ideally within payments, fintech, SaaS, finance automation, treasury, ERP, procurement, AP automation, commercial card, or related technology.

Demonstrated success selling sophisticated solutions to CFOs, Controllers, finance executives, and cross-functional buying committees.

Proven experience navigating longer-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise opportunities.

Exceptional discovery and consultative selling skills with the ability to move from a stated challenge to quantified impact, consequence, priority, and an executive-level reason to act.

Strong executive presence and financial acumen, with the ability to discuss cash flow, operating efficiency, controls, risk, working capital, payment economics, and change management.

Strong working knowledge of MEDDPICC or comparable enterprise sales methodologies.

Experience developing ROI analyses, business cases, executive presentations, and customer-specific points of view.

Strong negotiation, commercial judgment, and contract-management capabilities.

High personal accountability, resilience, organization, and comfort operating within a performance-driven sales environment.

Experience selling into higher education, public sector, healthcare, hospitality, or other complex and matrixed organizations is a plus.

The Seller Who Will Thrive Here

Enter customer conversations with a relevant hypothesis and thoughtful questions rather than a generic pitch.

Know how to distinguish between a payment process that simply “works” and one that is truly efficient, controlled, scalable, and economically optimized.

Understand that a product demonstration should reinforce a strong business case, not replace discovery.

Can uncover the hidden cost and effort surrounding payments, including exceptions, vendor maintenance, fraud controls, reconciliation, check handling, supplier follow-up, payment-method management, and manual work between ERP and banking systems.

Build champions who can advocate for the solution internally when you are not in the room.

Know how to respectfully challenge the status quo and create legitimate business urgency.

Leave customer meetings with a mutually agreed-upon next step, owner, timeline, and objective.

View forecast accuracy, CRM discipline, and account planning as essential components of professional enterprise selling.

Why Corpay

Corpay brings meaningful scale, payment expertise, technology, and operational support to organizations looking to improve how money moves. We help finance teams reduce administrative burden, strengthen control, optimize payment mix, improve visibility, and unlock value from processes that are often accepted as simply “good enough.”

Professional development and career-growth opportunities

Trusted by millions of customers in more than eighty countries, Corpay empowers organizations to operate more efficiently while driving smarter financial decisions.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an entry-level Copywriter to join our creative team. This role is ideal for someone who is eager to learn how great creative work is developed inside an agency environment. You’ll support senior writers and the broader creative team. You’ll develop social content, assist with conceptual development, complete annotations and references, and help bring creative work across the finish line. This role is a critical foundation for understanding how strategy, copy, art, and science come together to create effective work.

Responsibilities

  • Develop social content for healthcare clients and key audiences— healthcare professionals (80%) and patients (20%)
  • Gain general medical knowledge in therapeutic areas and understanding of audiences (eg, physicians, patients, sales reps)
  • Support internal creative copywriting initiatives
  • Write content that is on-strategy and in language that's compelling and differentiating; performs basic proofing of content, paying attention to the relationship with art and copy
  • Learn to annotation, reference and apply AMA style across creative projects
  • Support senior writers on assigned projects to develop and refine creative ideas

  • FDA standards, and ways of translating clinical data into promotional messages

Requirments

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, writing, or related field
  • Excellent writing and communication skills
  • Writing samples and/or creative portfolio
  • Curious, organized, and eager to learn
  • Interested in fast-pace working environment
  • Comfortable supporting others and contributing behind the scenes
  • Interested in understanding how creative work functions inside an agency
  • Open to feedback and willing to revise and refine your work
Interested in working with us? Apply online today. For this role, a copy of your work portfolio will also be required for future interview stages.

Not an agency*

The layer-laden teams. The prehistoric processes. The impersonal, ego-driven dog-and-pony shows. Take what you think you know about agencies and burn it. P10 was born of the idea that if something isn’t working—or could work better—change it. And that’s exactly what we did. We know that what we’re not makes us who we are. And we’re not just another agency. We are people driven by a palpable passion and purpose, felt by our clients from the very first conversation.
P10 brings together a team of diverse, remote-only seasoned professionals to deliver exceptional value for our clients. Dare to do something different - join us.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Cloud & Compliance Advisory
jobs.excerpt: About CoalfireCoalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges.
jobs.description:
About Coalfire

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.
But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.
We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.

Position Summary

The Advisory Senior Project Manager is a senior, client-facing delivery leader responsible for planning, governing, and delivering complex consulting engagements from initiation through closeout. The role serves as the primary project management partner to clients, sponsors, and internal delivery teams, translating engagement objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

Working across Coalfire’s Cloud, Compliance Advisory, Cloud Maintenance & Operations, and related consulting practices, the Senior Project Manager establishes delivery structure and manages scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, quality, and client commitments.

This role requires strong consulting presence, sound business judgment, executive communication, and the ability to operate independently in a matrixed environment. The Senior Project Manager leads through influence, brings transparency to delivery, and protects both the client experience and Coalfire’s delivery standards.

What You'll Do

    CLIENT & ENGAGEMENT LEADERSHIP

    • Serve as the primary project management point of contact for clients, sponsors, and internal delivery teams throughout the engagement.

    • Build trusted client relationships through proactive communication, credible advice, reliable follow-through, and a strong understanding of client objectives.

    • Lead project initiation, discovery, kickoff, planning, execution, transition, and closeout activities for consulting engagements.

    • Translate statements of work, engagement objectives, and client requirements into clear delivery plans, milestones, outcomes, and acceptance criteria.

    • Set expectations regarding scope, schedule, budget, roles, decision rights, deliverables, assumptions, and escalation paths.

    • Anticipate client needs and delivery risks, surface concerns early, and recommend practical options that support successful outcomes.

    PROJECT DELIVERY & CONTROLS

    • Own the full project lifecycle for multiple concurrent client engagements, from initiation through delivery, transition, and closeout.

    • Develop and maintain integrated project plans with appropriate detail to manage milestones, workstreams, dependencies, resources, deliverables, and critical path activities.

    • Establish and maintain baselines for scope, schedule, budget, resources, and delivery milestones; assess and communicate variance.

    • Coordinate work across matrixed consulting, technical, operational, and client teams to maintain delivery velocity and alignment.

    • Define deliverable ownership, review cycles, acceptance criteria, and completion evidence; drive timely client approvals and sign-offs.

    • Manage scope and change control, including impact analysis, approvals, documentation, and communication of approved changes.

    • Track project health using meaningful delivery metrics and provide clear recommendations when intervention or recovery planning is required.

    • Ensure project documentation, decisions, action items, approvals, and status artifacts are complete, accurate, and maintained throughout the engagement.

    GOVERNANCE, RISK & QUALITY MANAGEMENT

    • Design and manage an engagement governance model appropriate to the project’s size, complexity, client environment, and risk profile.

    • Establish meeting cadences, forums, decision rights, escalation paths, reporting expectations, and stakeholder participation across the engagement.

    • Maintain the RAID log and actively manage risks, assumptions, issues, decisions, dependencies, constraints, and mitigations through resolution.

    • Lead governance reviews, stage gates, steering committee meetings, executive updates, and other formal delivery checkpoints.

    • Prepare concise governance packs that communicate overall health, progress, decisions needed, risks, issues, financial status, and recommended actions.

    • Escalate matters with sufficient context, impact analysis, options, and a recommended path forward; follow through until resolution or formal acceptance.

    • Apply Coalfire delivery methodology, quality standards, and required controls; identify and address gaps before they affect client outcomes.

    • Ensure engagements are delivered in accordance with applicable contractual commitments, internal policies, security expectations, and quality requirements.

    FINANCIAL & COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT

    • Monitor project budgets, forecasts, burn, actuals, remaining effort, resource plans, and financial performance throughout the engagement.

    • Partner with engagement and practice leadership to identify financial risks, forecast changes, and recovery actions.

    • Track scope alignment and potential scope leakage; coordinate change requests and commercial impacts with the appropriate stakeholders.

    • Support accurate time, expense, invoicing, utilization, and revenue-related processes in accordance with Coalfire requirements.

    • Maintain visibility into resource capacity, staffing needs, delivery constraints, and planned transitions across the project lifecycle.

    STAKEHOLDER & EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION

    • Provide clear, concise, and audience-appropriate status reporting for clients, project teams, sponsors, practice leaders, and executives.

    • Lead client status meetings, working sessions, steering committees, executive briefings, retrospectives, and other required forums.

    • Tailor communication style and level of detail to technical teams, business stakeholders, client executives, and internal leadership.

    • Maintain decision logs, action registers, meeting outcomes, and commitments; ensure owners and due dates are clear and actively managed.

    • Communicate delivery health, tradeoffs, risks, and decisions in a timely manner, including when the message is difficult or requires escalation.

    TEAM LEADERSHIP & COLLABORATION

    • Lead and influence cross-functional, matrixed teams without relying solely on direct authority.

    • Clarify roles, responsibilities, handoffs, working agreements, and accountability across internal and client stakeholders.

    • Facilitate collaboration, resolve conflicts, remove blockers, and create an environment that supports high-quality delivery.

    • Coordinate with resource management, sales, finance, operations, security, and practice leadership to support successful engagement execution.

    • Delegate effectively, reinforce ownership, and provide constructive feedback that improves team performance and delivery consistency.

    CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

    • Apply lessons learned, delivery metrics, client feedback, and retrospectives to improve project execution and client experience.

    • Contribute to the evolution of Coalfire project management standards, governance practices, templates, playbooks, and reporting.

    • Identify opportunities to improve delivery predictability, operational efficiency, communication, quality, and portfolio visibility.

    • Perform other duties as assigned and maintain company-defined billable utilization targets.

  • Remote position; travel for client or internal work as needed (up to 20%)

What You'll Bring

    • 5+ years of progressive project management experience, including substantial client-facing project delivery experience in consulting, professional services, technology, cybersecurity, compliance, advisory, or a related environment.

    • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or associate degree plus equivalent experience in project management, business administration, consulting, technology, or a related field.

    • Demonstrated success leading complex client engagements with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, deliverables, dependencies, and competing priorities.

    • Experience managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, dependencies, quality, and change control across the project lifecycle.

    • Demonstrated experience designing or managing project governance, including steering committees, decision rights, escalation paths, stage gates, RAID management, and executive reporting.

    • Experience partnering with client executives, sponsors, business stakeholders, and delivery leaders to drive alignment and outcomes.

    • Experience leading cross-functional, matrixed teams in a consulting or professional-services delivery model.

    • Experience managing project financials, forecasts, utilization, resource plans, scope alignment, and commercial impacts.

    • Working knowledge of Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid project management approaches, with the judgment to tailor methods to the engagement.

    • Experience facilitating executive meetings, steering committees, status reviews, working sessions, and issue-resolution forums.

    • Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

    • Excellent customer service skills and a demonstrated commitment to client satisfaction, delivery quality, and professional integrity.

    • Experience with project and portfolio management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, OpenAir, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
    • Advanced ability to create executive-ready status reports, governance packs, dashboards, financial summaries, and decision materials.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex information and recommend a clear course of action.
    • Ability to establish structure in ambiguous or fast-moving environments and to operate effectively with minimal day-to-day supervision.
    • Demonstrated leadership, ownership of outcomes, sound judgment, adaptability, and consistent follow-through.
    • Ability to coach team members and influence stakeholders while maintaining appropriate boundaries and accountability.
    • Availability to provide full-time support aligned to U.S.-based delivery teams.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in cybersecurity, compliance, cloud, technology advisory, or related consulting services is preferred.
  • Foundational understanding of compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, DoD, CMMC, ISO, SOC, or HITRUST is preferred.
  • PMP, PgMP, CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or a related project management certification is preferred.

Why You’ll Want to Join Us

At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively – whether you’re at home or an office.
Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options.
At Coalfire, equal opportunity and pay equity is integral to the way we do business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Coalfire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact our Human Resources team at .

who we are

At Neuroelectrics® we are on a mission to change brain health forever. We design and manufacture wearable medical devices that monitor and modulate brain activity — combining high-density EEG with non-invasive neurostimulation to help researchers and clinicians tackle some of the most challenging neurological and psychiatric conditions, from epilepsy and stroke to depression and Alzheimer's.


Our technology is used in leading universities, hospitals and research centres in more than 30 countries, and we are now expanding our commercial footprint in the EU.

position summary

We are looking for a Sales Manager to lead our commercial activity across the EU on a freelance basis. This is a strategic, hands-on role for an experienced sales professional who knows the EU research and clinical landscape, enjoys representing breakthrough technology, and wants the autonomy of a self-employed contract.


You will own the EU market end-to-end — building the pipeline, closing deals and acting as the local face of Neuroelectrics for universities, hospitals, research institutes and key opinion leaders.

what will you do

  • Develop and execute the EU sales plan for our EEG and non-invasive brain stimulation portfolio.

  • Build and nurture a strong pipeline across academic, clinical and research institutions.

  • Lead the full sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, technical demos (with support from our product team), proposal, negotiation and close.

  • Represent Neuroelectrics at conferences, trade shows and customer sites.

  • Monitor the market — competitors, pricing, trends, funding cycles — and adjust the strategy accordingly.

what do you need

  • Bachelor's degree in business, plus a technical or scientific background (or equivalent experience). clinical understanding: knowledge of EEG technology, including routine EEG, Ambulatory EEG, LTM (Long-Term Monitoring), and cEEG in the ICU.

  • Comfortable creating and executing a sales plan, analysing data and reporting on progress.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Self-employed status in the UK (UTR / VAT registration as applicable), legally able to invoice as a contractor.

  • Willingness to travel up to 50–60% within the assigned territory for client site visits and clinical trials.

Highly valued


  • Experience selling medical devices, scientific instruments or research equipment.

  • Direct experience with EEG, neurostimulation, neuroimaging or neuroscience-related technology.

  • Established network across neuroscience, neurology, psychiatry, rehabilitation or academic research communities.

  • Clinical or scientific background (neuroscience, biomedical engineering, psychology).

you will be the perfect fit if you are/have

  • Passionate about making a difference and gifted with a can-do attitude.

  • Reliable, responsible and respectful.

  • Founder's mindset urgency, grit, adaptable, willing to push boundaries.

  • Comfortable working autonomously and managing multiple priorities in parallel.

  • Collaborative team player who gets things done.

  • Committed to quality in everything you do.

if you join us, you will enjoy:

  • Freelance contract on standard self-employed terms — full autonomy over how you work.

  • Fully remote, home-based within the EU.

  • The chance to bring cutting-edge neurotechnology to the EU research and clinical community.

  • Direct collaboration with a passionate, international team of scientists, engineers and clinicians.

  • A real opportunity to shape a market and grow with the company.

Sales Development Representative, Permanent Placement

Location: Remote | Hybrid | Onsite – Dallas, TX

About the Role

The Sales Development team is a driving force behind Doximity’s growth. We’re on a mission to connect healthcare professionals in smarter ways, and this team plays a key role in making that happen. Sales Development helps us identify new opportunities, expand our reach with existing clients, and create meaningful connections that set our sales teams up for success.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of a determined geography “territory”, researching accounts, identifying key decision-makers, and engaging them through multiple channels to introduce Doximity’s solutions.

We’re looking for individuals who are passionate about sales and eager to grow. This role is a launchpad into a full-cycle Business Development position, providing you with the skills, experience, and mentorship to thrive.

Location: This role is in person filled in our Dallas, Texas headquarters or remote U.S. location

What We're Looking For

We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

  • 1 year of prior relevant experience required.
  • Integrity, coachability, and a sense of urgency
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate our value proposition
  • Excellent organization skills and the ability to manage hundreds of accounts and contacts
  • Experience and success with cold-calling/prospecting; understanding of what it’s like to have a monthly quota.
  • Someone with a growth mindset who wants to learn and develop professionally

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Prospect via phone, email & social media focusing on both our largest existing customers and new prospects
  • Partner with Business Development team members to create strategies to land and expand accounts
  • Become a subject matter expert on Doximity’s suite of Talent Solutions Offerings
  • Leverage tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, LinkedIn & more
  • Manage your activity and metrics to drive decision-making
  • Consistently achieve quota

Growth Opportunities:

  • The SDR role provides a clear path to a Permanent Placement - Business Development Role.

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $85,000-$95,000, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Curative offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Wellness and mental health resources

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Curative, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

  • Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.
  • Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.
  • Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.
  • Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.
  • Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

About Doximity Talent Solutions | Curative

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

We are excited to introduce Doximity Talent Solutions, where Curative, Doximity’s recruiting team, joins Doximity Talent Finder, our best-in-class sourcing tool, to support all of our client’s recruitment and hiring needs in one place with a full suite of offerings. Doximity Talent Solutions offers hospitals and health systems a comprehensive product suite that includes best-in-class sourcing, full-service placement – locums, clinical and executive search – and advanced advertising options targeting engaged clinician audiences. It’s a range of products that no other company can offer.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

  • You’re comfortable working across hardware and software, from CPU microarchitecture and RTL to operating systems, compilers, runtimes, and applications.
  • You’re a strong technical communicator who enjoys collaborating with architects, designers, and software engineers on complex performance problems.

What We Need

  • PhD in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with strong research or industry experience in workload characterization, benchmark development, performance analysis, or simulation.
  • Deep understanding of CPU architecture and RISC-V, including pipelines, speculative execution, vector/SIMD extensions, memory hierarchies, and performance tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with performance analysis and simulation tools such as Linux perf, strace, QEMU, or CPU microarchitecture simulators.
  • Strong programming skills in C/C++, Python, Bash/Shell, and assembly or intrinsic programming, with experience working close to the hardware/software boundary.
  • Strong understanding of systems software, including operating systems, virtualization, compilers, runtimes, and GNU/RISC-V software ecosystems.

What You Will Learn

  • How real-world datacenter and agentic AI workloads influence CPU microarchitecture and architectural decisions.
  • How to connect workload characterization and performance modeling to CPU design, RTL implementation, emulation, and silicon.
  • How hardware/software co-design can improve CPU throughput, scalability, and performance-per-watt efficiency.
  • How to analyze complex production workloads and reduce them into representative workloads and traces for architectural exploration.
  • How emerging RISC-V capabilities, cloud infrastructure, compiler technology, and AI software stacks are shaping the future of high-performance.

jobs.description:
Description

The Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) is responsible for the operational management and oversight of the clinical investigative sites as well as the clinical operations deliverables of clinical trials. This includes but is not limited to training and study level oversight of clinical research associate (CRA) activities, identifying and managing quality issues related to site performance and monitoring, ensuring adherence to study plans, developing action plans to address concerns, as well as ensuring timelines are met and study is conducted according to budgets.

Requirements

The Clinical Trial Manager :

  • Ensures all clinical monitoring activities are performed in accordance with the Sponsor’s contract.
  • Ensures timely, quality deliverables in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), ICH/GCP guidelines, regulations, laws, and study-specific requirements.
  • Identifies quality issues and trends in site performance through KPI reviews, project meetings, site communications, and audit findings. Summarizes findings and establishes action plans to bring corrective actions forward to study team and sponsor, as applicable.
  • Maintains an in-depth knowledge of the protocol, therapeutic area and indication.
  • Serves as primary sponsor contact for operational site-specific issues and clinical deliverables;
  • Contributes to internal, sponsor, and investigator meetings.
  • Manages risk assessment and execution of mitigation.
  • Serves contact for sponsor and project team for all clinical operations matters and clinical deliverables.
  • Provides training/mentoring and oversight the CRAs, Lead CRAs, and other clinical operations staff, as applicable, Including overseeing the transition of CRAs.
  • Accountable for site management activities, including (but not limited to) maintaining site contact lists, coordinating site training, and monitoring site performance).
  • Manages site screening and enrollment oversight.
  • Tracks site visit report metrics to ensure quality, compliance, and timely completion.
  • Assess protocol deviations and related action items regularly.
  • Develop the Monitoring Plan and contribute to the development of other study plans, manuals, reference materials, logs, and applicable site worksheets/instructions.
  • Prepares and conducts project-specific training for the CRAs.
  • Conducts quality assessment visits with CRAs.
  • Coordinates and leads CRA meetings.
  • Performs co-monitoring visits with CRAs.
  • Oversees the development, performance, quality, and completion of SQV, SIV, SMV, COV (including annotated reports, follow-up letters, and other monitoring tools).
  • May participate in business development activities (client meetings, bid defense meetings, requests for proposals (RFPs,) and requests for information (RFIs)).
  • May contribute to the development of tools and/or process improvements within the department.
  • Manages tracking, forecasting, and reconciliation of project budget, including reviewing billed hours, tracking of out-of-scope (OOS) and contributing to change orders (CO) by providing recommendations and estimates to assist with budget preparation, cost justification, and financial planning for assigned studies.
  • Proactively identifies issues proactively and present solutions to project team.
  • Supports the achievement of team revenue objectives by delivering of clinical trials within agreed timelines and budgets.
  • Contributes to improving or adapting existing and new processes, methods, or techniques.
  • Applies prior experience and expertise to proactively solve complex issues, identify solutions and analyze outcomes.

The Clinical Trial Manager may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are integrity, commitment and teamwork. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

As a Clinical Trial Manager, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Complete benefits (medical, dental, vision, RRSP, vacation, personal days, virtual medical clinic, public transportation rebates, social activities)
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology with a team of over 350 employees. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and in Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

We thank you for your application and please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Indero only accepts applicants with a work permit for Europe.

Are you an Arabic (Emirati) language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication and translation for speakers of Arabic everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Arabic language specialists who live and breathe the complexities of Arabic grammar, syntax, morphology, semantics, phonetics, and pragmatics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like dialectal variation, formal versus colloquial language, Arabic script, translation accuracy, semantic ambiguity, and cultural context—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A degree in Arabic language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, translation experience, or hands-on linguistic analysis projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Arabic language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

jobs.description:
At The Obama Foundation, our mission is to inspire, empower, and connect people to change their world. We seek to build an active democratic culture where people are equipped and motivated to make change in the communities where they live, work, and play. Right here on the South Side of Chicago, we’re building a home for this vision, a global center for change with a range of opportunities - coordinated programming, community outreach events, educational moments, and more - that invite visitors from down the block or across the globe to turn hope into action.

Achieving our ambitious goals starts with an exceptional team built on our Hope to Action Values - Courage, Empathy, Integrity, Accountability, Community, Inclusivity, Pragmatism, Resilience, Imagination, and Hope. A Framework that anyone, anywhere, can use to build trust, activate participation, and expand opportunity in their community.

Purpose of the Role

The Program Associate, Voyager Scholarship plays an integral role in designing and facilitating virtual and in-person programming for college student program participants that integrates values-based leadership, bridge building, career visioning, storytelling, and career readiness leadership development content. They have a passion for supporting student-changemakers, are a strong relationship builder and communicator, and are a skilled project manager. They will collaborate with a fellow Associate and Senior Associate and report to the Deputy Director, to implement the Voyager Scholarship Program, in service of the Obama Foundation’s mission to inspire, empower, and connect the next generation of leaders.

Core Job Responsibilities

  • Virtual Program Implementation: Lead the implementation of monthly virtual programming for Voyagers with the support and guidance of the Deputy Director. Manage content components of all program sessions and events, including session design, scheduling, technology set-up, securing external speakers and facilitators, communication with program participants, and other tasks. Serve as the lead point of contact for a cohort of 100 Voyagers and develop systems to track and support their engagement. Contribute to the overall program design and curriculum informed by DMEL (design, monitoring, evaluation, and learning) data. Keep updated on current trends and conversations impacting higher education and closely collaborate with other team members to align programmatic content.
  • Program Participant Support: Provide individualized support and guidance and track program participant progress in achieving key programmatic milestones throughout the program term. Know each student by name and story and foster trusting relationships. Liaise with the Deputy Director to manage unique participant challenges or circumstances. Create a weekly newsletter to keep the cohort updated on programmatic events and share resources to support their development.
  • Partnership Management: Support the entire process of securing vendors by determining desired criteria and conducting interviews. Work across Foundation teams to execute contracts, complete invoicing, and conduct budget reconciliation. Help ensure that contracts are effective, well executed, and accurate. Assist with onboarding and management of program partners. Steward the partnership throughout the contract term by conducting regular meetings, preparing agendas, taking notes, and maintaining accurate communication throughout the contract term. Support the identification of and engagement with new and existing program partners.
  • Participant Recruitment and Selection: Assist with the entire Voyagers application process, including recruitment, application preparation and launch, selection committee training and tracking, application review, recipient announcement, Voyager registration, public announcement, and other duties. Support outreach priorities, including forming partnerships to develop long-term talent pipelines.
  • Cross-Team Operations and Project Management: Provide exceptional organizational and project management skills to streamline processes and workflows across virtual and in-person activities such as event logistics, forms management, and contracts workflows. Serve as a key contributor to a highly collaborative and cross functional team, including through daily collaboration activities, meetings and/or cross-department communications in a fast-paced working environment. Serve as a member of the Strategic Operations sub-team, working collaboratively across program verticals to learn from each other and identify operational efficiencies.
  • Event Support: Work with various colleagues and stakeholders to proactively contribute to event/program design and on-site program facilitation, as well as operations and logistics. Manage program operations in collaboration with colleagues, related to travel, communications, scheduling, technology, and coordination with external speakers and facilitators and post-event logistics. Supporting program participants and foster community and relationship building within the cohort.
  • Impact Evaluation and Storytelling Support: Contribute to the design and implementation of evaluation materials in alignment with Voyager Scholarship Program measurement frameworks. Analyze programmatic impact data and create readouts for and data visualizations for stakeholders. Support the development and iteration of systems to capture storytelling content that communicate data and stories of impact.
  • Other Duties: Perform as assigned.

Key Deliverables/Outcomes

  • Monthly Virtual Session Execution: Seamlessly manage and deliver monthly virtual leadership development programming, maintaining high student engagement and attendance across a cohort of 100 Voyagers.

  • Student Development: Conduct regular 1-on-1 check-ins to build individual student relationships, monitor progress against leadership goals, and proactively address participant needs.
  • Cohort Communication: Produce and distribute a weekly student newsletter featuring program updates, upcoming deadlines, and development resources.
  • Data Readouts & Visualization: Support the collection of participant data via DMEL frameworks, translating feedback and metrics into clear visual reports and impact stories for internal leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Vendor & Contract Lifecycle: Support vendor selection, draft/track contracts, manage invoicing, and complete accurate budget reconciliation across all vendor touchpoints.
  • Application Review: Contribute to the overall recruitment, evaluation and selection process each year.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Program Design & Implementation: 2-3 years of demonstrated experience designing curriculum and facilitating virtual and in-person leadership development or scholarship programs for young changemakers. Also experience providing individualized student support and career guidance and ability to facilitate spaces for students to build community and trusting relationships amongst each other.
  • Applicant Selection/Recruitment: Demonstrated experience reviewing and scoring applications in alignment with an equitable evaluation criteria and process.
  • Data & Impact Storytelling: Demonstrated experience in collecting, analyzing, and visualizing program metrics using DMEL (Design, Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning) frameworks to track outcomes and communicate programmatic impact.
  • Operational Management: Demonstrated project management and organizing skills and experience working with multiple partners and collaborators, managing multi-step operational workflows, vendor procurement, contracts, event planning, and basic budget reconciliation.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Strong communications skills: verbal, written, team collaboration, and use of digital media tools.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including monthly evening sessions to accommodate college student schedules.

jobs.description:
PRN | Independent Contractor (1099) | Project-Based

Organization: HCO Behavioral Health Services

About HCO

HCO Behavioral Health Services is a growing outpatient behavioral health organization committed to providing exceptional, evidence-based mental health services while honoring each client's values, beliefs, and treatment preferences.

As part of our continued growth, we are expanding our Christian Counseling program and are seeking an experienced consultant to help develop a comprehensive, clinically sound, ethically responsible, and insurance-compliant faith-based counseling model.

This is a unique opportunity to help build a program that equips clinicians to integrate Christian faith into counseling when requested by clients while maintaining the highest standards of professional practice, documentation, and clinical excellence.

Position Overview

The Christian Counseling Program Development Consultant will partner with executive leadership to design, develop, and strengthen HCO's Faith-Based Counseling Program.

The consultant will help create a structured framework that enables licensed mental health professionals to appropriately integrate Christian principles into evidence-based behavioral health treatment while remaining compliant with ethical standards, payer requirements, and applicable laws and regulations.

This role is project-based and intended to develop sustainable systems, training, resources, and best practices that can be implemented organization-wide.

Primary Responsibilities

The consultant may assist with:

Program Development

  • Design HCO's Christian Counseling program framework
  • Develop a structured model for integrating faith into outpatient mental health treatment
  • Create clinical guidelines and best practices
  • Help define levels of faith integration based on client preference and informed consent
  • Develop implementation strategies for clinicians

Clinical Training

Develop and deliver training covering topics such as:

  • Foundations of Christian Counseling
  • Ethical integration of faith into psychotherapy
  • When and how to appropriately discuss faith
  • Client choice, informed consent, and autonomy
  • Cultural humility and respect for diverse beliefs
  • Appropriate use of prayer in counseling
  • Scripture within clinical practice
  • Faith-based interventions
  • Boundaries and ethical considerations
  • Maintaining professionalism while incorporating faith

Documentation & Insurance Compliance

Develop documentation standards that address:

  • Appropriate documentation of faith-based interventions
  • Documentation that supports medical necessity
  • Insurance billing considerations
  • Evidence-based treatment planning
  • Appropriate terminology
  • Objective clinical documentation
  • What should and should not be documented
  • Documentation pitfalls and risk areas
  • Clinical language that supports reimbursement while accurately reflecting treatment

Clinical Integration

Assist in developing guidance for:

  • Integrating Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), Solution-Focused Therapy, Trauma-Informed Care, and other evidence-based practices with Christian counseling principles
  • Maintaining fidelity to evidence-based interventions while honoring clients' spiritual beliefs
  • Appropriate incorporation of faith-based coping skills
  • Spiritually integrated treatment planning

Policies & Procedures

Assist with developing:

  • Christian Counseling policies
  • Client informed consent language
  • Faith integration guidelines
  • Staff competency standards
  • Documentation expectations
  • Clinical decision-making guidelines
  • Risk management recommendations

Resource Development

Develop resources such as:

  • Training curriculum
  • Staff manuals
  • Clinical reference guides
  • Documentation examples
  • Case studies
  • Best practice recommendations
  • Competency assessments
  • Ongoing education materials

Desired Qualifications

Candidates should possess experience in:

  • Christian Counseling
  • Licensed mental health practice
  • Clinical supervision, education, or training
  • Behavioral health program development
  • Evidence-based psychotherapy
  • Ethics in behavioral health practice
  • Clinical documentation
  • Insurance-compliant documentation
  • Training adult learners
  • Policy and procedure development

Preference will be given to candidates with experience developing faith-based behavioral health programs or teaching Christian counseling at the graduate or professional level.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal consultant demonstrates:

  • Strong Christian faith and spiritual maturity
  • Deep understanding of evidence-based mental health treatment
  • Respect for client autonomy and informed choice
  • Knowledge of professional ethics and standards of care
  • Excellent teaching and curriculum development skills
  • Strong written communication abilities
  • Ability to bridge clinical excellence with thoughtful faith integration

Engagement Structure

This is a project-based Independent Contractor (1099) position.

Projects may include:

  • Program development
  • Training curriculum creation
  • Staff education
  • Clinical consultation
  • Documentation review
  • Policy development
  • Resource creation
  • Ongoing program evaluation

Workload will vary depending on project scope and organizational needs.

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience and project scope.

Compensation may be structured as:

  • Hourly consulting
  • Daily consulting rate
  • Fixed project fee
  • Training or workshop fee

Our Vision

HCO believes that faith can be an important source of healing for many individuals. Our goal is to develop a Christian Counseling program that is clinically excellent, ethically responsible, evidence-based, and respectful of every client's individual beliefs and treatment preferences.

We are seeking a consultant who shares this vision and is passionate about helping clinicians confidently and appropriately integrate faith into behavioral healthcare while maintaining the highest standards of professional practice.

Salary: Competitive compensation

jobs.description:
The East Africa Regional Technical Advisor I (TAI), Polio will provide strategic and technical leadership for the Strengthening Infectious Disease Detection Systems(STRIDES) Activity with respect to polio eradication-related activities including surveillance, laboratory strengthening, and data analysis. The Advisor ensures alignment of STRIDES polio activities with global guidance, national policies, Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) norms, and donor regulations, while delivering high-quality technical assistance across participating countries. S/He will provide technical oversight of in-country implementation, working closely with global, regional and country teams to ensure fidelity to STRIDES’ technical approaches, troubleshoot implementation challenges, and adapt interventions to evolving epidemiologic and operational contexts. The Regional TA, Polio will play a central role in supporting capacity strengthening, mentoring, and technical assistance to the country level teams, local partners, and government counterparts across polio surveillance, biosafety/biosecurity, laboratory operations, specimen management, data quality, outbreak preparedness and response, and related domains, ensuring alignment with the United States Government’s global health security priorities.

The Regional TA I, Polio will contribute to FHI 360’s technical thought leadership by developing tools, guidance, learning products, and public goods that strengthen STRIDES’ polio portfolio and enhance the organization’s visibility and credibility in polio eradication and infectious disease surveillance. S/He will represent STRIDES’ polio equities with key donors and stakeholders, including the U.S. Department of State’s Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy (GHSD), UNICEF, U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), national programs, and Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) technical groups, ensuring effective communication, strategic alignment, and strong positioning of STRIDES within the global polio architecture. Working closely with the STRIDES Technical Director, Polio; technical leads; MEL Director; and Program Implementation Director, the Regional TA, Polio will cascade and operationalize the Activity’s technical strategy and is accountable for the successful, timely, and compliant delivery of all polio-related technical components across assigned country-level work plans. S/He will collaborate across FHI 360, consortium and local partners to ensure coordinated implementation, responsive technical support, and rigorous reporting that meets or exceeds contractual, programmatic, and quality standards.

This Position will be regionally based in East Africa and work remotely to support STRIDES East Africa Polio activities with a focus on Anglophone Africa.

  • Contributes to planning and making recommendations for STRIDES operations and implementation at regional and country level.
  • Influences design and scope of STRIDES polio initiatives and programs.
  • Develops strategies and tools for the design and implementation of specific technical components within the STRIDES – Polio and Global Health Security programs of work.

  • Coordinates with HQ, regional and country-level technical and programmatic staff members to ensure that activities are performed as per award requirements and consistent with policy.

Staff Leadership and Training:

  • May supervise team members, monitor performance, and lead professional development efforts.
  • Develops and implements training and competency systems at the regional and country level.

Buyers use AI tools alongside search engines, vendor content, and conversations to research solutions and compare options. We want Influ2 to provide accurate, useful information as buyers explore our category, evaluate alternatives, and build their shortlists.

jobs.description:
Highlights

  • Location: Spain Remote
  • Language: Russian-speaking team; English fluency required (C1)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Writer to join the Documentation team and take ownership of the customer-facing documentation set: the articles each release demands, the live articles already published, and the older content that drifts out of date over time.

This is a high-ownership role. Product behavior comes from a Russian-speaking product team, and the customer reads it in English, written to the Fundraise Up standard. You'll go to the source, find out how the product actually works, and write it up so a customer can act on it — not just describe a feature, but make sure nothing is left unclear.

You won't be handed a finished playbook. You'll help write it, working closely with the Manager, Product Documentation as you build toward full autonomy.

What You’ll Own

  • Release documentation — every customer-facing release article, published and live on the date the release ships, with no lag between release and publication
  • Accuracy — what you publish is confirmed against the product and the platform, not against a spec or a guess
  • The feedback queue — live articles stay correct; feedback comes in, you triage and fix
  • The freshness cycle — a growing share of the back catalog, restructured, rewritten, and brought current as your release load allows
  • Media — screenshots, screen recordings, and short walkthroughs that go with release work

What You’ll Do

  • Turn a feature spec into a published article that goes live the day the release does
  • Work directly with the Russian-speaking product team to find out how the product behaves, then write it in English to the Fundraise Up voice and structure — ask the follow-up questions the spec doesn't answer
  • Start from an AI draft and do the real work: check each claim against the product, find where the draft doesn't hold up, and edit until no open questions remain
  • Own incoming feedback on live docs — read the report, find the real problem, fix the article, close it out
  • Refactor older content that no longer meets the standard, as release work allows
  • Produce and keep current the screenshots, screen recordings, and short walkthroughs a release needs
  • Collaborate with English-speaking colleagues across various departments to identify gaps in the current documentation.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience writing technical or product documentation, or tech content
  • Proven ability to own documentation end-to-end — you take responsibility for accuracy and clarity, not just for turning in a draft
  • Near-native written English (C1/C2): clean, precise prose and a consistent voice across a large set of articles
  • Working Russian: enough to source product behavior directly from a Russian-speaking team and press for the detail that's missing, not just translate what you're handed
  • Comfortable with technical material: most of our documentation is non-technical, but some isn't — you can read a tech spec, follow basic API behavior, and write about it accurately
  • Comfortable producing video: you can record, edit, and ship a clear screen-recorded walkthrough, not just write about one
  • Self-sufficiency: you apply a standard without hand-holding and improve older work to meet it
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where context shifts release to release and priorities can change day to day

Nice To Have

  • Deeper experience with REST APIs and developer-facing documentation
  • Background in editing — leading or contributing to an editorial process
  • Experience in product marketing or UX writing
  • Experience working in a bilingual (Russian/English) product or engineering organization

At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool — not an experimental one

We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €3,500 - €4,000 gross per month.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 23 paid vacation days per year
  • 11 paid public holidays per year
  • 5 company-paid sick leave days
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace
  • Co-working
  • Remote working.

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.
