jobs.description:
Engagement Coordinator

Reports to: Director of Coaching Excellence

Location: Fully remote, working US Eastern Time hours

Pay: $24,000 a year to start, rising with each year of service

About this Role

Engagement Coordinators are the EMERSE equivalent of paralegals in a law firm. They are the operational backbone of client delivery: engagements run smoothly, coaches are fully supported, and clients get a seamless experience. The role combines project management, client administration and sales support, and it builds deep knowledge of EMERSE's products and services.

This role suits someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented and always looking to improve how things work. Coordinators handle logistics and administration, and they also support clients directly: answering questions, running NPS surveys and keeping the CRM current. Over time, a Coordinator becomes a near-substitute for a coach on operational matters, which makes the role an indispensable part of how EMERSE delivers.

About EMERSE

EMERSE is a global sales transformation agency headquartered in Miami, USA, and London, UK. We help growth-oriented companies build diagnostic, scalable systems that make sales growth fast, predictable and profitable.

We specialize in sales diagnostics, playbooks, coaching, bootcamps, hiring systems and ongoing execution support. We help businesses codify and implement repeatable sales systems while developing their people into elite performers.

Our purpose is simple and ambitious: to bring excellence to the profession of sales, change lives for the better, and free business owners from the frustrations of growing revenue. Our team shares a commitment to discipline, clarity and impact, and we are redefining what sales excellence means in practice.

Culture and Values

We exist to bring excellence to the profession of sales. We help companies hit ambitious targets, grow profitably and improve lives. Our mission is to restore sales as a serious, service-led profession, rooted in integrity, clarity and impact.

Our Values

Our culture is built on five values that guide how we work, collaborate and grow:

  • Make an Impact: Take action, own outcomes, and deliver meaningful results.

  • Think Around Corners: Anticipate challenges, plan ahead, and act with agility.

  • Speak to Hearts & Minds: Communicate authentically, inspire action, and build trust.

  • Raise the Bar: Be bold, set high standards, and continually strive for excellence.

  • Be a Good Human: Act with integrity, keep your word, and do what's right.

Our Beliefs

  • Sales, when done from a place of service, is a noble profession.

  • We have a duty to help clients buy, even if that means not from us.

  • We aim to be the obvious destination for growth-minded companies who share our values.

The Role

The Engagement Coordinator makes sure coaches and clients are fully supported through every engagement. You'll keep visibility over all the clients assigned to you, keep the CRM accurate, prepare contracts and sales decks, track renewals, client spend and NPS results, and make sure every client journey is documented and improved.

You'll be expected to know EMERSE's products and services as well as the coaches do, and to step in and answer client questions where appropriate. The role goes beyond administration into solving problems before they land, improving how we work, and freeing coaches to focus on high-value client delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Keep Membrain, our CRM, current with each client's journey, renewals, spend and NPS scores.

  • Coordinate each client from onboarding through renewal as their trusted point of contact, and monitor client health.

  • Run NPS surveys and track client satisfaction.

  • Track program results and produce reporting that drives decisions.

  • Prepare and edit sales decks, proposals and contracts for the coaches.

  • Prepare engagements with the coaches: Miro boards, playbooks, OMG evaluations and programs.

  • Coordinate scheduling, logistics and communication with clients.

  • Own engagement administration: preparation, debriefs and content updates.

  • Work with the coaches to keep dashboards and reporting up to date.

  • Build and organize client playbooks, and act as Playbook Champion internally.

  • Improve systems, templates, processes and delivery tools to raise the standard.

  • Know EMERSE's products and services well enough to field client questions or step in for a coach when needed.

How Success Is Measured

  • CRM accuracy at 100% for your clients: renewals, spend and NPS.

  • NPS surveys run consistently and reported on time.

  • Sales decks and contracts delivered to coaches within agreed timelines.

  • Engagements scheduled and delivered without errors or delays.

  • Playbooks and program content kept accurate and up to date.

  • Coaches fully ready for every session, with materials in hand at least five days ahead.

  • Positive feedback from coaches and clients on the quality of your support.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Experience in coordination, project management or professional services support.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to run several engagements at once.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Fluency with CRM systems, project trackers and content platforms.

  • A proactive mindset: you anticipate needs and solve problems on your own.

  • High standards of accuracy and attention to detail.

Tools You'll Use

  • Membrain (CRM)

  • Miro (engagement boards)

  • Trainual (playbooks)

  • OMG portal (evaluations)

  • Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace

  • Zoom and Teams

Requirements

  • Prior experience in a coordination, paralegal or project management role preferred.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

  • Availability to work US Eastern Time business hours.

  • The ability to work across several coaches and client teams and keep them aligned.

  • Willingness to learn EMERSE's products and services to the same depth as the coaches.

  • Commitment to EMERSE's culture and values.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Alpaca is growing its Treasury function as we scale our product suite, global footprint, and self-clearing operations. We are looking for a Financial Risk Manager to support the development and day-to-day execution of Alpaca's liquidity risk monitoring and stress testing program.

This is a hands-on, analytical role for someone who wants broad exposure across Treasury, Finance, Operations, and Risk. You will work closely with the Head of Treasury and partner cross functionally to help maintain sound liquidity governance and produce rigorous analysis under both business-as-usual and stressed conditions. This role is responsible for building out Alpaca's liquidity risk infrastructure from the ground up. You will establish daily liquidity reporting, streamline data pipelines, implement intraday monitoring and stress testing capabilities, develop longer-term and Monte Carlo-based stress testing frameworks, and build the alerting and controls needed to support Treasury decision-making as Alpaca launches new products and expands into new markets.

While the title reflects managerial scope over liquidity risk and stress testing workstreams, this is primarily an individual contributor role with opportunity to grow into broader leadership as the function matures.

What You'll Do:

Key Priorities

  • This role will be responsible for building out the following core capabilities:
  • Daily liquidity reporting and streamlined data pipelines
  • Intraday liquidity monitoring
  • Intraday stress testing
  • Longer-term stress testing
  • Monte Carlo simulations for stress testing
  • Alerting frameworks and other necessary controls
  • Daily Liquidity Reporting & Data Pipelines
  • Build and own daily liquidity reporting, ensuring timely, accurate views of firm liquidity positions across products and legal entities
  • Design and streamline data pipelines connecting Treasury, Finance, Operations, and clearing/settlement systems to reduce manual effort and improve data quality
  • Help maintain broker-dealer liquidity reporting related to SEC Rule 15c3-1 (Net Capital), SEC Rule 15c3-3 (Customer Reserve), and related FINRA/SEC requirements
  • Partner with Engineering and Data teams to automate reporting workflows using SQL, Python, and BI platforms

Intraday Monitoring

  • Build and maintain real-time and intraday liquidity monitoring capabilities to track cash positions, settlement flows, margin movements, and funding needs throughout the day
  • Establish intraday liquidity metrics, limits, and early warning indicators (EWIs); investigate breaches and prepare escalation materials for Treasury leadership
  • Support same-day funding and treasury operations decisions with timely liquidity analysis during market hours

Intraday Stress Testing

  • Develop and implement intraday stress testing capabilities to assess the impact of sudden market moves, margin calls, settlement disruptions, and customer activity spikes on firm liquidity
  • Run and refine intraday stress scenarios in coordination with Treasury Operations and Risk teams
  • Ensure intraday stress results are actionable for real-time decision-making

Longer-Term Stress Testing

  • Build out the firm's longer-term stress testing program, including scenario design, assumption documentation, model runs, and results reporting
  • Develop and update stress scenarios — including market-wide and tail-risk events — to assess impacts on net capital, customer reserve, firm liquidity, and settlement flows across multiple time horizons
  • Participate in integrated stress exercises with Market Risk, Credit Risk, and Operational Risk teams and help synthesize results for Treasury and Risk stakeholders
  • Review and challenge assumptions used in stress models; flag areas requiring further review or remediation

Monte Carlo Simulations

  • Build and maintain Monte Carlo simulation models to complement deterministic stress testing and better capture the distribution of potential liquidity outcomes under adverse conditions
  • Calibrate simulation inputs, validate model outputs, and incorporate results into Treasury liquidity planning and risk limit setting

Alerting & Controls

  • Design and implement alerting frameworks to notify Treasury leadership of limit breaches, deteriorating liquidity metrics, and stress test threshold breaches
  • Build out the controls infrastructure necessary to support liquidity risk governance, including escalation protocols, documentation standards, and audit trails
  • Prepare analysis and documentation for regulatory examinations, internal audits, and management reporting; coordinate with the Risk team as needed

Cross-Functional Support

  • Provide liquidity risk input in the New Product Approval (NPA) process, identifying potential funding and liquidity considerations for new asset classes, leveraged products, and international expansion
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Operations to help stress-test margin engines, settlement workflows, and treasury systems
  • Contribute to ERM deliverables such as the Risk Register and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) in coordination with the CRO and Risk team
  • Help document policies, procedures, and methodologies as the Treasury function scales
  • Stay current on regulatory developments, industry stress events, and emerging liquidity risks in fintech and digital asset markets

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • 2-4 years experience in liquidity risk, treasury, financial risk, middle office, or balance sheet analytics within a broker-dealer, bank, or fintech environment
  • Solid understanding of broker-dealer liquidity and capital requirements, including SEC Rules 15c3-1 and 15c3-3
  • Hands-on experience building or supporting liquidity reporting, data pipelines, and stress testing programs
  • Experience with intraday liquidity monitoring, stress testing, or real-time risk reporting
  • Familiarity with Monte Carlo simulation techniques or probabilistic risk modeling
  • Familiarity with Treasury operations, cash management, and funding workflows in a regulated environment
  • Working knowledge of risk governance concepts and how Treasury and Risk functions interact in a broker-dealer setting
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python (or similar) for data analysis, pipeline development, reporting automation, and working with large datasets
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to produce clear, well-structured analysis for senior stakeholders
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, remote-first startup environment

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience at a self-clearing broker-dealer or carrying/clearing firm
  • Experience building alerting, monitoring, or controls frameworks from scratch
  • Exposure to SPAN, TIMS, or margin methodologies and their liquidity implications
  • Familiarity with crypto/digital asset liquidity risk or 24/5 trading environments
  • Experience supporting SEC/FINRA examinations or internal audit requests
  • Knowledge of international regulatory frameworks across Alpaca's global subsidiaries
  • FRM, CFA, or similar certification (or in progress)
  • Prior experience in a high-growth fintech where processes and frameworks are still being built

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Company Profile

IX Solutions is Western Canada’s go-to boutique IT firm, sought after by leading tech talent and forward thinking organizations for their innovative approach, trusted team, award-winning service and standout company culture.
We act as a trusted advisor to forward-thinking organizations and their IT teams, empowering them to fulfill their potential through innovative solutions and technology that solves business problems. Ultimately, we’re here to inspire innovation — for our customers and our people. For us, that means inviting ambitious individuals to the table — those who are primed to push the envelope — and fostering an imaginative environment for them to thrive. Why? Because we believe when you bring visionaries together with a genuine drive to do better and give them transformative technology as the toolkit, the possibilities and potential for your business become boundless.

For us, success is measured in the lasting relationships we build with our clients. We go the extra mile to deliver a positive customer experience and trusted solutions that are flexible to meet their needs. Founded in 2018, our company supports clients across Western Canada from remote offices in Calgary, Edmonton, Vancouver, and the BC Interior.

Position Summary

As Business Analyst, you are accountable for business-level discovery, process and operating-model analysis, requirements definition, prerequisite identification, and decision support for client projects and advisory engagements. This role connects stakeholder needs, operating requirements, governance considerations, and technical prerequisites into clear planning inputs that help IX Solutions deliver effective solutions and deliver on defined outcomes.

You will lead discovery and planning conversations with business and technical stakeholders, clarify desired outcomes and measures of success, document requirements and dependencies, and maintain alignment between business needs and implementation outcomes throughout delivery. You will work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, Architects, Consultants, Project Managers, and IT Managers to ensure project direction is grounded in clear requirements, ownership, and delivery readiness.

The position reports to the Director, Client Solutions and works 40 hours per week, with typical business hours being 8:00am to 4:30pm or 8:30am to 5:00pm Monday to Friday. Balancing multiple client priorities with deadlines is a requirement, and after-hours availability may be required on occasion.

This role is intended for a structured, curious, and business-aware facilitator who can turn stakeholder input into clear requirements, practical process direction, defined prerequisites, and actionable handoffs for technical and delivery teams.

IX Solutions is committed to helping all employees grow and develop within the organization, and the responsibilities below may be adjusted periodically to align with employee goals or aptitudes while supporting overall business objectives.

Compensation

The Business Analyst position is a full time, salaried position. Compensation range is between $120,000 - $155,000 and is commensurate with the skills, experience and duties included in this position.

What You’ll Do Here

Discovery and Requirements Definition

  • Lead discovery and planning workshops with business and technical stakeholders, creating a clear structure for the conversation and keeping discussion focused on business outcomes, delivery needs, and decisions required to move forward
  • Develop a strong working understanding of the client’s business context in the areas being analyzed, including relevant processes, stakeholder needs, operating constraints, decision points, and success measures
  • Gather and clarify business requirements, desired outcomes, constraints, and key decisions needed to guide project or initiative direction
  • Turn discovery findings, stakeholder input, current-state issues, and operating constraints into clear requirements and planning direction for technical and delivery teams
  • Connect requirements and process decisions to the business outcomes the client is trying to achieve within the engagement
  • Separate confirmed requirements from preferences, open questions, assumptions, and unresolved decisions to reduce ambiguity before work moves into design or delivery
  • Document decisions, ownership, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and required follow-up actions in a format that supports delivery execution and stakeholder accountability
  • Maintain alignment between business requirements and implementation outcomes throughout delivery by revisiting requirements when scope, design direction, or client priorities change

Process and Operating-Model Analysis

  • Map current-state and future-state business processes where process change, workflow improvement, automation, or operational handoff is part of the engagement
  • Identify business, operational, governance, data, security, resilience, and support requirements that affect project direction, delivery readiness, or long-term usability
  • Help define business-level models such as access control, information classification, recovery expectations, approval flows, and privileged access operations where those models are required for project success
  • Clarify how people, process, controls, ownership, and support expectations should shape the technical outcome, including how the solution will be used and supported after implementation
  • Surface gaps between the client’s current operating model and the future-state process so stakeholders can make informed decisions before delivery assumptions become embedded
  • Identify blockers, risks, and unresolved decisions that may affect delivery readiness, adoption, supportability, or project success

Planning Inputs and Delivery Support

  • Support architecture and design activities by turning business requirements into clear planning inputs that help technical teams make appropriate design and implementation decisions
  • Define prerequisites, dependencies, constraints, ownership, and decision points required for successful delivery, including items that must be confirmed by the client before work can proceed
  • Maintain client and engagement context across advisory, sales, technical, project, and managed-services teams so important requirements, decisions, and constraints are not lost during handoff
  • Prepare structured handoffs that help technical and delivery teams understand requirements, acceptance criteria, risks, decisions, stakeholder context, and known dependencies
  • Support projects involving AI, SharePoint, Power Platform, automation, business intelligence, security, cloud, infrastructure, and business and technology resilience by helping define the business and operating requirements behind the technical work
  • Work with Solutions Engineering, Architects, Consultants, Project Managers, and IT Managers to maintain a shared understanding of project direction, client expectations, scope boundaries, and delivery risks
  • Stay engaged during delivery where needed to clarify intent, confirm whether proposed changes still meet the business requirement, and help resolve requirement-related questions

Stakeholder Facilitation and Communication

  • Facilitate business and technical conversations in a structured, clear, and outcome-focused way, helping stakeholders move from discussion to decisions
  • Ask clear questions that separate stated requests from requirements, constraints, risks, operating impacts, and decisions needed for delivery
  • Communicate clearly with clients and internal teams in writing, workshops, meetings, and delivery discussions, adapting the level of detail to the audience and purpose
  • Summarize stakeholder input, open questions, and required decisions in a way that supports action, accountability, and follow-through
  • Keep stakeholders aligned when priorities, requirements, or delivery constraints shift, ensuring the impact of those changes is understood before decisions are made
  • Support ambiguous or sensitive stakeholder conversations where requirements, trade-offs, ownership, or delivery direction need to be clarified

Documentation and Continuous Improvement

  • Create clear, usable documentation for requirements, process flows, decisions, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and delivery handoffs
  • Maintain accurate notes and project artifacts that support continuity across advisory, technical, project, and managed-services teams
  • Organize information so that clients and internal teams can see what has been decided, what remains open, who owns follow-up, and what must happen next
  • Identify recurring discovery, requirements, process, and handoff patterns that can improve IX Solutions’ templates, delivery practices, and advisory capability
  • Contribute to templates, checklists, workshop approaches, and reusable planning materials that improve consistency and delivery readiness
  • Use delivery feedback to improve how requirements are captured, documented, communicated, and transitioned into technical work

Who You Are

The Business Analyst role requires a structured facilitator who can connect business needs, operating requirements, governance considerations, and technical prerequisites to functional delivery direction. The person in this role must be able to listen carefully, ask useful questions, organize incomplete information, and produce clear requirements and planning inputs that help projects move forward successfully.

Professional Characteristics

  • Builds trust through preparation, follow-through, clear documentation, and practical communication
  • Uses structured questions to clarify business needs, desired outcomes, risks, constraints, and decisions
  • Balances detail orientation with the ability to summarize what matters for stakeholders and delivery teams
  • Works effectively across business, technical, project, advisory, and managed-services conversations
  • Turns ambiguity into organized requirements, documented decisions, and actionable next steps
  • Understands how process, governance, data, security, support, and operational requirements affect technical outcomes
  • Demonstrates curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn across a range of client environments and technologies
  • Maintains a calm, constructive, and professional approach in ambiguous or sensitive client situations

Qualifications/Expertise

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, process analysis, project delivery, technology consulting, operations, or a related role
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate discovery sessions, clarify requirements, and document decisions with business and technical stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of business process mapping, current-state and future-state analysis, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and project handoffs
  • Comfortable supporting projects involving Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, automation, business intelligence, security, cloud, infrastructure, resilience, or similar business technology environments
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify options, risks, trade-offs, prerequisites, and unresolved decisions
  • Detail-oriented, organized, business-aware, and comfortable balancing structured documentation with practical delivery needs
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and common collaboration, documentation, diagramming, project, and requirements-management tools

Requirements

  • Legally permitted to work within Canada
  • Hold a valid Driver’s License and vehicle
  • Ability to speak and write English fluently
  • Be able to travel occasionally for business purposes

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive - Roboto AI
jobs.excerpt: About RobotoRoboto is the analytics engine for Physical AI.
jobs.description:
About Roboto

Roboto is the analytics engine for Physical AI. Robotics teams produce massive amounts of multimodal data from cameras, lidars, IMUs, motors, and batteries, and most have no good way to make sense of it. We ingest every robotics log format, automate the analysis, and surface the failures and patterns that actually matter, so teams can ship reliable robots at any scale.

We started from a different premise than the rest of the field. Robotics teams aren't bottlenecked by visualization. They're bottlenecked by analysis. So before we built another dashboard, we built the engine underneath: one SDK that reads every robotics log format natively, configurable agents that triage failures automatically, and search that works across a fleet, not one log at a time. That's our moat.

Role Overview

This Founding Account Executive role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You'll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and deal execution to long-term account growth. You'll work with engineers, founders, and customers shipping drones, surgical robots, and more into production.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in early-stage environments, loves building from zero, and is excited to help define how Roboto's analytics engine gets deployed across industries.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle. From cold outbound to signed contract. You find your way to the right buyers, earn their trust, and close.

  • Generate your own pipeline. You're a hunter who builds from zero. Outbound, events, partner channels, open source community, whatever works.

  • Become a product expert. Run technical discovery, demo credibly to engineering and product teams, and translate platform capability into a clear business case.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor. Deeply understand your customers' priorities and help them deploy automated analytics in ways that actually move their business forward.

Who You Are

  • A genuine hunter. You create your own pipeline, move deals forward with urgency, and don't wait to be told what to do next.

  • Technically fluent. You sell to engineers and can hold your own in a technical conversation. You understand APIs, SDKs, and developer workflows, and you can pick up new technical concepts quickly. Familiarity with robotics, ROS, PX4, or sensor data is a plus, but the curiosity to learn matters more than the prior exposure.

  • Customer-obsessed. You care about outcomes, not just signatures, and you build relationships that last beyond the close.

  • Energized by hard problems. Bespoke deals, new verticals, and undefined playbooks don't intimidate you. They motivate you.

  • A sharp communicator. You write clearly, present with confidence, and adapt from a platform engineer to a C-suite exec.

Why Join Roboto

  • Roboto sits at the center of the Physical AI stack. You're not just selling software, you're working alongside engineers building the infrastructure that lets robots run reliably at scale.

  • Robotics is at an inflection point. The companies that win the next decade will define the category, and you'll be one of the first commercial hires helping shape that.

  • Direct exposure to how frontier robotics gets built and deployed at scale, across drones, surgical devices, and autonomous vehicles.

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity and real performance upside. We want to build a small, high-performing team that has real ownership.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Base Salary: $150,000 - $175,000 + bonus

  • Equity: Meaningful stake in a well-funded, fast-growing startup

Changing lives. Building Careers.

Joining us is a chance to do important work that creates change and shapes the future of healthcare. Thinking differently is what we do best. To us, change equals opportunity. Every day, our colleagues are challenging what’s possible and making headway to innovate new treatment pathways to advance patient outcomes and set new standards of care.

SUMMARY DESCRIPTION

The Clinical Scientist supports the planning and execution of clinical evidence programs for products across the Tissue Reconstruction portfolio. This role contributes to study design, protocol development, study execution, data analysis, and interpretation of clinical and real-world data to support regulatory, medical, commercial, and market access objectives.

The scientist works closely with Clinical Development leadership within Medical Affairs and collaborates cross-functionally with downstream Medical Affairs colleagues, as well as Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, R&D, Marketing, Market Access, and external clinical partners to generate evidence supporting product development, regulatory submissions, clinical claims, scientific communications, reimbursement initiatives, and evidence-based decision-making across the product lifecycle. In addition to traditional clinical studies, the role may contribute to real-world evidence, registry, health economics, outcomes research, and claims-based research initiatives.

The scientist leverages strong analytical and scientific skills to derive insights from diverse data sources and support evidence generation, investigator collaborations, and scientific publications that advance patient care and product adoption.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Reports to Medical Strategy Lead

SUPERVISION EXERCISED

None

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Contribute to the development and execution of clinical evidence strategies supporting products across the Tissue Reconstruction portfolio.
  • Conduct literature reviews, evidence gap assessments, and scientific landscape analyses to inform evidence-generation priorities.
  • Lead the scientific design of assigned studies and contribute to the development of protocols, data collection instruments, analysis plans, and study reports in collaboration with Clinical Operations, Medical Communications, and Biostatistics.
  • Design, plan, and execute clinical studies, registries, real-world evidence, outcomes research, and claims-based research initiatives.
  • Lead assigned study and evidence-generation workstreams with accountability for timelines, deliverables, study quality, and execution.
  • Analyze, interpret, and synthesize clinical, real-world, health economics, and published data to generate scientific insights regarding evidence gaps, competitive evidence evaluations, and landscape analyses to inform clinical development and evidence strategy.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, and other evidence dissemination activities.
  • Present scientific findings and evidence-based recommendations to internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, R&D, Marketing, Market Access, and external investigators to align evidence-generation activities with product development and business needs.
  • Support investigator and KOL collaborations through study planning discussions, advisory activities, and investigator-initiated research programs.

DESIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree required (Master's minimum; Ph.D. preferred) in Biomedical Engineering, Biomaterials, Tissue Engineering, Regenerative Medicine, Biological Sciences, Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Outcomes Research, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in clinical development, clinical research, medical affairs, epidemiology, health outcomes, real-world evidence, or related evidence-generation functions.
  • Experience supporting clinical studies, registries, real-world evidence (RWE), outcomes research, health economics, or claims-based research projects preferred..
  • Experience within the medical device or biotechnology industry preferred.
  • Demonstrated academic training, research experience, or scientific expertise in biomaterials, tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, wound healing, tissue repair, soft-tissue reconstruction, or related fields strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing scientific communications, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, presentations, reports, or literature reviews preferred.

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and scientific problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of clinical research methodology, study design, and evidence-generation principles.
  • Understanding of biostatistics and experience interpreting clinical, real-world, and published data.
  • Ability to apply scientific understanding of biomaterials, tissue remodeling, and regenerative mechanisms to clinical evidence generation, study design, data interpretation, and scientific communications.
  • Ability to synthesize complex clinical and scientific information into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Ability to conduct literature reviews, evidence gap assessments, scientific landscape analyses, and evidence synthesis activities.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented with a strong commitment to execution excellence.
  • Familiarity with real-world evidence, outcomes research, registry, claims-based, and health economics research methodologies.
  • Effective project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong scientific writing skills with the ability to support publications, abstracts, study reports, and scientific presentations.
  • Excellent collaboration skills and demonstrated success working in a cross-functional, matrixed environment.
  • Ability to build productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external investigators, and research partners.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience working with clinical, real-world, registry, or claims data and utilizing analytical or data visualization tools (e.g., Excel, R, SAS, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The opportunity

Grafana Observability builds end-to-end observability that spans application, infrastructure, database, browser, and mobile. Our Real User Monitoring (RUM) initiative focuses on capturing, storing, and querying high-volume user interaction data from browsers and mobile devices, enabling teams to understand real-world user experiences at scale.

We’re building systems that ingest and process massive amounts of telemetry – sessions, events, traces, and logs – and make them explorable in real time. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-performance backend systems, columnar storage databases, and intuitive frontend experiences.

Our solutions are tightly integrated with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud. We care deeply about performance, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across the entire stack. From instrumentation to query layer to visualization.

We value open standards, great developer experience, and doing the hard engineering needed to ship reliable software at scale. You may not meet every requirement below. If this role excites you, please raise your hand.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and evolve fullstack features for RUM, starting with the frontend user experience that spans our backend services, APIs, storage systems.
  • Design and implement systems that ingest, store, and query high-cardinality, high-volume telemetry data using columnar/analytical databases.
  • Develop performant query layers and APIs that power real-time exploration of user sessions, traces, and events.
  • Contribute to frontend applications that visualize RUM data, enabling users to debug performance issues and understand user behavior.
  • Work on data modeling, indexing strategies, and query optimization to ensure low-latency, cost-efficient analytics at scale.
  • Collaborate closely with SDK engineers (browser and mobile) to ensure high-quality data ingestion and schema evolution.
  • Own projects end-to-end: from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables and iterate quickly based on feedback.
  • Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, documentation, and smooth upgrade paths.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, frontend, product, and solutions engineering to deliver cohesive observability workflows.
  • Support teammates, participate in technical design discussions and help shape the RUM roadmap.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups (always paired with strong code review and quality standards).

You’ll also have access to frontier models.

What makes you a great fit

  • 5+ years of fullstack engineering experience with strong frontend fundamentals
  • Frontend experience, TypeScript and React. Backend experience, Go is preferred.
  • Experience building or operating distributed systems in production (e.g., Kafka, WarpStream, Apache Pinot, ClickHouse, Cassandra, Postgres)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native systems (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience working with high-throughput, high-cardinality data (logs, metrics, traces, events)
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, query optimization, and performance tradeoffs
  • Experience designing and building APIs and distributed services
  • Experience building data-heavy UIs (dashboards, query tools, debugging interfaces)
  • Familiarity with observability concepts (traces, logs, metrics) and/or OpenTelemetry
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a remote, distributed team
  • Pragmatic, self-driven, and comfortable navigating ambiguity
  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for developer experience

Bonus / nice-to-have

  • Experience with browser or mobile instrumentation (RUM SDKs, telemetry collection).
  • Mobile development experience (iOS or Android) or familiarity with mobile performance and telemetry.
  • Contributions to OpenTelemetry or other observability OSS.
  • Experience building developer-facing platforms or observability products.
  • Familiarity with session replay, sampling strategies, or user behavior analytics systems.

In US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is USD $154,445 - $185.334. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. jobs.description:
Customer Experience Specialist (Philippines)

Aviron, a standout Y-Combinator-backed company, transforms fitness through its innovative game-based workout equipment, pioneering the future of fitness entertainment. Y-Combinator, renowned for nurturing groundbreaking startups like Airbnb, Dropbox, and Instacart, has been instrumental in Aviron's journey. With an infusion of $23.5M USD in funding, we've been experiencing exponential double-digit growth annually since our inception.

Founded on the principle of making fitness engaging through advanced gamification technology, Aviron is more than just a product; it's a vision to revolutionize how our community stays motivated. Our unique approach combines the enjoyment of gaming with the benefits of exercise, crafting an experience that's fun, effective and even addictive.

We invite you to explore our community and witness the impact of Aviron firsthand.

Aviron is right for you if:

  • You're looking for a role that prioritizes personal and professional growth
  • You're looking for a flat organization with friendly people that values merit (i.e. good work)
  • You're self-motivated and produce amazing work
  • You're not down with office politics
  • You want to own your work, start to finish
  • You want to be provided with ample support and resources (i.e. budget) to complete said work
  • You are looking to make an impact and see your work drive growth

Position Overview

Aviron is looking for a talented, customer-focused, detail-oriented professional to join our team as a Customer Experience Specialist. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our customers and a key representative of the Aviron brand. You will help customers navigate their journey with us by resolving issues, answering questions, and educating them on our connected fitness products.

This role supports our North American customer base from the Philippines, which means working overnight Philippine hours. We are direct about this up front because it is the single biggest factor in whether this role is a fit for your life, not just your skills.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys problem-solving, takes ownership of customer interactions from start to finish, and is excited to work in a fast-paced, growing startup environment. You enjoy learning products and software inside and out, adapt quickly to change, and are motivated by delivering a thoughtful, high-quality customer experience.

Schedule & Availability

Our Customer Experience team supports North American customers between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM Eastern Time, six days a week. This role covers the later part of that window.

Your primary shift, in Philippine Standard Time:

  • Wednesday to Sunday, 12:00 AM to 9:00 AM PHT (this is Tuesday to Saturday, 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET)
  • Days off: Monday and Tuesday, always two consecutive days

North America observes Daylight Saving Time and the Philippines does not, so your shift moves by one hour for roughly four months of the year. From early November to mid-March, your hours shift to 1:00 AM to 10:00 AM PHT. Your days off do not change. We give advance notice before each change.

Schedules are set in advance. This is a long-term overnight schedule, not a rotating one, so please apply only if you are confident you can sustain it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain a strong understanding of all Aviron products, support channels, and company policies and terms
  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer inquiries across live chat, phone, email, and social media
  • Resolve customer issues with empathy, clarity, and efficiency, escalating or routing technical issues to the Tech Support team when appropriate
  • Process orders, cancellations, returns, and verify customer account information as needed
  • Submit and manage shipping claims and delivery-related escalations when deliveries do not go as planned
  • Identify recurring customer issues, gaps, or inefficiencies and proactively share feedback to help improve support processes, tools, and the overall customer experience
  • Educate prospective members on Aviron hardware and software features through live video product demos
  • Support cross-functional and ad hoc projects as needed

Qualifications

  • 1+ year of experience in a customer service, customer support, or equivalent role
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including comfort on live video calls with North American customers
  • Able to effectively manage time, multitask, and reprioritize in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Strong typing speed and accuracy, particularly in live chat environments
  • Analytical and logical approach to problem-solving
  • Experience working with CRM systems
  • Experience with NetSuite is an asset
  • College diploma or university degree preferred, but equivalent experience will be considered

Work setup requirements

Because this is a fully remote overnight role supporting live customers, you will need:

  • A private, quiet workspace suitable for customer calls and video demos
  • Reliable high-speed home internet, with a backup connection such as mobile data
  • A plan for power interruptions, such as a UPS or backup power source
  • The ability to work the overnight Philippine schedule above on a sustained basis

What We Offer

  • 2 weeks paid vacation
  • Sick leave and personal days
  • Health benefits
  • Paid CAD holidays
  • Computer and headset
  • $25/month for internet coverage

A couple more things

Our customers love us because we are friendly, passionate, and always willing to go the extra mile. They are continuously impressed (even surprised) at the high-quality physical product and software experience we provide. We are very proud of the product and market we've carved out as a team/company that was until very recently mostly boot-strapped. We are looking for someone to match (and elevate!) our passion and hard work to the next level during this very exciting time for our company.

Aviron is based in Toronto, Canada, but much of our team is remote, spanning across Canada, the U.S., and Asia. Please note that this role must be based within the Philippines.

Aviron is an equal opportunity employer. We provide a safe and inspiring workplace where everyone is accepted and has the opportunity to grow with us. If you require any accommodations, please let us know.

The Accelerate Account Manager owns a portfolio of around 60 customers representing roughly $2.5M in annual revenue. Your main job is keeping those customers happy, healthy, and renewing. jobs.excerpt: ViaBill is a Copenhagen-based fintech offering flexible payment and consumer credit products to shoppers and merchants in Denmark.
jobs.description:
ViaBill is a Copenhagen-based fintech offering flexible payment and consumer credit products to shoppers and merchants in Denmark. Our products include a consumer app, the ViaBill card, and a merchant-facing platform used by thousands of webshops and stores.

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our Lead Product Designer as the second designer on the team. You'll own specific product areas end-to-end, from understanding the problem through to shipped UI. You'll work within our shared design system and closely with product, commercial and engineering. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, in a small team where your work goes live quickly.

What you'll do

  • Own design for defined product areas, including our merchant-facing platform and parts of the consumer experience, from problem framing and user flows to final UI and implementation.
  • Pick up design needs from across the business when they come up, from web and campaign pages to visual assets for internal and external use, and bring the same craft to them as to product work.
  • Explore several design directions before converging, present them clearly to non-design stakeholders, and drive decisions to closure.
  • Design within our design system and contribute to it, working with our Lead Product Designer on component standards and consistency.
  • Run lightweight usability testing and use product and funnel data to improve live flows.
  • Design flows that are clear and compliant at the same time. In consumer credit, disclosures, consent and application steps have to work for both the customer and the regulator.
  • Deliver clean, well-structured handoff and stay involved with developers through implementation and QA.

What we're looking for

  • 2–4 years designing shipped web and mobile products; fintech, e-commerce or B2B SaaS a plus.
  • Portfolio with 2–3 case studies showing problem, alternatives explored, decision, and outcome.
  • Strong Figma skills, including components, variants and auto-layout, and experience working inside an existing design system.
  • Clear, confident written and spoken English; comfortable presenting and defending design choices.
  • Based in the EU with CET working-hours overlap.

    • You'll fit well here if you like owning outcomes rather than tickets, share early work instead of waiting until it's polished, and can hold a view and change it when the evidence says so.

    Nice to have

    • Experience designing regulated or multi-step flows, such as onboarding, applications, payments or identity verification.
    • Experience designing for both consumers and business users.
    • Basic prototyping in code or motion design.

What we offer

  • Ownership of real product areas from day one, with a direct line to the COO and short decision paths.
  • A small, international team where design has a seat at the table.
  • Fully remote work within the EU, with occasional trips to Copenhagen for team gatherings.
    • We're a small team, so no two weeks look the same. One week you might be deep in a mobile app flow, the next shaping a landing page or a piece of brand work. If you enjoy range as much as depth, you'll like it here.

How we hire

    1. Short intro call (30 min)
    2. Portfolio walkthrough with our product team (60 min)
    3. Design task, or a deep-dive into one of your past projects
    4. Final conversation with our COO

jobs.title: National Workforce Program Integrity Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives.
jobs.description:
Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting-edge technology with compassionate, high-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we’re solving today’s unemployment challenges with smart software, world-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you’ll feel right at home here.

TITLE:
National Workforce Program Integrity Specialist

REPORTS TO:
Senior Director of Performance and Tech Innovation

LOCATION:
Remote – Corporate (100%), with frequent travel to project sites

EMPLOYMENT TYPE:

Full-Time, Exempt Employee

Career Team is looking to hire a National Workforce Quality & Performance Specialist. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Performance and Tech Innovation, this 100% corporate role is a hands-on, multi-project resource that steps into Workforce Services projects when performance, quality, or day-to-day operations are at risk. Whether a gap is caused by turnover, vacancies, a new project start-up, or unclear direction, this person will go into the project, perform the actual day-to-day work alongside (or in place of) local staff, diagnose what went wrong, and make the practical operational decisions needed to re-stabilize the project and hand it back in a sustainable state.

This role blends program integrity, quality assurance, and training. It is intended for someone with a strong QA background who can speak the language of corporate QA, understand why files and approvals fail, and help the Performance team and the QA side of the house work from the same data, standards, and priorities. The specialist will also deliver training and technical assistance so that fixes stick after they leave a project. Time is allocated approximately 40% to project stabilization and direct operational support, 35% to quality assurance and program integrity, and 25% to training, technical assistance, and continuous improvement; actual allocation will shift based on portfolio needs.

Your Impact on Career Team's Success:

Project Stabilization and Direct Operational Support (40%): Serve as a deployable corporate resource for projects experiencing performance, compliance, staffing, or operational breakdowns. Step in to do the work, stabilize operations, and leave the project with clear processes and ownership.

  • Deploy (remotely or on-site) to assigned projects when performance, QA results, staffing levels, or contract deliverables are at risk, and quickly assess the current state of operations, backlogs, and compliance exposure.
  • Perform day-to-day project work as needed to prevent service disruption — including eligibility and enrollment processing, case file documentation, service-submission preparation (OJT, SS, ITA, WEX, supportive services, and other participant services), data entry in state workforce systems, and corrections.
  • Make and document operational decisions needed to re-stabilize a project, such as reprioritizing workloads, clearing backlogs, reassigning caseload tasks, tightening approval workflows, and setting interim procedures, in coordination with project and regional leadership.
  • Build and execute short-term stabilization plans with clear goals, timelines, owners, and exit criteria, and provide regular status updates to the Senior Director of Performance and Tech Innovation and Workforce Services leadership.
  • Coach project directors, supervisors, and frontline staff in real time while working alongside them, modeling correct practice rather than only reviewing it after the fact.
  • Transition responsibilities back to local staff with documented procedures, trained owners, and follow-up checkpoints to confirm performance holds after exit.

Program Integrity, QA, & Operations Partnership (30%): Act as a bridge between the Performance team and Corporate QA, bringing a QA mindset to performance work and making sure QA findings turn into operational fixes.

  • Partner closely with Corporate QA and Operations to align quality standards, review criteria, and priorities with performance goals, and help translate QA findings into practical, project-level corrective action.
  • Conduct targeted file reviews, pre-audit and pre-monitoring reviews, and risk assessments on assigned projects covering eligibility, enrollment, documentation, service approvals, and data integrity.
  • Analyze QA, monitoring, and performance data to identify recurring errors, root causes, and bottlenecks — including where eligibility and service-submission approvals stall between local teams and corporate QA.
  • Develop and track corrective action plans, validate sustained improvement through follow-up sampling, and escalate unresolved or systemic issues to leadership.
  • Contribute QA and integrity measures to project scorecards and dashboards, and work with performance, data, and technology resources to automate exception reporting and reduce manual review where feasible.
  • Prepare monthly reporting on assigned projects summarizing quality results, stabilization status, training delivered, and outstanding risks.

Training, Technical Assistance, and Continuous Improvement (30%): Deliver the training and technical assistance that keeps projects stable after intervention and prevents repeat issues across the portfolio.

  • Design and deliver job-specific training for local operational staff, supervisors, and leadership — including eligibility/enrollment, approval processes, corrections, customer flow, documentation standards, and state workforce systems.
  • Use QA trends and stabilization findings to target retraining for specific individuals, teams, or projects, and measure whether training improves results.
  • Support new project start-ups and transitions with readiness reviews, initial staff training, and early-life monitoring at approximately 30, 60, and 90 days after launch.
  • Build and update SOPs, desk guides, checklists, and job aids based on lessons learned in the field, in coordination with Corporate QA, the Program Integrity Manager, and the training team.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on new local, state, and federal workforce guidance (including WIOA and related funding streams), advise project leadership on implications, and recommend process, tool, and training updates.

This is a remote, 100% corporate position. The selected candidate must be available to work across applicable business hours based on organizational and project needs and must be able to travel frequently, sometimes on short notice, to support project stabilization, monitoring, training, and implementation.

The Ideal Qualifications for this Position Include:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Administration, Public Administration, Social Services, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in workforce development operations, with a strong background in quality assurance, compliance, program monitoring, or audit.
  • Hands-on experience performing frontline or supervisory workforce program work (eligibility, enrollment, case management, service approvals, or data entry) and the ability to step into those roles immediately.
  • Working knowledge of WIOA and other public workforce funding streams (SNAP E&T, TANF, or similar experience preferred), eligibility requirements, and service documentation standards.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting file audits, root-cause analysis, and corrective action planning, and turning findings into operational improvements.
  • Proven ability to stabilize or turn around under-performing teams, programs, or processes, and to make sound decisions quickly with incomplete information.
  • Experience designing and delivering training for adult learners, preferably across multiple states or projects.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends and systemic issues in QA and performance data.
  • Excellent communication and relationship skills, with the ability to coach staff, influence leaders without direct authority, and collaborate across Performance, QA, and Operations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and case-management or QA reporting systems; experience with state workforce management systems (e.g., CalJOBS, WorkInTexas, or comparable) strongly preferred.
  • A hands-on, "get it done" mindset and comfort balancing strategy with execution.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently to project sites across the country.

Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 annually, based on experience

Salary is commensurate with education and experience. Career Team offers a competitive benefits package including healthcare, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, paid holidays, and professional development opportunities.

Travel:

Frequent travel will be required based on project stabilization needs, program monitoring schedules, implementation activities, training, and organizational meetings.

About Career Team:
Founded in 1996, Career Team, LLC is a private workforce development organization.

Career Team’s outstanding record of accelerating the human condition has resulted in numerous honors:

  • Named by Inc. Magazine as one of America's 500 fastest growing privately held companies
  • Recipient of the US Chamber of Commerce Blue Chip Enterprise Award for innovation
  • Featured by 60 Minutes, CNN, Money Magazine, Inc. Magazine and the British Broadcasting Network as an innovative, government funded solutions program
  • Invited to the White House after being cited by the National Welfare-to-Work Partnership and National Alliance of Business as a top 10 US training provider

As a socially conscious organization, Career Team has found a healthy balance between for-profit innovation and community enrichment. Looking ahead, the organization will continue to close the nation’s opportunity divide with additional government-funded workforce sites; while also building staff capacity of workforce funding sources and industry providers. See www.careerteam.com for more information.

Career Team is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

jobs.excerpt: The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.

Overview

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
  • Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
  • Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
  • Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for
  • Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat
  • Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us
  • Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud
  • A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created
  • A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone
  • The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it
  • Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it
  • A preference for being corrected over being right
  • Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The France Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

This Role Is Not For

The Bar

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.
