Job Overview:

We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to own a significant piece of Omada's Member-facing surface. You own what gets built, in what order, and how the people building it grow.

A squad owns problems from prototype to production, including the maintenance and the on-call rotation for what it ships. At this level you own more than one, which means the hardest calls you make are the ones about where capacity goes when two good things want it at the same time.

You stay technical. You are in the codebase and in the same agent workflows your builders use, close enough to review architecture, catch a weak design, and be useful in an incident. Where you manage directly, you ship production work off the critical path. Where you manage through someone else, that person's growth is your work product.

You partner with Product Strategists who spend their time in front of members, coaches, and stakeholders, and who prototype to test ideas quickly. They own what gets built and why. You own whether it can be delivered, at what cost, and by when, and you are senior enough that your answer shapes the roadmap rather than just responding to it.

About you:

You are comfortable being accountable for what your squads ship. You still write code, and you want to. This role ships production work off the critical path, in the same codebase and the same agent workflows as your squads, so you feel the friction your people feel first-hand.

You have a point of view on where AI-assisted development helps and where it creates rework, and it comes from changing how a real team works, not from reading about it. You have done the engineering manager job well enough that you can teach it. Whether or not you have carried the title of manager-of-managers, you have grown someone into leading, and you know the difference between doing the work for them and raising their ceiling.

Your first team is your peer group, not your reports. When something is slowing down the engineering org and it is nobody's job, you have a track record of picking it up, getting the right people in the room, and finishing it.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own delivery across your squads. Sprint shaping, prioritization, backlog grooming, and estimation. Make the calls, write them down, and be accountable for them. When two squads want the same thing at the same time, you are the one who decides.
  • Own cycle time. Yours to improve, not at the expense of quality, and yours to explain when it changes, including why one of your squads is slower than the other.
  • Stay technical. On squads you manage directly, you ship production work every sprint, off the critical path, in the same agent workflows your builders use. On squads that run through a manager, you stay close enough to review architecture, catch a weak design, and be useful in an incident. Either way, you can teach someone to navigate the system, not just navigate it yourself.
  • Partner with your Product Strategist. They own what the squad builds; you hold the line between their scope and yours so the squad never has two people answering the same question differently.
  • Grow a manager. If an EM reports to you, their growth is your work product. Their squad's health is the evidence.
  • Plan the team you need next year, not just this quarter. Headcount, skill mix, and the onboarding path that gets a new builder productive in an agent-heavy codebase in weeks rather than months.
  • Set the AI standard past your own boundary. Write down what good looks like, teach it, and measure whether it stuck. Other squads should be able to use what you built without you in the room.
  • Take on the problem that is nobody's. You will find things that slow down engineering broadly. Some of them you should pick up, organize, and close out with your peers.

What you need for this role:

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years managing engineers directly.
  • Experience developing another leader: a manager who reported to you, or an engineer you grew into a tech lead or EM role with real accountability attached. Tell us where they are now.
  • A track record shipping mission-critical software to production, and living with it afterwards. We all make mistakes; what sets you apart is that you own yours and turn them into something better.
  • Experience owning prioritization and estimation for a team, including saying no, not now, and explaining why.
  • Experience giving direct developmental feedback, and at least one case where you managed someone through underperformance with real support attached.
  • Currently shipping, or recently shipping, production code in at least one layer of our stack (backend (Ruby, Python, ...), web frontends (React), iOS, or Android,) with enough range to follow the conversation in the others and review architecture decisions critically.
  • Comfort with an expert-generalist team model, where a backend-heavy builder ships in the mobile app and a mobile-heavy one ships in the backend. You understand how transformative this model is, and you should be able to name the risks and opportunities it brings.
  • Hands-on experience directing AI agents through real world production changes, and a considered view on where they help and where they produce work someone else has to redo.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and telemetry, at the level where you can tell whether your squad's operational story checks out or falls short.
  • Excellent written communication. Much of this job is writing things down clearly once so they do not have to be argued four times.

Technologies we use:

Ruby on Rails, Python (Flask, FastAPI), React, native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), native Android (Kotlin), PostgreSQL, GraphQL, AWS (RDS, SQS), Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab, Datadog, PagerDuty.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote, with periodic travel to LTS headquarters in Herndon, Virginia.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, with periodic travel to LTS headquarters in Herndon, Virginia. Preference will be given to candidates residing in the DMV area (Washington D.C., Maryland, and Virginia). Candidates outside the DMV area may also be considered.

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Compensation range: $200,000 - $275,000

LTS is seeking a hands-on finance leader to own enterprise financial planning and analysis across its Health, Federal IT Services, and Emergency Response divisions. Federal government contracting experience is strongly preferred. The VP, FP&A will connect program and division performance to the Company’s financial outlook, give executive leaders clear insight into risks and opportunities, and help turn financial analysis into operating decisions.

This role also carries assigned Deputy CFO responsibilities under LTS’s Delegation of Authority. The VP may serve as Acting CFO when formally designated. The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly with financial data and operating leaders, while bringing the breadth and judgment needed to carry assigned Deputy CFO responsibilities.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the annual operating plan, rolling forecasts, and consolidated enterprise forecast, integrating program performance, funded backlog, pipeline, staffing, indirect rates, margins, cash, and working-capital assumptions.
  • Partner with Division General Managers as their senior finance advisor, providing P&L insight, testing assumptions, and supporting decisions on growth, staffing, investments, and corrective actions.
  • Work closely with the COO to strengthen financial accountability and translate performance gaps into actions with clear owners and expected outcomes.
  • Analyze contract and program profitability, including labor mix, subcontractor costs, indirect-rate impacts, pricing assumptions, and cash timing.
  • Present concise financial reporting and recommendations to the CEO, CFO, COO, and executive leadership team.
  • Build reliable financial models, KPIs, and reporting processes that improve forecast accuracy, program-level visibility, and decision-making.
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer to connect business and individual performance with LTS’s pay-for-performance philosophy. Provide financial modeling, performance measures, and affordability analysis to inform merit, bonus, and incentive decisions.
  • Lead assigned Deputy CFO responsibilities within delegated authority, including cash management and support for broader financial planning, controls, risk management, and financial leadership continuity.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive finance experience, including senior leadership in FP&A, business-unit finance, divisional finance, or enterprise financial management.
  • Experience managing integrated forecasts and P&Ls across multiple divisions, business units, or complex programs.
  • Strong command of forecasting, budgeting, financial modeling, variance analysis, cash flow, working capital, and executive reporting.
  • The judgment and communication skills to advise senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and recommend practical action.
  • Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills, plus experience with ERP, project-accounting, planning, or business-intelligence systems.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Finance leadership experience with a federal government contractor, including program-level forecasting and profitability across government contracts.
  • Working knowledge of indirect-rate management, project accounting, contract types and pricing, and FAR/CAS and DCAA requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with Deltek Costpoint and the ability to use project and financial data to inform division and enterprise decisions.
  • An MBA, CPA, CMA, or comparable credential is also preferred.

What’s In It for You?

  • The Opportunity to support high-visibility federal missions
  • A culture that values innovation, growth, and collaboration
  • Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies
  • Comprehensive benefits for you and your family
  • A career path that rewards ambition and performance

If you’re ready to push boundaries, sharpen your skills, and join a team that is passionate about building what’s next, we’d love to meet you. Apply today and let’s build a future together!

Pay Range
$200,000—$275,000 USD

LTS shares salary ranges to promote transparency. Compensation ranges are provided for informational purposes, and final compensation may vary based on experience, skills, location, and role requirements.

LTS is committed to offering eligible employees comprehensive benefits that will provide them with options intended to meet their needs and the needs of their family.

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software.

We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations.

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Team: Engineering – Platform Consulting

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. Our work blends clean architecture, practical engineering, and a startup mindset.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

What You'll Do

Backend & Integrations

  • Build and maintain REST APIs using Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django/FastAPI), .NET (C#/), Golang, or comparable frameworks, powering dispatch, service orders, billing, and asset workflows.

  • Design relational schemas, migrations, and high-performance queries against SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

  • Implement workflow automation, asynchronous job processing, audit trails, reporting, and intelligent backend features — including AI-assisted or LLM-backed capabilities where they add value.

  • Ensure API performance, reliability, and security across high-volume operational workloads.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional development experience (backend/API focus).

  • Strong hands-on experience shipping production REST APIs in at least one of: Java (Spring Boot), Python, .NET (C#), or Golang.

  • Solid SQL experience — relational modeling, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures.

  • Practical experience with an ORM (JPA/Hibernate, Entity Framework, SQLAlchemy, GORM, or equivalent) and migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, or similar).

  • Experience maintaining and refactoring legacy codebases.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP/CRM).

  • Comfort with concurrency, messaging, and asynchronous processing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Testing discipline (JUnit/Mockito, pytest, xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, or equivalent depending on stack).

  • Basic working knowledge of Angular + TypeScript for occasional frontend contributions.

  • Good proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, Claude, LLM-backed automation) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, agile consulting environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • SQL performance tuning and query optimization.

  • Experience with Azure (App Service, Functions, Service Bus), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

  • FSA/HSA options

  • BYOD reimbursement

jobs.excerpt: Here's the full job description, keeping the original flow and blending in the retention metrics and cybersecurity experience: About BreachLockBreachLock is a global leader in offensive security, helping organizations proactively reduce cyber risk through Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS), Attack Surface Management (ASM), Adversarial Exposure Validation (AEV), and Red Teaming.
jobs.description:
Here's the full job description, keeping the original flow and blending in the retention metrics and cybersecurity experience:

About BreachLock

BreachLock is a global leader in offensive security, helping organizations proactively reduce cyber risk through Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS), Attack Surface Management (ASM), Adversarial Exposure Validation (AEV), and Red Teaming. Our unified platform combines expert-led testing with continuous, automated validation to give organizations real-time visibility into exploitable risks across their environments. Trusted by enterprises worldwide, BreachLock delivers attacker-perspective insights that help security teams prioritize what matters most and stay ahead of evolving threats.

The Opportunity

BreachLock is looking for a proactive, self-directed Senior Account Manager to lead growth within our existing enterprise customer base. This role focuses entirely on current accounts, not net-new logo acquisition. You will own a portfolio of large, established accounts and drive measurable expansion through new stakeholders, new business units, new use cases, and increased contract value, while protecting and growing retention across your book. Success in this role depends on spotting opportunity before it's obvious, building relationship depth across each account, and working closely with our Delivery team to make sure what we sell is delivered well, so that strong delivery becomes the springboard for the next expansion conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of large, existing enterprise accounts and build multi-year account growth strategies
  • Own retention and expansion results for your book of business, including Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and renewal rate
  • Proactively identify and build relationships with new stakeholders within accounts, including security, IT, procurement, compliance, and business-unit leaders, beyond the initial point of contact
  • Drive expansion revenue through upsell, cross-sell, and broader adoption of BreachLock services across business units and geographies
  • Conduct account mapping and whitespace analysis to surface untapped budget and stakeholder influence
  • Partner closely with the Delivery/Engagement organization to monitor project health, flag renewal risk early, and turn delivery outcomes into expansion opportunities
  • Manage a high-volume, diverse account portfolio while maintaining strategic depth on top accounts
  • Own forecasting, pipeline accuracy, and renewal/expansion contract negotiations for your book of business
  • Serve as the internal point of coordination across sales engineering, delivery, and leadership for your accounts

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in account management, client success, or enterprise sales
  • Experience at a cybersecurity company, ideally a penetration testing, PTaaS, or offensive security services provider
  • Demonstrated success expanding existing accounts (not solely net-new sales), with quantifiable results such as NRR of 110%+ and GRR of 90%+
  • A track record of proactive account growth, identifying and pursuing new stakeholders and opportunities without being prompted
  • Experience in a high-growth or scaleup environment, with comfort operating amid ambiguity and evolving processes
  • Proven ability to manage a large and varied portfolio of enterprise accounts concurrently

If you're technically strong, care about shipping quality software, and want your work to visibly move the product forward, we'd love to meet you.


The Opportunity

As a Software Developer, you'll design, build, and ship features across our platforms. You'll work closely with product owners, QA, and support to take well-scoped requirements from design through to production, and you'll have real input into how those requirements get shaped in the first place. We're rebuilding our engineering practices as we scale post-acquisition, so you'll help set the standard for code quality, review, and release process — not just follow one that's already fixed in stone.


What Success Looks Like

During your first year, you'll:

  • Ship a meaningful body of production code across platforms.
  • Build a track record of reliable, well-tested releases with minimal regressions.
  • Partner effectively with product owners, QA, and support across the full SDLC.
  • Debug and resolve production issues efficiently, with clear root-cause analysis.
  • Contribute ideas that improve our engineering practices as we scale.


What You'll Do

  • Design, build, test, and ship features across the platforms.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and participate actively in code review.
  • Debug and resolve production issues, partnering with support and QA as needed.
  • Work closely with product owners to clarify requirements and flag technical tradeoffs early.
  • Follow and help improve our SDLC practices (branching, review, release, QA).
  • Participate in technical design discussions and architecture decisions for your area.


Why This Role Matters

Every feature our operators rely on — bookings, payments, waivers, reporting — is only as good as the engineering behind it. As we rebuild our product organization post-acquisition, the developers who join now will shape not just what gets built, but how reliably and how well it's built for years to come.

You'll Thrive Here If...

  • You want ownership over how you solve a problem, not just a ticket to close.
  • Accountability motivates you.
  • You appreciate direct feedback because it helps you improve.
  • You like experimenting, learning, and helping build better ways of working.
  • You care as much about your teammates' success as your own.
  • You want to help build something, not simply inherit it

Our Hiring Process

We believe hiring should be thoughtful, transparent, and fast. Our process typically includes:

  • Introductory conversation
  • Hiring manager interview
  • Technical assessment / pairing exercise
  • Leadership conversations
  • Final decision


Join Us

We're building more than a codebase. We're building the engineering foundation that will define the next chapter of Clubspeed and Resova. If you're looking for a place where you'll be trusted with real ownership over your work, and rewarded for the outcomes you drive, we'd love to hear from you.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

We're far more interested in judgment, ownership, and coachability than checking every box.

You'll likely be successful if you have:

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, ideally in SaaS or a high-growth product company.
  • Comfort working across the full SDLC — from requirements through code review to release and support.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, and the discipline to write tests that hold up in production.
  • Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders when clarifying requirements.
  • A bias toward shipping: you'd rather get a well-scoped version live and iterate than wait for perfect.
  • A commitment to iterative development: you build for today with tomorrow in mind, favoring designs and architecture decisions that stay easy to change as requirements evolve.
  • The ability to pivot quickly as market needs shift, implementing sound design decisions in both code and SDLC process.


Technical Requirements

We run on two distinct architectures, so the specific stack depends on which product area you join. You'll likely draw on some combination of:

  • Languages & frameworks: C# and VB.NET (.NET Framework, ASP.NET Core / Web API), PHP/Laravel, TypeScript/Node.js (Express, Next.js), and Angular.
  • Databases: SQL Server and MySQL.
  • Cloud & infrastructure: AWS (ECS, SQS, S3, CloudFront, SSM Parameter Store), Docker and GitHub Actions CI/CD, alongside Windows Server/IIS for our on-prem systems.
  • Payments: experience integrating with payment gateway APIs (e.g., Stripe, Adyen) is a strong plus, given how central integrated payments are to our platform.
  • Deep expertise in any one of these isn't required — comfort moving between modern cloud-native services and established on-prem/monolithic systems matters more than prior experience with our exact stack.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary (between $110,000-$130,000 CAD)

For more than a decade, we’ve worked to show that with the mindful use of technology, we can break down barriers, meet community needs, and find real solutions.

At Code for America, you contribute to exciting work while learning and developing in a supportive and flexible environment. Our compensation and benefits are holistic and thoughtfully curated to represent our employees and our mission. Help us drive real generational change that lasts.

Code for America is looking for a talented Staff Solutions Engineer who will collaborate with government partners and deliver technical guidance, transforming the way our government delivers services to communities in need.

You will spend time with key government agencies to build rapport with their technical team, understand their technical needs, and develop a shared understanding of how Code for America can help them achieve their goals. This will involve identifying and designing technical solutions to improve access to their programs.

Solutions Engineers at Code for America are an integral component of all of our program areas. There are currently three focused program areas at Code for America:

  • Criminal Justice, which focuses on Automatic Record Clearance,
  • Tax Benefits, which focuses on free trustworthy tax services and simplified tax filing,
  • And the Social Safety Net. Focus areas in this portfolio include food benefits, integrated benefits applications, and training & capacity building.

This role will report to the Solutions Engineering Manager and is expected to travel no more than 10% of the time.

  • 7+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solutions Architect with experience leading projects and interacting with customers.

jobs.description:
Nelnet is a diversified and innovative company committed to enriching lives through the power of service as a student loan servicer, professional services company, consumer loan originator and servicer, payments processor, renewable energy solutions, and K-12 and higher education expert. For over 40 years, Nelnet has been serving its customers, associates, and communities.

The perks of working at Nelnet go beyond our benefits package. When you join the Nelnet team, you're part of a community invested in the success of each individual. That support comes through in our work, as we are united by our mission of creating opportunities for people where they live, learn, and work.

This role owns the technical build and deployment of Nelnet’s GenAI solutions on Google Cloud, specifically the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform — Google’s 2026 evolution of Vertex AI, unifying model selection, agent building, and orchestration with what were formerly separate Vertex AI and Agentspace products. The GCP / Gemini Enterprise Engineer translates the Forward Deployed Engineer’s scoped delivery backlog into working agentic solutions, model integrations, and data connections that meet client requirements and Nelnet’s engineering standards.

Operating as the core build engineer within Nelnet’s GenAI delivery team, this role is responsible for the technical implementation of agentic assistants, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and model integrations for higher education and SLED clients, in close collaboration with the Data Engineer on data readiness and the AgentOps Engineer on infrastructure and deployment. The Forward Deployed Engineer and Engagement Manager own client scoping and relationship management; this role owns solution build quality, technical architecture, and delivery execution.

Comepnsation range for this role: $130,000-$150,000 based on experience

Key Responsibilities:

Agentic Solution Development

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic assistants and GenAI applications on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Agent Builder, Workspace Studio, Model Garden), translating backlog items from the Forward Deployed Engineer into working solutions.

  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and grounding using the platform’s search and grounding capabilities.

  • Integrate Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol and multi-agent orchestration patterns where engagements require them.

Model Selection & Tuning

  • Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models from Model Garden (including Gemini and third-party models) based on client use case, cost, and performance requirements.

  • Fine-tune or prompt-engineer models to meet accuracy, safety, and compliance requirements specific to higher education and SLED data.

  • Monitor model performance and iterate based on client feedback and delivery retrospectives.

  • Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and regression test sets to validate agent accuracy, grounding, and hallucination rates prior to release, with added rigor for student-facing and FERPA-sensitive use cases.

Platform & Integration Engineering

  • Build live API and tool-calling integrations so agentic solutions can take real-time actions in client systems (SIS, ERP, casework systems) — distinct from the batch data pipelines the Data Engineer builds for analytics and RAG ingestion; partner with the Data Engineer on shared data access patterns and the AgentOps Engineer on infrastructure.

  • Maintain technical documentation of solution architecture, model configurations, and integration points for internal reuse.

  • Build solutions for reuse across engagements, converting one-off client work into repeatable playbooks and connectors.

Delivery Execution & Quality

  • Execute against the delivery backlog owned by the Forward Deployed Engineer, providing technical estimates, flagging build risks, and delivering working solutions on schedule.

  • Participate in technical discovery sessions with the Forward Deployed Engineer to validate feasibility before commitments are made to clients.

  • Conduct code and configuration reviews to maintain quality and security standards across the practice.

  • Serve as the quality gate in release readiness, confirming evaluation and regression test results before a build moves to production, alongside the AgentOps Engineer’s operational readiness sign-off.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with the Data Engineer to ensure data pipelines and classification support agentic solution requirements.

  • Partner with the AgentOps Engineer on deployment, monitoring, and environment management.

  • Provide technical input to the Forward Deployed Engineer and Engagement Manager on scope, risk, and timeline.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/agentic AI solutions (e.g., LLM-based assistants, RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration) in production — required. Direct experience with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Agent Builder, Model Garden, Workspace Studio) or its predecessor Vertex AI strongly preferred; candidates with deep GenAI experience on other platforms (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs) who can ramp quickly on Google's stack will be considered.

  • Experience with large language models and prompt engineering, fine-tuning, or grounding techniques; direct experience with Gemini models (Gemini API / Gemini Enterprise) preferred.

  • Familiarity with the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol and multi-agent orchestration patterns.

  • Working knowledge of cloud data, compute, and access-control services supporting AI workloads (e.g., BigQuery/Snowflake, Cloud Run/GKE or equivalent container platforms, IAM) sufficient to ramp quickly on Google Cloud's specific implementations.

  • Google Cloud certification preferred (Professional Machine Learning Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect), demonstrating hands-on technical fluency; foundational/business-oriented certifications (e.g., Generative AI Leader) do not satisfy this preference.

  • Experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and integrating LLM-based solutions with enterprise data sources.

  • Software engineering fundamentals sufficient to build production-quality, maintainable integrations (Python and/or relevant SDKs).

  • Experience building evaluation harnesses or test suites for LLM/agent outputs (accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate) and running regression tests before releases.

  • Ability to work from a scoped backlog and translate technical requirements from the Forward Deployed Engineer into working solutions.

Desired Competencies:

  • Demonstrates strong technical judgment in selecting the right model, architecture, and approach for a given client constraint.

  • Builds for reuse, translating one-off client work into repeatable technical assets.

  • Communicates technical trade-offs clearly to the Forward Deployed Engineer and Engagement Manager.

  • Adapts quickly to platform and product changes given the pace of change in Google’s AI product stack.

  • Takes ownership of solution quality from build through deployment.

  • Collaborates effectively with Data Engineering and AgentOps counterparts.

  • Maintains composure and problem-solving focus when technical blockers threaten delivery timelines.

  • Seeks continuous learning given the fast-evolving nature of the Google Cloud AI and agent platform.

Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, HSA and FSA, generous earned time off, 401K/student loan repayment, life insurance & AD&D insurance, employee assistance program, employee stock purchase program, tuition reimbursement, performance-based incentive pay, short- and long-term disability, and a robust wellness program. Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:

It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
  • Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.

jobs.excerpt: Insurance Discover | Healthcare Revenue Cycle | Advanced Analytics, AI & Big Data Level: Senior / Lead-capable Function: Product Analytics & Optimization Domain: Healthcare RCM / Coverage Discovery Tools: SQL, Databricks, AI/ML, BI About the RoleImpact you will make.
jobs.description:
Insurance Discover | Healthcare Revenue Cycle | Advanced Analytics, AI & Big Data

Level: Senior / Lead-capable Function: Product Analytics & Optimization Domain: Healthcare RCM / Coverage Discovery Tools: SQL, Databricks, AI/ML, BI

About the Role

Impact you will make. As a Principal Data Analyst on the Product Optimization team, you will turn complex healthcare revenue cycle data into evidence-based product decisions for FinThrive’s Insurance Discover product. This role is designed for someone who is deeply technical, statistically curious, and comfortable working across very large datasets to identify root causes, quantify product performance, and recommend measurable improvements. Why this role matters. You will partner with Product Management, Technology, Operations, Finance, Sales, and customer-facing teams to uncover data quality issues, coverage discovery gaps, operational inefficiencies, and opportunity areas that directly affect customer outcomes and recovered revenue. The ideal candidate can move fluidly from SQL and Databricks analysis to executive-ready storytelling, translating technical findings into practical recommendations and prioritized action plans.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and maintain deep subject matter expertise in Insurance Discover, including product lifecycle, customer workflows, eligibility / coverage discovery logic, data ingestion, matching behavior, operational processes, and the value chain required to deliver customer outcomes.
  • Analyze large, complex healthcare revenue cycle datasets to identify trends, gaps, anomalies, failure patterns, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve product accuracy, performance, scalability, and customer impact.
  • Use advanced SQL and big-data tooling such as Databricks to query, structure, profile, and interpret high-volume datasets across multiple sources and operational workflows.
  • Apply descriptive, diagnostic, and basic statistical techniques to assess product performance, validate hypotheses, measure impact, and distinguish signal from noise in complex data environments.
  • Leverage AI-assisted analytics, automation, and emerging AI capabilities to accelerate pattern detection, anomaly identification, root-cause exploration, documentation, and insight generation while maintaining strong quality controls.
  • Build metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical frameworks that measure the effectiveness of product enhancements, operational optimizations, and customer-facing outcomes.
  • Translate technical analysis into clear recommendations, business cases, decision support, and executive-ready narratives for Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Sales, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to prioritize improvements, define success measures, support implementation, and monitor whether changes deliver the intended business and customer outcomes.
  • Support high-impact initiatives related to data integrity, coverage discovery performance, integration workflows, reporting accuracy, process optimization, and product stabilization / enhancement efforts.
  • Become a trusted analytical partner who can challenge assumptions, frame ambiguous problems, and bring structure to complex data questions in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or another quantitative / technical field; advanced degree preferred but not required.
  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business analytics, healthcare analytics, revenue cycle analytics, or a related analytical role.
  • Healthcare revenue cycle experience, ideally with exposure to eligibility, coverage discovery, claims, denials, patient access, payer data, provider workflows, or healthcare data exchange.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregation logic, data validation, performance-aware querying, and analysis across large, messy datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with big-data environments or cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Synapse, Spark, or comparable tools.
  • Strong statistical and analytical foundation, with the ability to apply practical methods such as cohort analysis, segmentation, variance analysis, trend analysis, outlier detection, correlation, sampling, confidence-based reasoning, or experiment / impact measurement.
  • Technical fluency with data pipelines, data models, data quality concepts, APIs / data exchange patterns, and the practical realities of working with operational healthcare data.
  • Experience using AI-enabled tools or analytics approaches to improve productivity, identify patterns, summarize findings, document analysis, or support decision-making; must be comfortable experimenting with responsible AI use cases.
  • Proficiency in data visualization and storytelling using Tableau, Power BI, SSRS, Excel, or similar tools, with the ability to create leadership-ready insights rather than simply reporting numbers.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including translating complex findings into concise recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and next steps.
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, prioritization, and project management skills; ability to drive multiple initiatives with minimal supervision in a collaborative, matrixed environment.

Preferred / Differentiating Experience

  • Experience supporting product optimization, product operations, product performance management, or data-driven product strategy in a healthcare technology environment.
  • Working knowledge of payer / provider data, EHR or practice management workflows, eligibility transactions, insurance discovery, coverage verification, or revenue recovery processes.
  • Practical Python or PySpark experience for data manipulation, statistical exploration, automation, or repeatable analytical workflows.
  • Experience designing analytical QA checks, data reconciliation logic, exception reporting, or repeatable monitoring frameworks for operational data products.
  • Familiarity with model-assisted analysis, machine learning concepts, predictive analytics, or experimentation frameworks; ability to partner with data science or engineering teams when deeper modeling is required.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces where the first task is to define the problem, locate the data, validate assumptions, and create a structured path to action.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Azure Cloud Architect serves as a specialized Subject Matter Expert (SME), providing high-level strategic leadership, technical guidance, and hands-on engineering direction for complex cloud projects. This role is responsible for validating architectural designs, engineering Mission Landing Zones (MLZ), guiding the implementation of Zero Trust Architectures (ZTA), and overseeing the evolution of Cloud Native Security Stacks (CNSS). You will act as a bridge between high-level strategy and technical execution, ensuring that cloud environments are secure, automated, resilient, and aligned with Department of Defense (DoD) requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Strategic Design & Validation
    • Validate technical Engineering Assessments in close coordination with Cloud Engineers to ensure proposed solutions are viable and scalable.
    • Lead the engineering, deployment, and customization of Azure Mission Landing Zones (MLZ) using automated Infrastructure as Code (IaC) workflows.
    • Deliver specialized design recommendations across critical pillars: data storage, identity management, governance, and monitoring solutions.
    • Provide expert guidance on Mission Owner (MO) cloud transition strategies and collaborate with Program Managers to oversee the implementation of proposed architectures.
    • Advise on F5 configuration activities and evaluate the potential operational impacts of migrating from legacy appliances to a cloud-native security stack.
  • Security & Compliance Leadership
    • Provide strategic recommendations for the maintenance and sustainment of the DoD Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) Functional Requirements Document (FRD) within Azure Government.
    • Lead the implementation and long-term sustainment of the future Cloud Native Security Stack and potential Shared Services.
    • Deliver hands-on expertise and strategic configurations for Azure Firewall Premium (AFW-P) with IDPS, User-Defined Routing (UDR), and advanced hub-and-spoke network topologies.
    • Author, enforce, and maintain custom Azure Policies to ensure continuous compliance with DoD landing zone standards.
    • Guide the transition toward Zero Trust Architectures to meet modern federal security mandates.
  • Operational Excellence & Resilience
    • Build, optimize, and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Azure DevOps) to automate the deployment of cloud infrastructure.
    • Coordinate with Cloud Operations Engineers to design and ensure high availability and failover capabilities across both Azure Government and Commercial environments.
    • Ensure all architectural designs support the rigorous requirements of Azure Government and applicable commercial cloud services.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Basic:

● Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

● Experience: 2–4 years of cloud engineering experience with a deep background in Azure administration and cloud architecture.

● DoD Expertise: Specific expertise in the strategic maintenance and sustainment of DoD SCCA functional requirements.

● Technical Proficiencies: Hands-on experience writing Infrastructure as Code using Azure Bicep or ARM templates. Strong proficiency with CI/CD platforms, DevSecOps toolchains, and git-based workflows.

● Certification: Security+ certification.

● Security Clearance: U.S. Citizenship and the ability to obtain a DoD Top Secret clearance.

Preferred:

● Active DoD Top Secret clearance.

● Advanced Cloud certification (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect Associate).

● Proven experience deploying and maintaining Azure Mission Landing Zone (MLZ) repositories

● Proven experience implementing DISA STIG configurations and hardening automated deployments.

● Experience supporting compliance for DoD SRG and NIST SP 800-53 security controls.

● Certification: Active Security+ certification.

Location: Ventura, CA or Remote

This role offers the exciting opportunity to contribute to our growing AI security practice.

  • AI Security Architecture & Assessment: Advise on and assess the security posture of AI/ML systems, including LLMs, GenAI pipelines, and model serving infrastructure — identifying vulnerabilities, attack surfaces, and gaps against industry frameworks (e.g., OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS).
  • Threat Modeling for AI Systems: Lead threat modeling exercises specific to AI workloads, covering adversarial inputs, prompt injection, model inversion, data poisoning, and supply chain risks across SaaS, self-hosted, and local AI deployments.

  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a trusted security advisor bridging business stakeholders, AI/ML engineers, IT operations, and information security teams on all matters related to AI risk and security.
  • Stay Current on AI Threat Landscape: Continuously track emerging AI security research, adversarial techniques, regulatory developments, and vendor security advisories to keep client guidance relevant and proactive.
  • Security Documentation & Standards: Produce and maintain security architecture documentation, risk assessments, control frameworks, and guidelines tailored to the organization's AI environment.
  • Strategic AI Security Roadmap: Contribute to the development of a long-term AI security strategy, including prioritized remediation roadmaps, capability maturity assessments, and investment recommendations.
  • Security Awareness & Education: Develop and deliver training and awareness content for technical and non-technical stakeholders on AI-specific risks, responsible AI usage, and secure development practices for AI-powered applications.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering with a significant focus on cloud security and/or AppSec
  • Hands-on experience implementing, managing, securing, and supporting Agentic AI solutions within an enterprise context
  • Familiarity with major cloud service provider AI-focused services such as AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex
  • Proficiency in at least one relevant programming language, preferably Python
  • Solid understanding of generative AI concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), context engineering, agentic tool usage, and foundational AI/ML principles
  • Deep knowledge and real operational experience in the usage of Agentic Coding assistants like Claude Code, Open Code, Cursor, or Codex
  • Strong written and oral communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated experience applying security principles to AI implementations, including data protection, access controls, and threat modeling for AI systems
  • Understanding of AI-specific security challenges including prompt injection, data poisoning, supply chain security, and model extraction attacks
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes

  • Certifications such as:
    • AWS Certified AI Practitioner/AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer
    • Azure AI Engineer Associate

  • Understanding or experience with model fine-tuning techniques
  • Familiarity with red teaming of agentic systems

jobs.description:
Job Title: Engineering Lead
Location: Remote (Work from home eligible)
Company Overview: Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in utilities and energy sectors. We empower organizations by converting complex data into actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project outcomes. Our background and expertise enable us to drive and deliver transformation and operational excellence for our clients.
Practice Overview: The Business Integration Services (BIS) practice is a high-growth technology consulting practice delivering enterprise-scale integration, digital transformation, and solution design engagements for complex, multi-stakeholder clients. The practice is in its third year of a structured build and scale phase, expanding from a founding team to a full-capability organization spanning four pillars: Project Management (PMO), Business/Technical Analysis, Solution Architecture, and Engineering.
The practice operates at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, working closely with technology partners and vendors to deliver outcomes that are both architecturally sound and commercially meaningful. It is entering a pivotal phase of maturity, transitioning from practice-leads delivery to a structured operating model with defined build paths, methodology standards, and delivery governance.
Position Overview: The Engineering Lead is a senior technical leader who builds and runs the engineering capability of BIS practice. This is a dual-role position: the Engineering Lead is both a hands-on technical practitioner who contributes directly to client engagements and a people manager responsible for hiring, developing, and retaining Junior Developers who will grow into the practice's core delivery workforce. This person is also a people manager while owning the internal operating infrastructure that allows the practice to scale without losing delivery quality or team cohesion. This is a founding role for the Engineering pillar. The Engineering Lead will define how engineering is practiced, how the Junior Developer team is structured, how quality standards are set, and how the pillar integrates with the BA and SA functions to deliver coherent solutions. The right candidate is someone who has already led small engineering teams in consulting or professional services contexts and is energized by the opportunity to build a function from a blank page.
This role demands strong operational leadership, industry knowledge, and technical fluency to drive results in complex client environments.
What makes this role distinctive: Most Engineering Lead roles sit inside an established function. This one is a founding role — the first engineering hire the practice has made. The person who takes this role will shape not just what the team builds, but how the practice thinks about engineering as a discipline. That requires both technical depth and organizational ambition.

Key Responsibilities:
Technical Leadership & Delivery:
  • Lead the engineering delivery function across all active client engagements, ensuring technical quality, architectural alignment, and delivery commitments are met
  • Serve as the senior technical authority on the engineering pillar — accountable for code quality, technical standards, tooling choices, and engineering methodology across the team
  • Contribute hands-on to client engagements, particularly in the early months as the Junior Developer team is being onboard and ramped to delivery readiness
  • Partner with the Solution Architecture pillar to translate architectural designs into engineering execution plans — bridging the gap between what should be built and how it gets built
  • Review and approve technical deliverables produced by Junior Developers before they are presented to clients or integrated into production environments
  • Lead technical scoping sessions with clients and partners, translating business requirements into engineering estimates, sprint plans, and delivery roadmaps
  • Own the engineering section of client-facing documentation: technical specifications, integration designs, deployment guides, and post-implementation handover materials
People Leadership & Junior Developer Development:
  • Directly manage Junior Developers — own their performance reviews, career development plans, day-to-day workload, and professional growth within the practice
  • Build a structured onboarding program for all Junior Developer hires, ensuring they reach delivery readiness within 60-90 days and are integrated into the practice culture
  • Provide daily technical mentorship and coaching to Junior Developers — code reviews, pair programming sessions, architecture walkthroughs, and real-time feedback on client deliverables
  • Set clear, measurable performance expectations for Junior Developers tied to technical milestones, delivery quality, and professional conduct standards
  • Identify development gaps early and build targeted learning plans — whether through internal mentorship, external training, certification programs, or stretch assignments on active engagements
  • Create a psychologically safe team environment where Junior Developers are encouraged to ask questions, surface technical risks, and grow without fear of punitive judgment for early-career mistakes
  • Plan for team growth — as the practice expands, the Engineering Lead will define when the team needs a mid-level engineer, what the role should look like, and how to build a sustainable engineering career ladder within the practice
Engineering Practice & Standards:
  • Define and maintain the engineering methodology for the BIS practice: coding standards, version control practices, code review processes, testing frameworks, deployment protocols, and documentation standards
  • Establish the technology stack and tooling used across client engagements — making deliberate, defensible choices about languages, frameworks, integration platforms, and development environments
  • Build reusable engineering assets — accelerators, templates, boilerplate components, and integration patterns — that reduce delivery time on future engagements and demonstrate the practice's technical maturity to clients
  • Own engineering quality assurance: define what 'done' looks like for engineering deliverables, implement QA checkpoints in the delivery process, and ensure Junior Developer output meets the bar before it reaches clients
  • Stay current on emerging technologies relevant to the practice's focus areas — enterprise integration, digital transformation platforms, cloud-native architectures, API ecosystems — and bring relevant innovations into the practice's capability set
Partner & Vendor Technical Engagement
  • Represent the engineering pillar in conversations with technology partners and vendors, including technical solutioning, platform capability discussions, and proof-of-concept evaluations
  • Build and maintain technical relationships with key vendor engineering teams — ensuring the practice has access to sandbox environments, technical support, early release programs, and partner-level technical resources
  • Evaluate new technology platforms and vendor capabilities against the practice's client needs — providing leadership with clear technical recommendations on which partnerships to invest in and why
  • Lead technical demos and proof-of-concept builds for clients and partners, showcasing the engineering team's capability and the practice's ability to deliver on complex integration challenges.
Cross-Pillar Collaboration:
  • Participate in the weekly delivery coordination sync with the leads — providing engineering status updates, flagging technical risks, and aligning on resource deployment across active engagements
  • Collaborate on requirements translation — ensuring business requirements are technically feasible before commitments are made to clients
  • Contribute to the practice's go-to-market positioning — helping to articulate the engineering capability in proposals, capability statements, and client presentations
  • Support preparing engineering-related content for leadership reporting, practice reviews, and project/partner related updates
Educational Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree (Masters) is preferred.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a lead, principal, or staff engineer role carrying technical ownership of a product, platform, or delivery engagement
  • Demonstrated experience managing or mentoring junior engineers — comfortable with performance feedback, technical coaching, and career development conversations
  • Proven delivery experience in consulting, professional services, or client-facing environment — understands the difference between building internal products and delivering to external clients with commercial accountability
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in at least two of: enterprise integration platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services, AWS), cloud-native development (Azure, AWS, GCP), API design and management, microservices architecture, or digital transformation platforms
  • Experience leading technical scoping, estimation, and solution design in a pre-sales or project delivery context
  • Demonstrated ability to translate architectural designs into engineering execution — works fluently with architects without requiring over-specification
  • Strong communication skills — can explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders, write clear documentation, and represent engineering credibly in client-facing settings
  • Proven track record as a people manager — comfortable owning performance reviews, difficult conversations, retention risk, and career development for experienced individual contributors
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in SaaS companies or with system integrators.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust with experienced peers and direct reports who have strong professional identities and do not require or respond well to directive management styles
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, structurally evolving environment where processes are being built while delivery is ongoing
  • Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to travel domestically and(or) internationally if required.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience building or scaling an engineering function from early-stage — has defined standards, selected tooling, or stood up a team with minimal existing infrastructure
  • Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns: event-driven architecture, ETL pipelines, middleware orchestration, API gateway design, and data synchronization across heterogeneous systems
  • Exposure to digital transformation delivery contexts: ERP implementations, CRM integrations, digital workplace tooling, or cloud migration programs
  • Experience working alongside business analysts and solution architects in integrated delivery teams — understands how to receive and refine BA outputs and align to SA constraints
  • Prior experience with technology partner ecosystems (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft, SAP, ServiceNow, MuleSoft) — holds or has held partner-level technical credentials
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipeline design, and infrastructure-as-code in a consulting delivery context
Preferred Certifications:
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect — Associate or Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or similar certifications.
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer, ServiceNow Certified Application Developer, SAP Certified Development Associate or similar certifications.

The salary range for this position is provided in good faith and is subject to variation based on geographic location, candidate experience, and market conditions. Final compensation will be determined after a comprehensive evaluation of the candidate’s qualifications and alignment with the role.

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws—including but not limited to those in California, Colorado, New York, Washington, and other jurisdictions—we disclose salary ranges to promote equity and transparency. Where required by law, compensation and benefits information will be included in job postings or made available upon request.

This job description outlines the primary responsibilities and standards of the position but is not exhaustive. Employees may be asked to perform additional duties that are reasonably related to their role and consistent with company policies and applicable labor laws.

jobs.description:
About us

Orchid Software Solutions is the engineering group behind the SeedTrust / VeraTru family of companies. We build and operate software for healthcare and family-building services: escrow for surrogacy and egg donation, agency management for fertility clinics, medical records retrieval, insurance risk management, and IDRE.

IDRE is our platform for Independent Dispute Resolution under the federal No Surprises Act. When a healthcare provider and an insurer disagree on what an out-of-network service should be paid, the dispute goes through a federal arbitration process, and our platform manages those cases end to end for our clients — hundreds of new disputes a day, with core business logic in how we calculate settlements and track case state. It's a fast-growing, high-volume product, and the team is actively expanding to keep up.

The team you'd join

IDRE's engineering team is small and senior by design: an engineering manager, a handful of senior engineers, a senior QA, and a PM, working closely together rather than in isolated silos — no hand-off-and-forget here. You'd report to, and work daily alongside, engineers who care about the craft and about getting the domain right, not just shipping tickets. We're a genuinely multicultural, fully remote team spread across the US and LATAM, and we've been deliberate about building a culture where different technical opinions get heard and new ideas aren't shut down because "that's how it's always been done."

The role

This is an independent-contractor, full-stack Senior Software Engineer role, based in Latin America. You'll work across React/Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL (MySQL/PostgreSQL), owning features end to end — from a product conversation through to what's running in production — rather than working in a narrow lane someone else defines for you. Hands-on experience with financial or transactional systems (payments, billing, claims, settlements) is directly relevant, since settlement calculation and case-state tracking sit at the core of what IDRE does; prior IDR/No Surprises Act knowledge is not required, that part is very learnable on the job.

Why this role, specifically

  • Real ownership from day one — this isn't a maintenance seat on a mature product; IDRE is still being actively built out, and your technical decisions will shape how it works for years.
  • A genuine domain to go deep in — healthcare dispute resolution and payments logic is a niche most engineers never get exposed to, and depth here is a real differentiator for your own career.
  • A small, senior team means your voice actually carries weight in architecture and product conversations — not diluted across a 40-person org.
  • Direct, daily collaboration with a US-based team, in English, on a product serving real clients — not a back-office ticket queue.

You must have

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience, with real production depth in React/Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL.
  • Advanced/professional spoken and written English.
  • Based in a Latin American country, able to work with substantial daily overlap with US Eastern Time.
  • Ability to work and invoice as an independent contractor in your country of residence.

How to apply

Direct applicants only — no third-party agencies or recruiters.

jobs.title: Design Lead
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. We are evolving what product design looks like at Sumara, and this is the role that leads it.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are evolving what product design looks like at Sumara, and this is the role that leads it.

The traditional product design role is built around handoff. You sketch in Figma, hand it to engineering, wait, get a build that does not match the spec, iterate, ship something close to the original idea. The handoff is where craft, speed, and intent get lost.

AI tools are changing what a product designer can do. Tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, v0, and modern Figma let a designer go from idea to working prototype, and increasingly to near-production interface, faster than a traditional designer-plus-engineer pair. The handoff shrinks. The designer ships more of what they design.

This role is for product designers who want to be at the front of that shift. Whether you are already experimenting with these tools or just curious and motivated to learn, we will invest in your growth, give you the time and the support, and help you evolve into what the industry is calling a design engineer. You set the pace.

We are building a unified financial platform that combines trading, investing, crypto, and everyday spending into a single account. Five pillars. Different latencies, different mental models, different levels of complexity. All inside one app on a phone screen. In a product that moves people’s money, polish is not a nice-to-have. It is what makes the product trustworthy.

WHAT YOU OWN

  • The design system from scratch: components, primitives, tokens, motion language, accessibility patterns, built to scale across all five pillars

  • End-to-end product surfaces: discovery, exploration, high-fidelity design, prototyping, partnership with engineering through to ship

  • Animation and interaction design: gestures, transitions, micro-interactions that make the product feel alive

  • Cross-pillar consistency: making sure trading, investing, crypto, and cards feel like one product, not five

  • Your own evolution: pulling AI tools and frontend skills into your workflow over time so you can prototype and ship more of what you design directly

You work shoulder-to-shoulder with other product designers, product managers, and engineers. You own the result, not the artifact.

HOW YOU OPERATE

You are curious about AI tools and excited to make them part of your workflow. Maybe you are already using Claude or Cursor on the side. Maybe you have heard about Claude Code and v0 but have not gone deep yet. Both are fine. What matters is the direction of travel.

We will invest time, training, and tooling in helping you become self-sufficient at prototyping and shipping using AI. By the end of year one, you should be operating much closer to a design engineer than to a traditional product designer. That is the deal we are offering, and it is rare.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • The design system is in production within six months, with clear rules other teams adopt

  • The app has a recognisable visual and interaction signature

  • Polish gaps between pillars close. The product feels like one app, not a federation of features.

  • You are visibly more self-sufficient at prototyping and shipping by the end of year one

  • New product surfaces inherit craft instead of fighting for it


Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years as a product designer shipping consumer products at quality

  • Strong taste. You have shipped interfaces that look and feel deliberately different from the average.

  • Fluent in Figma, motion, interaction design, and design systems thinking

  • Curious about AI tools and motivated to make them part of how you work, even if you are not there yet

  • Comfort working close to code. You can read it, you understand what is happening, you are open to going deeper.

  • Intent to evolve your craft, not defend the old version of it

Strong signal

  • Already experimenting with AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, v0, Lovable, or similar) in your workflow or side projects

  • A public portfolio, Dribbble, Codepen, GitHub, or live demos that show range across UI, motion, and craft

  • Mobile-first product experience (iOS and Android)

  • Experience contributing to a design system at a real product company

  • Frontend skills, even informal (React, React Native, modern CSS)

  • Fintech, trading, crypto, or any product where polish directly shapes user trust

  • Charting, data visualization, or real-time UI experience


Benefits

Benefits
  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Market standard EOSB and performance bonuses
  • Comprehensive health insurance
  • Professional development and conference budgets
  • Team building events, career mentorship, and strong company culture
  • Remote work flexibility
